name: Rote Rosen
description: Rote Rosen is a German telenovela produced by Studio Hamburg Serienwerft Lüneburg and broadcast by Das Erste since November 6, 2006. The show is a complex telenovela, who tells one love story every season about women in their forties.

videos.title: Episode 1503

videos.title: Episode 1504
videos.overview: Vera doesn’t want Jan’s aggressive son Robin in the Rosenhaus which leads to a conflict with Jan. Britta notices Ben behaves nervous; he evades her questions. Sönke wants Jule to take care of him and not his mother Claudia.

videos.title: Episode 1505
videos.overview: Gunter is in love and Benita feels more for him than she wants. Benita doesn’t share Lorenzo’s vision of their future. She rejects Gunter’s proposal of marriage. Jan is disappointed when Vera accuses him of having a relation with another.

videos.title: Episode 1506
videos.overview: Benita doubts between her old plans with Lorenzo and her new love for Gunter. Jan withdraws the translation job even when Claudia denies having undermined his relation with Vera. Robin is glad Ariane forgives him.

videos.title: Episode 1507
videos.overview: Britta is glad when she is invited to do a reading in New York. She has to talk about it with her chief first but Ben disturbs her plans. Vera encourages Jan to adopt Robin as his son. Naomi is glad Thomas offers her his help.

videos.title: Episode 1508
videos.overview: Naomi and Thomas record Thomas’ talk with a witness via Lorenzo’s cellphone. Naomi disclosures her secret to Lorenzo. Benita looks for the USB-stick in the commune when Gunter and Thomas enter. Will Vera’s party fail?

videos.title: Episode 1509
videos.overview: Benita and Gunter are more and more a perfect couple. Lorenzo addresses Benita because she rejected Gunter’s proposal of marriage. Claudia places herself outside of the group because of her distrust. Torben cannot use the telephone tap.

videos.title: Episode 1510
videos.overview: Jan and Sönke make it that in the hotel it becomes clear that Claudia’s credit card has been blocked. Benita confesses she loves Gunter. The crisis between Ben and Britta escalates. Ben acknowledges he has a problem and needs help.

videos.title: Episode 1511
videos.overview: Benita admits Lorenzo she feels something for him as well as for Gunter. Naomi is enthusiast about Alfred’s romantic idea to give a private concert in «Salto». Jan addresses Claudia about a possible threat to him and Vera.

videos.title: Episode 1512
videos.overview: When Vera is reported to the supervisory authority, Jan accuses Claudia immediately of sabotage. Vera turns out to be innocent. Claudia manipulated the parachute of Jan and Vera. Only Benita can pull Lorenzo out of the juridical problems.

videos.title: Episode 1513
videos.overview: Vera and Jan are surprised when the pilot quits the parachute jump. Claudia informed the pilot in the nick of time. Benita doesn’t remember anything in front of the judge. Seefeld sticks to his verdict despite of a bribe attempt.

videos.title: Episode 1514
videos.overview: Frederic hears Naomi is being threatened by Lorenzo. He postpones his voyage. Claudia flees again for Jan and Vera. Sönke convinces mother to report herself to the police. Merle wants to help Ariane to do something against the rent raise.

videos.title: Episode 1515
videos.overview: Torben and Frederic save Naomi just in time from Lorenzo’s mob. Jan is indignant because Claudia goes scot-free. Jule runs over Claudia with a car. Benita and Gunter are in the seventh heaven and Lorenzo doesn’t like that.

videos.title: Episode 1516
videos.overview: Merle lets Rieke down. Erika successfully intermediates but when Merle discovers that the inherited house has to be renovated, she feels having been fooled. Lorenzo sticks to his demand. Benita realizes she has to tell Gunter the truth.

videos.title: Episode 1517
videos.overview: Gunter is glad Benita accepted his proposal of marriage. During a talk with Sönke he understands with fright that Benita has a secret. Merle makes it clear to Erika that she doesn’t let Rieke fool her.

videos.title: Episode 1518
videos.overview: Gunter is irritated by Sönke’s remark: What does Benita hide for him? Jule suffers too much from her part in Claudia’s death. Ben and Britta quarrel all the time. Merle hears from Rieke how heartless her father was.

videos.title: Episode 1519
videos.overview: Because Jule feels guilty about the accident. She goes on distance from Sönke. Gunter makes up the municipal amount to buy the painting back. Lorenzo refuses to leave the city.

videos.title: Episode 1520
videos.overview: Gunter wants to marry Benita but hears she met Lorenzo again. Sönke finds it hard to accept the separation from Jule. Britta doesn’t want to keep Ben on distance any longer but now Ben keeps her on distance.

videos.title: Episode 1521
videos.overview: Gunter doubts to marry Benita tomorrow because she lied to him about her relation with Lorenzo. Vera is not surprised Jan doesn’t want to be on Claudia’s funeral. Hannes returns from Bhutan.

videos.title: Episode 1522
videos.overview: Sönke is relieved when Jan and also Jule appear on Claudia’s funeral. Sönke’s funeral oration results in a charge against God. Benita has to accept that Gunter cancels their marriage.

videos.title: Episode 1523
videos.overview: Sönke loses his faith in God after Claudia’s death. After talking with Ben he sees he still can help people. Gunter realizes he loves Benita. They decide to marry each other. Ariane wants to lure more customers by doing things different.

videos.title: Episode 1524
videos.overview: Merle places Benita out of the nursery and accuses Rieke who knew about Benita’s evil plan. Benita blabs Torben that Lorenzo wants to thrust the church a falsified painting. Jule fears to have to express her opinion about the accident.

videos.title: Episode 1525
videos.overview: Gunter places Lorenzo out of the hotel. Lorenzo wants to kill him for 3 million Eur. Jan decides to live in Lüneburg. Sönke tells the general editor about Jule’s accident. The editor takes away her report. Robin is stolen an old timer.

videos.title: Episode 1526
videos.overview: Benita is frightened when Lorenzo wants to kill Gunter to get the three million Eur. For the sake of appearances he agrees with her suggestion to wait a month for reflection. Jule is angry with Sönke. Jan and Vera have a quarrel.

videos.title: Episode 1527
videos.overview: Lorenzo wants to poison Gunter during Rieke’s wine tasting. Vera wants to start a biological garden with Jan but Jan hesitates. Vera finds a parcel at Lorenzo and suspects the falsified painting in it. Mick wants time for reflection.

videos.title: Episode 1528
videos.overview: Sönke has lost is faith in God. Jule has a trauma caused by the accident in which Sönke’s mother lost her life. Benita saves Gunter from drinking the poisoned wine. When she works against Lorenzo, she knows also her life is in danger.

videos.title: Episode 1529
videos.overview: Ariane succeeds in lowering the raise of the rent. She starts a shoe production. Rosi raises the rent again and desires Hannes more and more. Rieke has a quarrel with Mick constantly. Bali: Mick traces Benita’s past.

videos.title: Episode 1530
videos.overview: Vera and Merle want to proof that Lorenzo chanced the original with a falsified painting but Lorenzo catches them. He steels Benita’s pistol. Benita fears the loss of Gunter’s life. Ben and Britta feel attracted towards each other.

videos.title: Episode 1531
videos.overview: Lorenzo locked Vera and Merle in the cellar. Jan and Gunter can’t reach them and their worries grow. During a scuffle a shot sounds: Merle has been hit. Thomas is convinced that the lake is poisoned.

videos.title: Episode 1532
videos.overview: Jan and Gunter are indignant when they hear that Vera and Merle keep an eye on Lorenzo to reveal his deceit. Merle has lost much blood and becomes unconscious. Jule takes part in group therapy for Sönke.

videos.title: Episode 1533
videos.overview: The hospital has an insufficient buffer of Merle’s rare blood type. Fortunately Gunter’s blood rescues Merle. Lorenzo asks Benita after the false pass so he can disappear to Uruguay. Jule hallucinates: she sees Claudia.

videos.title: Episode 1534
videos.overview: Jule feels guilty about Claudia’s death and desperately deletes her report. She commits plagiarism but that is discovered. Lorenzo drinks the poisoned Champaign. Benita lets his corpse sink in the lake.

videos.title: Episode 1535
videos.overview: Benita acts as if everything is OK but through Mick Gunter gets a photo with Benita and Lorenzo. Vera and Jan are disappointed when they selling of the land is finally canceled. Jule has to admit she committed plagiarism.

videos.title: Episode 1536
videos.overview: Merle leaves the hospital for work but becomes unwell in Gunter’s arms. Benita asserts that the one on the photo is Lorenzo’s ex but Gunter still has his doubts. Ariane is surprised when her father Rainer visits her on her birthday.

videos.title: Episode 1537
videos.overview: Vera talks so much with Rainer that Jan wants to send him out of the house. Gunter offers Merle against Benita’s will to help him with the garden show. Rieke advices Merle to keep Gunter on distance. Benita’s intrigue against Mick fails.

videos.title: Episode 1538
videos.overview: Jan is not happy when Rainer offers Vera to live in the Rosenhaus but he denies to be jealous. Rainer is impressed by Ariane’s special shoe design. Benita confesses having caused an allergic reaction with a customer.

videos.title: Episode 1539
videos.overview: Torben hears the falsifiers have been caught but there is no indication that the handwriting is not real. Gunter puts more and more trust in Benita despite of the Bali photos. Vera founds Rainer to have become modest.

videos.title: Episode 1540
videos.overview: Rainer helps Ariane with the renovation. Jan confronts Rainer with an article that says Rainer was in jail. Benita is alarmed when Mick tells her he sees what her plan is. Seefeldt falls for Torben’s bluff and confirms the falsification.

videos.title: Episode 1541
videos.overview: Jan tells Vera that her ex Rainer has to go to jail soon. Ariane’s understanding for her father Rainer disappears when he doesn’t care about the suicide of one of his victims. Mick has trouble in the hotel. Robin receives strange calls.

videos.title: Episode 1542
videos.overview: Rieke helps Mick with a love menu for special guests. Ariane had it with Rainer. Vera sends Rainer out of the house. Sönke still wrestles with the death of his mother. Hannes’ wild garden doesn’t help neighbor Erika.

videos.title: Episode 1543
videos.overview: Erika is glad Hannes and Robin decide to sell their garden goods but the next day it turns out that guests of the selling event have ruined Erika’s garden. Mick plays his affair with Rieke down. Vera evicts Rainer.

videos.title: Episode 1544
videos.overview: Rieke wants to couple Merle with Rainer but when she lures Rainer to the nursery-garden, something goes wrong. Thanks to Robin’s failed sale event it looks like Erika’s chance to win is gone. Ariane still is angry with Rainer.

videos.title: Episode 1545
videos.overview: Rainer is broke and has to live with Vera and Jan. Jan is angry and offers Rainer to move into the assisted living. Erika is surprised that the game commission comes to her without previous notice. Jan gives Robin’s car part trade a chance.

videos.title: Episode 1546
videos.overview: Sönke gets full acknowledgment now he has found the painting. But Crescenzia Lombardi accuses him of deceit. On their first date Merle and Rainer come each other near. Because of the removal Benita puts pressure on Gunter.

videos.title: Episode 1547
videos.overview: Soon it becomes clear Lorenzo cheated the church with the sale of the painting. Crescenzia claims the painting is hers. Thomas informs the environmental service that farmer Denhaake is the sinner. Robin shrinks from starting a company.

videos.title: Episode 1548
videos.overview: Gunter is jealous when he sees Merle with Rainer, which confuses him. When Benita urges him to it, he decides to go to Sardinia. Jan and Vera are surprised that Gunter offers them to buy his country-seat. Robin starts a trade in car parts.

videos.title: Episode 1549
videos.overview: Mick still thinks Benita is in league with Lorenzo. Torben, Mick, Rieke and Crescenzia search in Lorenzo’s bank statements. Vera and Jan want to buy the country-seat from Gunter. The friendship between Thomas and Gunter is damaged.

videos.title: Episode 1550
videos.overview: Benita can take away Mick’s suspicion of murder but not his distrust. Gunter hesitates selling the country-seat. Merle advices him to leave Lüneburg. Mick avoids Rieke. He makes her clear he loves Annett.

videos.title: Episode 1551
videos.overview: Rieke is surprised when Mick doesn’t want her to tell Annett about their one-night-stand. Soon it becomes clear what Annett wants from Mick. Benita turns out to know Annett. Jule reacts disappointed in Sönke. Thomas raises an objection.

videos.title: Episode 1552
videos.overview: Mick is surprised when Annett does him a proposal. Rieke dissuades it. He thanks her with a kiss. Benita makes a picture of the kiss. Ariane presents her fashion collection to the press. Jule wants to be the mouthpiece of the town-hall.

videos.title: Episode 1553
videos.overview: The head of the municipal service for environment assures Jule to treat her fair but in reality he wants to use her to put pressure on Thomas. Britta is glad she got medic apparatuses for the poor-relief board.

videos.title: Episode 1554
videos.overview: Benita makes Gunter believe that Mick made Annett’s father ready to take over «Drei Könige» as soon as Gunter is on Sardinia. Mick confesses he had sex with Rieke. Britta discovers her seemingly drunken chief wants to do a bypass operation.

videos.title: Episode 1555
videos.overview: Benita’s intrigue succeeds: Annett betrays her lover Mick. But Gunter withdraws Mick’s discharge. Robin is disappointed when Ariane doesn’t want to go with him to England. Britta doubts to report her alcoholic chief to the management.

videos.title: Episode 1556
videos.overview: Ariane decides to go with Robin to Crawley, England, but Robin already canceled the earl. When Thomas tries to find the number of her doctor, he is almost surprised by Benita. Jan and Vera are back after Jan sold his supermarket chain.

videos.title: Episode 1557
videos.overview: Thomas discovers an expert report about the water, is fake. Jule is threatened and Sönke wants her to withdraw herself. Britta discovers her chief lost his driver’s license. Gunter doubts to go to Sardinia.

videos.title: Episode 1558
videos.overview: Ben and his family start to shop a lot but then it turns out that Ben doesn’t get the big order. Gunter waits impatiently for Benita’s disease file. Santiago blackmails Benita. Robin doesn’t tell Ariane he has to race cars for his new job.

videos.title: Episode 1559
videos.overview: Gunter still fears Benita was as Sophia Magnani the lover of Lorenzo. Thanks to Alfred’s help at the latest moment Mick becomes «Barkeeper of the year». Rieke and Mick have sex.

videos.title: Episode 1560
videos.overview: Merle hopes Torben can reduce Rainer’s sentence. When Benita dumps Lorenzo’s travel bag in the lake, she fears Gunter could have seen her. Ariane is sad because she had a quarrel with Robin.

videos.title: Episode 1561
videos.overview: Rainer does Merle a proposal of marriage but Merle doesn’t feel that much for him. The buyer of Jan’s store hasn’t enough money. Jule suspects more abuses at the town-hall. Thomas refuses a job at the environment service.

videos.title: Episode 1562
videos.overview: After the separation from Merle Rainer develops fear to end-up in prison. He tries his luck with Jan’s money on the stock exchange. Gunter’s trust in Benita cracks. He is not to know Mick and Rieke are a pair.

videos.title: Episode 1563
videos.overview: Thomas prepares his polar expedition with enthusiasm. Benita blackmails Rainer who gambles with Jan’s money at the stock exchange. Mick and Rieke see their business trip canceled because Gunter discovered they are a pair.

videos.title: Episode 1564
videos.overview: Rainer gambles with Jan’s money and loses; Jan is mad. When Benita wants a day without Gunter to sell her yacht; he pretends his cooperation. Thomas refuses the job at the environment service first but starts to doubt about his decision.

videos.title: Episode 1565
videos.overview: Gunter hides in the community. Benita thinks she is save. Rainer is in despair because he disappointed Ariane. Because of Rainer’s deceit Vera and Jan don’t want to buy the country-seat anymore. Thomas becomes an environmental agent.

videos.title: Episode 1566
videos.overview: Benita talks herself out in front of Gunter who becomes suspicious. Ariane suffers from the fact that her father did Vera and Jan out of one million Eur. Rainer promises her to report himself to the police but in fact he hides himself.

videos.title: Episode 1567
videos.overview: Rainer puts pressure on Benita to make her motivate Gunter to sell the country-seat to Jan. Gunter doubts Benita. Merle convinces him to try a new start with Benita on Sardinia. Thomas persuades the mayor for a dive inspection in the lake.

videos.title: Episode 1568
videos.overview: Benita’s attempt to put pressure on Gunter fails. Mick gives Rieke a wine cooler but it doesn’t function. Ben saves the wine by repairing the cooler in time. Britta suggests Ben to nominate for the Heather Pair 2013 contest.

videos.title: Episode 1569
videos.overview: Thomas and Jule think Johanna has enough flight experience after a scenic flight but Johanna wants to have a flight-certificate. Gunter refuses to sell the country-seat to Vera and Jan. Benita fears Lorenzo’s corpse will be found.

videos.title: Episode 1570
videos.overview: Benita fears Gunter could surprise her any moment. Lorenzo’s corpse is found. Jan and Vera are glad they still can buy the country-seat. Torben interrupts the quarrel between Rieke and Mick. Ariane has production problems for the fair.

videos.title: Episode 1571
videos.overview: Gunter suspects Benita of having murdered Lorenzo. Thomas can’t avoid Jule to see Lorenzo’s corpse. Jule remembers she once run over Sönke’s mother Claudia. The management wants fences in the allotment garden.

videos.title: Episode 1572
videos.overview: Benita denies to have anything to do with Lorenzo’s dead but when Gunter surprises her hiding her third earring Benita confesses her guilt. Jule swallows pills to keep on working hard. Johanna trains for her flight-certificate.

videos.title: Episode 1573
videos.overview: Benita tells Gunter that Lorenzo died as the result of an accident. It goes wrong when Merle wants to talk about it with Gunter. Thomas understands his mother Johanna wants to have her flight-certificate before it is too late.

videos.title: Episode 1574
videos.overview: After a fierce quarrel Benita offers Gunter not to go to Sardinia but to stay with him in Lüneburg. Jule has to defend the new highway but in fact she is against it. Despite that she throws away her pills.

videos.title: Episode 1575
videos.overview: Mick surprises Rieke with a bottle of wine. She cooks for him. When Mick wants to give her his home key she leaves in a hurry. Benita gets mad when Gunter wants to live in the hotel. Rieke kisses Torben not knowing Carla comes home.

videos.title: Episode 1576
videos.overview: Gunter doubts: can he believe Benita and does she really love him? Carla is back and wants to celebrate with Torben their first wedding day but she surprises him when he kisses Rieke. Jule panics when her sedative pills fall in the drain.

videos.title: Episode 1577
videos.overview: Gunter wants to divorce from Benita and is astonished to hear Benita had a double life. Carla and Torben don’t understand each other. Hannes and Erika hear the allotment garden has to make place for the highway.

videos.title: Episode 1578
videos.overview: Britta worries about Jule and refuses to give her the pharmaceuticals. Jule surprises Sönke who searches secretly in her bag. Benita can’t deny that she lived in luxury as Sophia on Lorenzo’s side. She disappoints Gunter.

videos.title: Episode 1579
videos.overview: When Gunter discovers Benita’s double life he grabs her arms. Benita provokes him to act aggressive. Rieke wants to prepare the menu for Carla’s wedding if Carla hires her when the menu is a success.

videos.title: Episode 1580
videos.overview: Gunter demands that Benita is gone when he returns from Brittany but Benita stays. Jule confesses Sönke she stole Britta’s recipes. Carla and Torben start to realize that a relation on distance is impossible for them.

videos.title: Episode 1581
videos.overview: After they return from their vacation Jan and Vera want to the start as biological farmers. They do not know yet that an highway is planned on their parcel. Hannes is surprised when Uschi visits him. Erika doesn’t like it. Benita is alone.

videos.title: Episode 1582
videos.overview: Merle suspects Benita of having murdered Lorenzo. She informs Mick and Rieke about it. Benita hears that Gunter is in Brittany. Jan wants to sell the farm. Jule ordered pills through the Internet.

videos.title: Episode 1583
videos.overview: Desperate Sönke decides to break off with Jule. Benita is not given Gunter’s address but she finds it on his computer. Jan finds a possible buyer for the parcel but Vera doesn’t want to sell: buyer is not informed about the planned highway.

videos.title: Episode 1584
videos.overview: Merle has a bad feeling about it that Benita has found out Gunter’s stay in Brittany. Sönke wants via the divorce force Jule to deal with her addiction by herself. Vera searches the area for protected animal and plant species.

videos.title: Episode 1585
videos.overview: Hannes feels overcharged by Uschi which satisfies Erika. Despite that, when Uschi wants him to go with her to Malaga, he packs his bags. Gunter’s friends try in vain to contact him and to warn him for Benita.

videos.title: Episode 1586
videos.overview: When the Italian police doesn’t take the suspect against Benita serious, Merle and Vera decide to go to Gunter’s villa themselves to warn him. Jule starts her therapy. Unlike Britta Ben wants to win the Heather Pair contest.

videos.title: Episode 1587
videos.overview: Merle and Vera reach the villa just in time to safe Gunter’s life. Hannes sees his romantic idea of Spain being disappointing in reality. Ole and Lisa win the Heather Pair contest but Lisa withdraws herself.

videos.title: Episode 1588
videos.overview: Thomas and Jan try to catch Gunter after he hears from his marriage and Benita’s suicide. Vera and Jan realize the planned highway makes a bio certificate impossible for them. Britta and Ben are not amused to become Heather Pair 2013.

videos.title: Episode 1589
videos.overview: Gunter doesn’t want to sell back the country-seat Jan and Vera offer him; he wants to sell «Drei Könige». Uschi wants Hannes to come with her now or keep away forever. Ole discovers that Lotte lied to him. Jule wants to work on her trauma.

videos.title: Episode 1590
videos.overview: Hannes risks the chance to go with Uschi to Andalusia. They come not far because they differ too much from each other. Gunter finds a buyer for the country-seat of Jan and Vera. Lotte wants to stay the night with Brian.

videos.title: Episode 1591
videos.overview: Vera accepts gladly Jan’s proposal. They find a buyer for the country-seat. Alfred returns from New York as the winner of the World Cocktail Contest. Jule wants to get rid of Sönke even after his proposal of marriage.

videos.title: Episode 1592
videos.overview: Alfred becomes unwell and is brought to the hospital; Britta diagnoses a lung infection. When Mick thinks Rieke is on her way to New York she stands for his door: Mick is more important to her. Vera and Jan decide to sell the country-seat.

videos.title: Episode 1593
videos.overview: Vera and Jan are glad Gunter buys the country-seat back for the full 1.7 million Eur. Now they can buy the vineyard. Jule wants to start a campaign against addiction and confesses her pill addiction. Alfred lies in the hospital.

videos.title: Episode 1594
videos.overview: When the wedding preparations start to become too much for Vera she and Jan decide to keep it small. Trouble between Lisa and Lotte. Lotte gets advanced money from Erika for her laptop. Despite his illness Alfons works too hard.

videos.title: Episode 1595
videos.overview: Jan and Vera decide to marry in small circle but secretly both plan a big wedding party. Ole accuses Lisa of freezing Lotte out; pregnant Lisa feels stitches in her belly. Alfred wants to die. Torben flies with Rieke to Copenhagen.

videos.title: Episode 1596
videos.overview: Johanna decides to fly away with Alfred to the horses he wants to see in reality. Rieke and Torben return successfully from Copenhagen. When Hannes lets his tongue run away with him Vera knows that Jan is planning a wedding party.

videos.title: Episode 1597
videos.overview: Alfred returns from the flight to the horses. He and Johanna don’t speak about it. Vera and Jan stop their secret party preparations but realize they will have nothing this way. Torben keeps Rieke on distance; Rieke searches Mick’s help.

videos.title: Episode 1598
videos.overview: Vera and Jan laugh when they find out both have quited the party preparation for each other. Sönke, Gunter and Merle help them with the preparation. Torben is happy because Carla is back. Mick asks Rieke if she has an affair with Torben.

videos.title: Episode 1599
videos.overview: When Vera wants to give up the search for a white wedding dress Erika finds the dress of her mother. Merle and Gunter come closer to each other during dancing and finally kiss. Ole is skeptical about the reconciliation of Brian and Lotte.

videos.title: Episode 1600
videos.overview: Vera and Jan have a great wedding party with family and friends. They start a new life on the borders of the Mosel. Torben is glad that Carla is back but he can’t forget Rieke. Inge fears that Ole needs help.

videos.title: Episode 1601
videos.overview: Lotte is being mobbed since she wrongly is accused. Torben has to admit there is something between him and Rieke but he doesn’t want to deceive Carla. Johanna confesses that she damaged the airplane.

videos.title: Episode 1602
videos.overview: Tine tenderly is there for her daughter Lotte. The relation between Ole and Tine is difficult. Tine blames Merle because she went to bed with Ole once. Mick and Carla think they have different opinions about the renovation of «Salto».

videos.title: Episode 1603
videos.overview: Merle wants to talk with Tine about her past but Tine blocks it because she couldn’t forgive Merle her one-night-stand with Ole. Gunter wants Merle back as his partner. Torben dreams he declares Rieke his love and divorces from Carla.

videos.title: Episode 1604
videos.overview: Torben leaves; Carla is hurt and stays behind. Gunter rejects Carla’s idea for «Salto». Mick is also hurt; Rieke comforts him. Tine and Ole must see that they can’t do a lot against the cyber mobbing.

videos.title: Episode 1605
videos.overview: Tine rejects the idea that Lotte lives with Merle till the exam. Can sect leader Uli Klein manipulate Lotte? Carla wants to push her plans for «Salto» forward. Johanna arranges a flight instructor for Merle.

videos.title: Episode 1606
videos.overview: Lotte hesitates to deal with Uli Klein. Tine’s corked up anger comes out during a quarrel with Merle. Carla wants Torben to come back. When Torben sits in front of her door he accuses her of endangering their marriage.

videos.title: Episode 1607
videos.overview: Tine agrees that Lotte lives with Ole and Lisa until she is 18. Sönke explains Tine that Malakron is a sect. Inge discovers that Erika and Hannes go very well with each other. Rahel offers Gunter a leading position.

videos.title: Episode 1608
videos.overview: Tine and Ole come close to each other because their daughter might be in the hands of the sect «Malakron». According to Thomas Gunter needs a new wife. Gunter is not interested in Rahel; he is interested in the job she offers him.

videos.title: Episode 1609
videos.overview: Lotte has lost her faith in her mother after Tine’s anger expression. Ole wants to protect her for the sect but when Ole is angry with Brian, Lotte sees him as a traitor. Torben postpones the confession of his affair.

videos.title: Episode 1610
videos.overview: Ole accidentally hits Brian. Lotte moves to the sect house with Brian. Tine and Ole decide to get her from there. Mick hears about Carla’s marriage problems and asks Rieke again about her relation with Torben.

videos.title: Episode 1611
videos.overview: Mick can’t forgive Rieke her affair with Torben. During a quarrel with Carla he tells her the truth. Lisa removes with mixed feelings to the Rosenhaus. Malte makes Lotte a little loose from Malakron. Can Gunter revive the trot course?

videos.title: Episode 1612
videos.overview: Jule becomes a member of Malakron. Only Sönke knows she is there undercover to stop Uli Klein. Lotte doubts: does she belong to Malakron or to her mother? Carla lets Torben feel how deep his affair hurts her.

videos.title: Episode 1613
videos.overview: Tine sends Lotte a message from someone who left Malakron. Lotte decides to leave the sect. The cyber mobbing stops; Uli says he controls this. Carla designs fashionable working clothes and Tine brings this under the fashion label Hedelund.

videos.title: Episode 1614
videos.overview: Carla lets Rieke know how disappointed she is. Gunter’s mediation has no effect. When Rieke packs her bags Carla asks her to stay. Brian tries to convince Lotte to return to the sect.

videos.title: Episode 1615
videos.overview: Tine and Ole come near to each other so Ole forgets his appointment for triathlon with Lisa. Britta comforts Ben who didn’t get good starting places for the triathlon. Inge and Erika worry about Lady Applewhite.

videos.title: Episode 1616
videos.overview: Because of a contagious horse virus the trot course cannot be opened as planned. Gunter must not know that Merle lends money from Inge and Udo to buy shares. Lotte finds out that her parents divorced because Ole had an affair.

videos.title: Episode 1617
videos.overview: Gunter is convinced Merle bought herself into the trot course to be closer to him. Tine and Ole are astound when they discover Lotte lies to them for Malakron. Carla and Torben vainly try to repair their relation with a romantic dinner.

videos.title: Episode 1618
videos.overview: Ole hopes Lotte can stay with her mother when he and Lisa are on vacation. He cancels the vacation when there seems to be a chance that Lisa comes under the influence of the sect. Carla asks herself if there is a future for her and Torben.

videos.title: Episode 1619
videos.overview: Tine is hurt when Lisa tells her she is a bad mother. Tine is glad that there is harmony between her and Ole. During a dinner Udo and Inge invite Erika to come with them to Mallorca. Malte hopes to get a financial investor through Torben.

videos.title: Episode 1620

videos.title: Episode 4000
videos.overview: Klaas saves wounded Jördis who lies outside in the storm. Mo places family before Julius. Simon gains admiration for the fire brigade but hesitates to join them. The lessor annuls the rent of Ben’s workshop. Benefactor Hannes.

videos.title: Episode 4001
videos.overview: Klaas and Jördis are together; the Kilic family reacts. Elyas informs his family: he did get a large amount of money. Leyla is invited to become Diana’s co-trainer. Jorik doesn’t trust Amelie. Carla makes her new food truck public.

videos.title: Episode 4002
videos.overview: Leyla closes her sports career, or not? Is Mo needed for his family? Klaas resists against his use of a household remedy. Amelie, Jorik and Julius keep the moldy roof parts silence for Gunter. Does Hannes become a capitalist?

videos.title: Episode 4003
videos.overview: Gunter hears about the neglected roof maintenance that caused Jorik almost an accident. Responsible are Julius and Amelie who blame each other. On the Salzmarkt Julius and Amelie help two guys that have been beaten because they are gay. Laundry shop Kilic starts a pro-gay action. In the meantime Julius and Amelie propose hotel owner Gunter to turn the hotel into a safe space as a statement against intolerance. Bicycle mechanic Ben seeks a new location for his repair shop. He still blames Franka for driving him away causing that his existence is at stake. Franka reflects again that when he had his communication right, this would have happened. Julius and Hendrik persuade Ben to offer Franka his excuses. Carla’s food truck opens today in a party atmosphere. Johanna rather doesn’t see that. Her opinion has been exaggerated by a journalist before publication.

videos.title: Episode 4035
videos.overview: Amelie and Jorik present the hotel project to potential investors. Jorik becomes aware of the enormous responsibility and would rather give up the plan. Simon reassures him that Amelie will not find an investor anyway. But Amelie wins Fabienne as a financier. Marvin is looking forward to a weekend in Amsterdam with the poker lady. However, there is a problem: who will represent him in the food truck? Marvin can persuade Leyla and Franka convinces Ben to do it. Marvin is happy until he sees Franka and Ben in a warm embrace. He is seething with jealousy. Klaas is aware that he has to accept Jördis’ wish for distance. Even if the break in the relationship feels like a separation to him. At the same time, he lets Valerie know that she has to leave his apartment as soon as he returns from a conference. Elyas returns from Cologne unhappy: Celeste has cheated on him. Mo tries to be there for him sensitively, but Elyas is biased - because Mo loves a man.

videos.title: Episode 4036
videos.overview: Valerie feels lonely and tries to connect with Franka and Julius. At the same time, Simon finds out by chance that Valerie is pregnant and Leyla suspects her. Could he be the father? Valerie is at a loss for words. Jorik is not comfortable with the plans to buy the Askanier Park. Amelie, on the other hand, is already mentally organizing the move to the new property, which Jorik doesn’t like at all. But the plan threatens to fail: Fabienne demands equity from Amelie, which she doesn’t have. Jördis accidentally comes across the documentary filmmaker Adam Szymanski at a lecture, which reawakens her old longing for Botswana. When she meets Szymanski in the hospital, however, the two clash. Marvin is irritated by his feelings for Franka and would like to flee to Amsterdam immediately. But Leyla is unavailable to cover for the food truck. Franka, of all people, spontaneously offers to step in.

videos.title: Episode 4037
videos.overview: Marvin and Franka get on well during their training at the food truck. When Marvin finds out that Franka has registered Ben as the caregiver for the foster child at the youth welfare office, he is hurt - Franka didn’t want a child with him. He angrily accuses her of not having a foster child. Elyas has forgotten the deadline for his seminar paper and is under time pressure. Jørdis has the idea of asking Julius for help. But Elyas still has a problem with Mo’s relationship with Julius. Can Elyas get over his fears? Valerie assures Simon that he is not the father of her child. When Julius finds out, Valerie has to justify herself to her brother too. Under pressure, she forges her maternity certificate and presents it as proof. Amelie is so busy planning the hotel takeover that she forgets about Henni’s chess tournament. Jorik accuses her of not caring about her family. And Amelie shows insight - she wants to drop the Askanier Park project.

videos.title: Episode 4038
videos.overview: Elyas has difficulty dealing with his father’s partner in a relaxed manner. Only when Julius makes it clear to him that Mo has not changed despite his new love does Elyas reconcile with his father and Julius is warmly welcomed by the Kilics. Julius is so happy that he spontaneously proposes marriage to Mo. Simon’s chickens are about to hatch and he is wondering: Where should the little ones go? Farmer Knut Petersen’s farm would be ideal. But Simon has fallen out with the farmer. Can he still convince the stubborn Knut? Marvin breaks off his short trip to Amsterdam because the argument with Franka is too much for him. When he returns, he finds that she has stepped in for him in the food truck despite everything... Valerie tries to get closer to Franka again. The two sisters spend an evening together like in the old days. Until Franka realizes - she is not yet ready for a reconciliation with her younger sister.

videos.title: Episode 4039
videos.overview: Fabienne thinks Amelie’s withdrawal from the hotel project is cowardly. This is bothering Amelie. She gets the feeling that everyone around her is in the fast lane - only she is stuck in «Carlas». She spontaneously decides to buy the Askanier Park after all. Jorik is horrified. Mo puts pressure on Julius’ spontaneous marriage proposal. Julius blames himself - he actually only wanted to express his happiness. He then gives Mo a symbolic gift, which Mo happily accepts. The city is planning a new park project on a green area that belongs to farmer Knut Petersen. But the stubborn farmer refuses to sell. Franka senses a good job and wants to convince Knut so that the city will give her the contract in return. But at the last moment Franka cancels the meeting when she realizes that Knut is an old ex-lover of hers. On the other hand, Simon manages to make a deal with farmer Knut: his chicks can stay on the farm if he works a few hours on the farm.

videos.title: Episode 4040
videos.overview: Jördis finally learns more about the Okavango Delta from Adam Szymanski. It becomes clear that Adam has sacrificed his private life for his expeditions. Jördis doesn’t want to go that far, but she finally wants to realize her dream of traveling to Africa. Ceyda encourages her to set off alone. Jördis is motivated until Klaas returns from his conference and declares his love for her. Farmer Knut Petersen is open to Franka’s project. However, he flirts with her, so that Franka spontaneously breaks off a business appointment. Has she thereby lost her chances of a good deal? Jorik is angry that Amelie wants to buy the Askanier Park on her own. He accuses her of acting selfishly. But Amelie is not put off - she wants more from life. The two argue violently and Jorik’s words hurt Amelie deeply. Simon wants to finish his work for farmer Knut as quickly as possible - hard farm work is not his thing. But then Knut has an accident.

videos.title: Episode 4041
videos.overview: Ben returns from Andalusia and cannot yet return to his apartment because of the broken roof. So Franka and Ben decide to extend their shared apartment situation. Lilly could also move to the estate temporarily. But Lilly has other problems at the moment and feels ignored by Ben. She accuses him of playing the «super dad» but only thinking about himself. Jördis is on cloud nine after Klaas’ declaration of love. Ceyda tries to bring her back down to earth - she shouldn’t put her own needs and the dream of her trip to Africa aside again. Amelie is deeply hurt by Jorik’s accusation that she is not interested in Henriette. It is only when Henni is burdened by the arguments that the two pull themselves together. But is that enough to save their family? Merle and Gunter return from Costa Rica accompanied by Pedro. He is the son of one of Gunter’s friends and wants to study law in Lüneburg. At least that’s what they think.

videos.title: Episode 4042
videos.overview: Amelie promises Jorik that she won’t take any risks with the hotel purchase. But then the seller puts pressure on him and Amelie decides - without Jorik’s knowledge - to take out a mortgage on the apartment. Jorik finds out about Amelie’s solo action and panics. In his fear for his existence, he tells Julius that the Askanier Park is for sale. Jördis and Klaas plan a motorcycle tour through Botswana together. When Valerie finds out about this, she begs Klaas not to put himself in danger for the sake of her child. Klaas convinces Jördis to switch to an off-road vehicle - he doesn’t want to put her in danger. Shortly afterwards, Jördis learns from Valerie the real reason for Klaas’ change of plan. Ben is unsure whether Lilly’s accusation that he only thinks about himself is justified. Franka encourages him and organizes a party for Lilly with him. And it is a complete success. While Gunter and Merle are already asleep, Pedro sneaks off the estate to party with Leyla, Simon and Marvin.

videos.title: Episode 4043
videos.overview: While Valerie is enjoying her triumph of having dissuaded Klaas from the motorcycle tour, Klaas realizes that she has manipulated him again. The situation seems hopeless to Jördis - Valerie will always stand between her and Klaas. Jorik realizes that he has stabbed Amelie in the back - he shouldn’t have told Julius about the sale of the Askanier Park. He asks Julius to keep the information to himself. But when Julius is forced to make an important financial decision for the «Drei Könige», he confides his knowledge to Gunter. Franka is concerned that Knut Petersen will sell the land for the city project to another interested party. But Ben senses an opportunity to help. Together with Marvin, he manages to bring Franka a step closer to the contract. Leyla wants to help Ceyda to have a romantic dinner with Björn. Marvin manages to get Amelie the table du chef at «Carlas». However, Pedro causes a lot of chaos.

videos.title: Episode 4044
videos.overview: Gunter thinks about buying the Askanier Park, which leads to arguments with Merle. He abandons the idea when he hears how much the building needs to be renovated. It is only when Gunter finds out that Amelie is interested in the dilapidated hotel that his interest returns. Gunter spontaneously decides to buy it. Klaas is shocked: Jördis is breaking up with him. Jördis tries bravely to deal with the pain of the breakup and continues to plan her trip to Africa. When she notices how Valerie is constantly courting Klaas, it hits her hard. The attic of the Rose House is finally habitable again - Ben and Louis can go back to their apartment. But saying goodbye to Franka is difficult for everyone. Marvin realizes that he cannot make his happiness dependent on a relationship. And in conversation with Ben, he slowly realizes why his relationships may have all gone wrong.

videos.title: Episode 4045
videos.overview: When Merle notices that Amelie is already recruiting staff from the «Three Kings» for her own hotel project, she supports Gunter’s decision to buy. Amelie has no idea about Gunter’s plans and already sees herself as the new hotel owner. After a dispute with Julius, she quits without further ado. But then Amelie learns that Gunter bought the Askanier Park right under her nose. Jördis is suffering - just like Klaas - from the separation. She finds comfort in her family and can forget her grief for a few hours. Strengthened, Jördis makes a decision: she asks Adam Szymanski if she can join his team and travel with him to the Okavango Delta. Franka cannot concentrate on her application documents for the city project because she misses Ben and Louis. She is all the more grateful when Ben wants to help her clear her head. When Simon is called to the farm to give birth to a sheep, Pedro has to spontaneously step in for him at the bar in «Carlas». Will that go well?

videos.title: Episode 4046
videos.overview: Franka is facing competition from a large company in the municipal tender for the garden project. Now she fears for her chances and makes a passionate plea for her project, which Marvin puts online. Shortly afterwards, she receives a rejection from the youth welfare office, which has become aware of the video. Does Franka have any time for a foster child alongside her work? Farmer Knut is back from the hospital and Simon is no longer needed on the farm. He negotiates with Gunter to work on Gut Flickenschild on a trial basis. But then Simon suddenly feels under the weather - the next MS attack? Amelie is deeply hurt because Gunter snatches the Askanier Park from under her nose. Her pride is hurt and she no longer wants to work in the hotel. Jorik, on the other hand, has a guilty conscience: he had betrayed Amelie’s plans to Julius. Valerie has a nightmare: Klaas reacts dismissively to her and their child. He can calm her down, but insists that she finds her own apartment.

videos.title: Episode 4047
videos.overview: Franka says goodbye to the idea of taking in a foster child with a heavy heart. Johanna makes her realize how much she means to Ben. Although Ben and Franka tell themselves that sex is a threat to their friendship, they cannot resist and kiss. Amelie does not want to accept that Gunter has snatched the Askanier Park away from her and demands that he make her the manager of the new hotel. Gunter refuses: Julius is to manage both hotels. When Jorik asks Julius to help Amelie, Julius is committed to taking over management together with Amelie. Jørdis prepares for Botswana. She practices with Ben’s motorcycle, has a breakdown and repairs it herself. Leyla is impressed and supports her mother. Jørdis learns of Leyla’s plan: she wants to become an emergency doctor. Simon is relieved: he is not having a new MS attack, but an allergy to horse hair. This means that he will no longer be able to work for Gunter in the future. But farmer Knut Petersen is looking for a shepherd.

videos.title: Episode 4048
videos.overview: Leyla notices that Valerie has two maternity passes - why? She immediately informs Klaas that Valerie has not only slept with him, but also with another man. Klaas is upset and confronts Valerie: Is he really the father of her child? Amelie accepts Julius’ offer to become manager of the «Drei Könige» hotel while Julius takes over the Askanier Park. Meanwhile, Jorik’s guilty conscience grows. And when Amelie thanks Jorik for her new job, Jorik can’t help himself and confesses to Amelie that he told Julius about her plans to buy the hotel. During the preparations for Africa, Jördis increasingly suffers from the unsympathetic Adam Szymanski. When he demands that Jördis cancel her shift at the hospital to prepare for the expedition, Jördis has had enough. Simon is determined to become a livestock farmer, and farmer Knut immediately arranges a suitable internship for him - as a shepherd on Pellworm.

videos.title: Episode 4049
videos.overview: Amelie is so hurt after Jorik’s betrayal that she refuses to talk to him. Jorik hopes that time will heal all wounds and Amelie will calm down again. But the opposite happens: Amelie gradually becomes aware of the extent of Jorik’s lie and breaks up with him. After Jördis tells Adam what she thinks, it becomes clear that he doesn’t want her on his team. But then Ceyda tells Adam what she thinks - he finally shows insight and apologizes for his behavior. Jördis’ dream of a trip to Botswana is within reach. Valerie fends off Klaas’ question about paternity. Of course he is the father. But then Julius finds her first maternity record. Valerie is forced to confess to Julius that Klaas is not the father of her child. After Pedro’s party trips are exposed, he sees himself on the plane back to his father. But Gunter and Merle show understanding and make it clear to him: If he doesn’t want to study law, then he shouldn’t do it.

videos.title: Episode 4050
videos.overview: Valerie hopes to be able to bind Klaas to her after all. But when Mo learns from Julius that Klaas is not the father of Valerie’s child, he puts Julius under moral pressure: he must not cover up his sister’s lie. And Leyla no longer believes Valerie either and is in the process of finding out the truth. Jorik is desperate after his separation from Amelie. When Amelie wants to kick him and Henriette out, however, his fighting spirit awakens - he will not allow Henni to suddenly have no home. Gunter and Merle help Pedro to stand up to his father and pursue his own goals. Pedro postpones the start of his studies by a year and goes on a trip to Europe. Gunter and Merle also question their current life situation - what should they do next? Julius and Mo plan Mo’s move into Julius’ apartment. They are looking forward to living together and are planning a little surprise for each other.

videos.title: Episode 4051
videos.overview: After Klaas finds out that he is not the father of Valerie’s child, he throws her out. Jørdis and Klaas don’t really know how to approach each other. In addition, Klaas doesn’t want to dissuade Jørdis from her journey. Only when Mo appeals to Klaas to fight for Jørdis does he approach her. But Jørdis is unsure: Even if Valerie is no longer standing between them - Klaas still wants a child? Jorik gets Amelie to continue to pretend to Henni that their relationship still exists. Amelie realizes that she has long since become a mother substitute for Henni. She realizes that the separation from Henni will be the real problem for her. Valerie has found shelter with Mo and Julius - a real test for the men’s relationship. At the same time, Elyas returns to Luneburg. He has been expelled because of the AI fraud. But Mo can’t be angry with him, because Elyas broke up with his girlfriend because she made derogatory comments about Mo.

videos.title: Episode 4052
videos.overview: Jorik and Amelie try to pretend to Henni that their relationship is fine. While the two pretend to be a happy family, Henni has long since realized that not everything is OK. She asks Amelie and Jorik not to split up. Valerie becomes aware of the extent of her paternity lie when even her siblings don’t want to help her. She feels lonely and mourns her old jet-set life. When she happens to come across an expensive necklace and a lot of cash while working in the hotel, she takes it - what else does she have to lose? Things are getting tense between Mo and Julius. Julius is absorbed in creating a home together and wants to spend as much time with Mo as possible. Mo, on the other hand, feels constrained by Julius. Julius is offended. Marvin shines in his midterm exam and risks being a big mouth with Amelie. Amelie then offers him a deal: she will treat him to a challenging workshop if he creates the perfect sauce in just 24 hours. Can Marvin do it?

videos.title: Episode 4053
videos.overview: The morning inspection of Yan Brenner’s boat by Julia and Paul comes to nothing. The Mafia drug courier, known to the police, had previously thrown the suitcase containing several kilos of cocaine overboard. The perfect starting capital to escape the looming boarding school and sheer boredom to Portugal, the two young people think when the suitcase washes up in front of their tent on the shore of Lake Constance. But they have not reckoned with Brenner, who is doing everything he can to get his drugs back. And Nele and her team also follow the trail of the young runaways Katja Hartmann and Marco Reichert, who want to sell the coke to the ex-dealer Chris. But the dream of escaping the drug world turns into a nightmare. Yan is ready for anything and is armed. And he knows where to look... Meanwhile, Jakob Frings is really getting sidelined by his landlady, Nele’s mother Mechthild. His constantly changing girlfriends have always been a thorn in Mechthild’s side.

videos.title: Episode 4054
videos.overview: While Julius looks after his sister, Mo decides to give his life a new direction - he will accept the job offer from perfume manufacturer Angelo Formani and go to Florence. Mo quietly and secretly says goodbye, hands the laundry over to Elyas and leaves. Julius is shocked when he finds Mo’s farewell letter. Ceyda is flattered by Björn’s marriage proposal. But when she finds out that Björn will lose his inheritance if he is not married, she briefly considers a marriage of convenience. Until she sees Björn also proposing to Johanna. Valerie is dependent on the support of her siblings and makes peace with Julius and Franka. For Julius it is clear that Valerie will move in with him and Mo first. Amelie tries everything to bind Jorik and Henni to Lüneburg. Jorik sees this as an opportunity for him and Amelie as a couple. When Amelie suggests that she should take custody of Henni - in case something should happen to Jorik - Jorik realizes: Amelie only cares about Henni.

videos.title: Episode 4055
videos.overview: Klaas asks Jördis whether he still wants children. Because Jördis will not grant him this wish. When Klaas sees how Jördis is blossoming in the preparations for their trip to Africa, he cannot resist her attraction and suddenly a kiss is in the air. Is there still a chance for Jördis and Klaas? Surprise successful: Britta is overjoyed when Hendrik suddenly stands in front of her. The longing was so great that he quit his job in Geneva to be with her and his family again. Julius is stunned: Mo has quietly and secretly gone to Florence. Jördis and his family are also surprised - no one would have believed Mo could do this. Julius feels betrayed. It was only through him that Mo was able to find himself and now he wants to live his life without him - a bitter realization. After many trials and tribulations, Ceyda is ready to marry Björn for a good cause. But Björn also wants to marry her for love. Then Ceyda gets cold feet.

videos.title: Episode 4056
videos.overview: Amelie accepts Jorik’s invitation to dinner. But when Jorik asks her for a second chance, Amelie becomes thoughtful. She remembers her very first meeting with him and that it all started with a lie. All the disappointment comes back and Amelie throws it in Jorik’s face that she should never have got involved with him. Valerie refuses to admit to Simon that he is the father of her child. So Leyla drives to Simon in Pellworm to tell him the truth. But Simon reacts dismissively and does not believe in paternity. Klaas separates from Jördis with a heavy heart in order to first clarify his desire to have children and not burden Jördis with it. But is a child really what Klaas wants? Julius is devastated because Mo has disappeared to Florence and wonders what he did wrong. Britta is looking for a new tenant for Jördis. And it happens quicker than expected: Jenny is standing at the door with Bella and Till and would love to move in immediately.

videos.title: Episode 4057
videos.overview: Klaas realises that it was only Valerie’s pregnancy that triggered his desire to have children. He still hasn’t gotten over the loss of his unborn daughter. But then he manages to put the subject of children behind him during a ritual. And he realises: he should never have let Jördis go. Jorik is hurt by Amelie’s harsh words and decides to go to Berlin with Henni. In his disappointment, he refuses to say goodbye to Amelie. But Henni doesn’t leave without saying goodbye. Sadly, Amelie then finds Wolfine in her apartment. Leyla can’t get through to Simon because he rejects any responsibility for Valerie’s child. Meanwhile, Valerie is in danger of sinking into her pregnancy blues. When she finds out about Leyla’s trip to Pellworm, she doesn’t like her interference at all. Britta isn’t convinced about Jenny as a new roommate. She says no to her. But then Jenny unintentionally manages to change Britta’s mind by running an online campaign to donate blood.

videos.title: Episode 4058
videos.overview: Julius is completely beside himself with lovesickness. This also affects his professionalism at work: because he doesn’t know how he is going to finance the renovation of the roof structure, he steals some of the golf tournament budget. When Amelie finds out, she has Julius in her hands. Klaas is determined to fight for Jördis. But for Jördis, the realization comes too late; she has finished with Klaas and wants to concentrate on her trip. Klaas is ready to accept her wish. But he makes one last attempt to confess his love to her. Jenny moves into the Rosenhaus with Bella and Till and is immediately visited by her best friend Svenja from Münster. Jenny has to go to her new job at short notice and godmother Svenja is happy to have some time with Bella and Till. Because the move means they won’t have much time together in the future. Britta is annoyed: the half marathon clashes with an important meeting at the hospital.

videos.title: Episode 4059
videos.overview: Klaas lets Jenny teach him magic because he wants to surprise Jördis with a big effect. With Leyla’s support, Klaas manages to make a magical declaration of love. How will Jördis react? Amelie feels sorry for Julius and the two are able to make peace at first, but it doesn’t last long: the two quickly clash again - which Jenny notices first and then Svenja, who is Julius’s childhood neighbor. The joy of seeing each other again is great, which leads Jenny to a spontaneous idea: Wouldn’t it be great if Svenja took over Amelie’s job at the «Three Kings» and moved to Lüneburg? Ceyda has decided to go back to Mettmann. She consistently refuses to accept Björn’s invitation to Cambridge. Only when Elyas finds Ceyda’s message in a bottle does he find out what is really holding her back and confronts her with her fears. But Ceyda takes refuge in excuses.

videos.title: Episode 4060
Episode 4061
videos.overview: Valerie makes it clear to Simon that he is not the father of her child. But Leyla does not believe it and convinces Simon to look into the matter. Does Julius perhaps know more? Julius holds up a mirror to Amelie: she is at a dead end both professionally and privately. Unfortunately, Amelie has to agree with him: she misses Henni terribly and feels lonely. Amelie no longer wants to be dependent on Julius professionally and makes a decision: she will quit. Jördis and Klaas want to make the time until Jördis leaves for Botswana as pleasant as possible and not think about the pain of saying goodbye yet. Because Klaas does not want to take away Jördis’ joy of her dream trip. Jenny rotates between the chaos of moving and the new job. Till is no help to her, he escapes into his gaming world. Jenny is annoyed, but Svenja advises her to take the pubescent teenager’s needs seriously. Thanks to Johanna, Svenja manages to get through to Till.

videos.title: Episode 4062
videos.overview: Jördis’ departure to Botswana is approaching and she realizes how much she will miss her familiar surroundings - especially Klaas. When the two spend their last evening together, Klaas plucks up the courage and asks Jördis if he can accompany her. After his professional sauce workshop in Strasbourg, Marvin feels called to greater things. Carla puts him in his place in a motherly way when he somewhat arrogantly questions her cooking skills. But Carla still respects Marvin’s ambitions and offers to send him to Paris - there he could continue his training at the highest level. Julius offers Svenja the position of co-managing director. Amelie now sees no future for herself at «Drei Könige». But Svenja makes it clear to Amelie how much she would like to work with her. Can she convince Amelie? Simon does not want to continue his training in Pellworm - he misses his friends too much. Can he still convince farmer Petersen to take him on as an apprentice?

videos.title: Episode 4063
videos.overview: Time for new beginnings: Marvin is determined to pass the cooking test in Paris and continue his training there. Therefore, he immediately terminates his contract at «Carlas». Encouraged by Marvin, Carla realizes that she wants to live her own dream. She listens to her heart and decides to go to Michael in Texas. Britta is impressed by Carla’s decision and she also realizes that she no longer wants to be exposed to the stress of being a clinic manager. She surprises Hendrik with the idea of opening a joint practice with him. Jørdis is overjoyed that Klaas wants to travel to Botswana with her. But that turns out to be more difficult than expected. They have to convince Adam Szymanski to take Klaas with them. And Klaas has to find a replacement for himself in the clinic at short notice. Bella can’t get Elyas out of her head. She is happy when he suddenly appears in front of her at «Carlas».

videos.title: Episode 4064
videos.overview: Till is bullied at school because he doesn’t know his father. Svenja doesn’t like the fact that Jenny continues to refuse to let her children meet their father, and the two get into an argument. But Jenny doesn’t want to reveal the name. Tina comes to Lüneburg to pick up Louis. While Ben is still thinking about how to tell Tina about his relationship with Franka, Lilly unknowingly spills the secret. Tina is shocked by this - does she still have feelings for Ben? Britta and Hendrik are planning to start their own business together and are looking for space for a shared practice. The feeling of departure inspires their love. And Carla is full of energy too, because she is looking forward to seeing her boyfriend Michael. The food truck is sold to the «Drei Könige» and the plane ticket to Texas is already booked. And Jördis and Klaas are ready to start their adventure together - the two happily set off for Africa. Only Amelie is unhappy.

videos.title: Episode 4065
videos.overview: Till demands the truth from Jenny: Who is his father? But Jenny remains silent. Only Hendrik can convince her to be open and honest with her children and not to spare them out of false consideration. Jenny overcomes herself and tells Bella and Till that she will tell them the truth. Britta is extremely excited before her half marathon. Hendrik is able to calm her down and the two say goodbye at the start. But then she doesn’t see him at the course as agreed. Because Hendrik offers to help Jenny, who has broken down with her car on the country road. Suddenly a car races towards them at excessive speed. Can they get to safety in time? Tina thinks she can deal with the relationship between Ben and Franka. But when she sees how close Louis is with Franka, she feels threatened as a «mother» and draws her conclusions. Simon has sublet his room in a shared flat and is in need of accommodation. Amelie has a room free, but she won’t give it up so easily.

videos.title: Episode 4066
videos.overview: Noah happens to pass the scene of the accident and gives Jenny and Hendrik first aid. Leyla then arrives in the ambulance and is overwhelmed, especially when she finds Jenny’s lucky charm bracelet on the side of the road... Britta and Svenja are informed and immediately rush to the hospital to see Hendrik and Jenny. While Hendrik escaped with a fracture, Jenny has to undergo emergency surgery. After the operation, she initially appears stable and reminds Svenja of her promise to look after Bella and Till if anything should happen to her. But then Jenny’s condition suddenly worsens... The first rumors start to circulate about Amelie and Simon’s «shared flat» that the two could be more than just roommates - which neither of them wants. Simon decides to move out when Amelie unexpectedly receives a call from Henni and collapses crying in Simon’s arms. The situation between Ben and Tina threatens to escalate.

videos.title: Episode 4067
videos.overview: Leyla is shocked: When she tries to give Jenny her lucky bracelet back, Jenny suffers a cardiac arrest. Noah fights for her life - without success. While Svenja and Bella say goodbye, Till cannot allow his grief. Svenja is determined to keep her promise to Jenny and take care of her children. Only in Julius’ arms does she realize that she does not feel up to the task. Amelie is beside herself with joy when Henni comes to visit. But Jorik only lets Henni stay overnight with Amelie if he can stay too. Amelie is overwhelmed and nervously claims that this is not possible because she is now in a relationship with Simon. To prove it, she simply kisses him. The situation between Tina, Ben and Franka relaxes. But the mood changes when Louis suddenly says «Mom» to Franka. How will Tina react? Britta and Hendrik move Sam’s birthday party to the estate - out of consideration for Jenny’s grieving family. Hendrik enjoys the celebration with his family.

videos.title: Episode 4068
videos.overview: Hendrik and Britta get the approval to set up a shared practice. Their lives are going perfectly. But while Britta is toasting the upcoming practice opening with friends, Hendrik collapses unconscious while taking a walk with Betty. Jorik quickly sees through Amelie’s spontaneous claim that she is now with Simon. But he misunderstands the situation and believes that Amelie still has feelings for him and therefore wants to keep him at a distance. Amelie is only interested in Henni. Svenja tries to find out whether she is ready to take responsibility for Till and Bella. And she quickly realizes that it will not be easy to win Bella and Till over. Tina is hurt after Louis calls Franka «Mama». But Franka manages to calm Tina down and the two talk things out. Tensions arise between Leyla and Noah in the shared apartment. Meanwhile, Elyas does not know how to support Bella in her grief. He is relieved when she takes a step towards him.

videos.title: Episode 4069
videos.overview: The unthinkable happens: Hendrik dies in the hospital. Britta is in shock. She says goodbye to Hendrik in a matter-of-fact way and throws herself into everyday activities to protect herself. Only when Svenja, who is still grieving for her best friend, shows her understanding can Britta let her tears flow freely. Julius is urgently looking for a carpenter for the Askanier Park. Then Valerie comes up with the idea of hiring Jorik. Julius is not averse and makes Jorik an attractive offer. Will Jorik accept it? Jorik and Simon are overwhelmed by Amelie’s demand that they settle the overnight question between themselves. Both want to back off voluntarily. But then Jorik confesses to Amelie the real reason why he absolutely wanted to stay overnight with her: he is still struggling with the separation. Svenja struggles with her promise to Jenny to look after Till and Bella. Till just plays games and Bella shuts down completely. Then Jenny appears to her in a daydream and encourages her.

videos.title: Episode 4070
videos.overview: Till is trapped in his grief and doesn’t want to let anyone get close to him - especially not Svenja. When he can’t stand it at home any longer, he just runs off and ends up with Simon on the goat farm. Simon takes him under his wing and has an idea how Till can say goodbye to his mother. Jorik and Julius have a deal: Jorik will renovate the roof of the Askanier Park for a small price and Julius will help him become independent. Meanwhile, Amelie learns of Hendrik’s death and lets Jorik console her in a moment of weakness. He immediately gives himself false hope... Britta and Svenja support each other in their shared grief. But that doesn’t change the fact that Britta feels guilty about Hendrik’s death. She tries to throw herself into work, but immediately clashes with Noah in the hospital. He is hurt by Britta’s unfair accusations, but tries not to let it show. But Amelie is there for Britta and can support her in her pain.

videos.title: Episode 4071
videos.overview: Britta is in denial mode and delegates everything to do with Hendrik’s funeral to Amelie and Ben. She herself is only concerned with taking over the practice. When she asks Carla for help to come from the USA, a misunderstanding arises: she thinks Carla doesn’t have time for her. Helpless, Britta becomes more and more unfair to her fellow human beings… until Carla suddenly stands in front of her. Noah predicts to Leyla that they will end up in bed - ridiculous, Leyla thinks. Until she realizes that she really likes him. She tries to make it clear to Noah in a matter-of-fact way that an affair between them as colleagues and roommates could be problematic. But the temptation is greater... Amelie and Jorik can finally talk things out and Jorik realizes that he wanted to bend Amelie too much to his ideas. When Franka gets a job offer from Munich, she is concerned about leaving Ben alone in his grief for Hendrik.

videos.title: Episode 4072
videos.overview: Before the funeral, Britta is overwhelmed by her grief. Only at the last moment does she manage to face the funeral. Ben’s spontaneously improvised eulogy catches her, but the farewell is harder than she thought. Till tries to block out the loss of his mother and has also kept her death a secret at school. When he needs a doctor’s note for the days he was absent, he steals Noah’s notepad. When Svenja finds out about this and wants to talk to Till, he is overwhelmed and tells her that he wishes she had died instead of his mother. When Valerie hears that a millionaire has checked into the hotel, she senses her chance. Jolina is annoyed and makes Valerie believe that Michael is the millionaire, which ends in an embarrassing misunderstanding. When Jolina is then asked to take care of the wealthy guest, Valerie goes crazy and locks Jolina in the cold storage room. Noah reacts unemotionally after having sex with Leyla, which upsets Leyla against her will.

videos.title: Episode 4073
videos.overview: Hendrik’s funeral awakens bad memories of Torben’s death in Amelie. She is happy to have Jorik by her side, who shows her how much she means to him. She feels supported by him and so the two have sex. Svenja is hurt by Till’s rigorous rejection, but decides to be there for him anyway. However, when Till is brought home drunk in broad daylight, Svenja is unsure whether she is up to her new tasks. Britta manages to say goodbye to Hendrik - with a touching speech at the funeral and at the place where Hendrik died. When Britta is afraid of being alone afterwards, she realizes: she is never alone in the rose house. Valerie continues to try to get close to the US millionaire Herwig Schiller. But he turns her down because of her pregnant belly. Valerie is humiliated. After her repeated misbehavior, Julius can no longer keep his little sister at the hotel and throws her out for good.

videos.title: Episode 4074
videos.overview: Before her appointment at the youth welfare office, Svenja wants to clarify with Bella and Till what their future might look like. It becomes clear that Till has felt neglected by her for a long time. Svenja is shocked - she hadn’t realized that. Nevertheless, she wants to take responsibility for the children. But do Bella and Till want that too? Shortly before Franka leaves for Munich, her temporary worker at the nursery falls ill. Tina offers to step in temporarily. But Valerie warns Franka: Tina has her eye on Ben. Is there anything to that? Amelie and Jorik’s tryst comes to an abrupt end when Simon and Henni suddenly appear in the bedroom. Shortly afterwards, half of Lüneburg mistakenly believes that the two are a couple again. Bella has to take her last oral exam via video. But the Rosenhaus has an internet problem. Leyla, Noah, but above all Elyas come to her aid and she passes the exam. Secretly, Elyas hopes that he has come one step closer to Bella in this way.

videos.title: Episode 4075
videos.overview: Bella is happy that Svenja wants to look after her and Till. Till, on the other hand, hopes that the youth welfare office can find her father. Bella doesn’t understand Till and the two get into a heated argument. After that, Till withdraws and Bella is very worried about her brother. Valerie unsettles Franka: Does Tina really want to win Ben back? Franka decides to trust Ben and asks Valerie not to spy on Tina any more while she is away. Will Valerie stick to this? Britta regrets that Carla and Michael have to leave again. But she is grateful to have Svenja and Amelie with her in Lüneburg. Amelie and Jorik feel as if the whole of Lüneburg is happy that they are a couple again. It goes so far that Johanna registers them for the election as «Heidepaar 2024». There is a spark between Leyla and Noah and the two try to play it down by having a little competition about whose job is more important. But the attraction is greater.

videos.title: Episode 4076
videos.overview: Svenja gets custody of Bella and Till from the youth welfare office, but offers them the opportunity to live alone. Everyone is happy until Bella has doubts: Is Till mature enough to take responsibility for himself? Till feels patronized by Bella. The situation escalates and Till wants to move in with his father. Britta meets a shirt-sleeved but charming man while jogging. For the first time since Hendrik’s death, she experiences a carefree moment and immediately feels guilty. When she meets the stranger again, a misunderstanding arises and Britta keeps her distance. Until Svenja introduces the man to her as her father, Heiner. Henni and Britta are thrilled that Amelie and Jorik are part of the Heide couple’s election. In order not to disappoint them, Amelie and Jorik decide to keep up appearances and let the matter run its course. Tina trains Valerie in the garden center and recognizes her talent for flower arranging - Valerie is surprised.

videos.title: Episode 4077
videos.overview: Mo unexpectedly turns up at Julius’ door and wants to talk. Overwhelmed, Julius throws him out, he doesn’t want to hear Mo’s attempts to explain. But Mo doesn’t let up and admits to Julius in an emotional exchange that leaving Julius was his biggest mistake. Valerie finds Tina more and more likeable and is convinced that Tina is no longer interested in Ben. Until Tina and Ben agree to have dinner together on their wedding day. Valerie’s mistrust flares up again and she tells Tina straight out that she still loves Ben. Tina feels caught out... Till has to accept that the search for his father is hopeless. Until Leyla tells him about Jenny’s last words: the emperor. Till is convinced that must be her father’s name - Bella finds that absurd. Heiner tries to clear up the misunderstandings between him and Britta, but only makes things worse. A dog that apparently doesn’t belong to anyone runs up to Elyas. Bella immediately falls in love with the dog and Elyas decides to keep him.

videos.title: Episode 4078
videos.overview: Bella is becoming too responsible for Till, but she doesn’t want to tell Svenja about it. To distract the children, Svenja takes them to a gig of her former band «Girl Front». They finally have fun together. But Till skips school the next day and continues to focus on finding his father. Bella, overwhelmed, asks Svenja to move in with them in the Rosenhaus. Noah and Simon make Leyla aware of different ways in which she could be admitted to medical school even with a bad numerus clausus. Julius cannot accept Mo’s apology. The hurt is too deep. Mo tries to accept it. But the more Mo and Julius try to avoid each other, the more often they bump into each other unintentionally. After an evening together with Ben, Tina realizes that Valerie is right - she still has feelings for Ben. Could Ben feel the same? But then she hears how in love Ben is on the phone with Franka. There is no room for her here anymore.

videos.title: Episode 4079
videos.overview: Amelie and Jorik start the election campaign for the «Heather Couple of the Year» for Britta and Henni’s sake - without being a couple. Amelie is in competition mode and hopes to get lots of sympathy points by taking a photo with Henni. But Jorik is opposed: no photo of Henni on the internet. Amelie gives in. Shortly afterwards, a photo of Henni appears on the internet and Jorik is seething with anger. Leyla is considering following Noah’s idea and studying medicine in Hungary. Mo doesn’t think that’s the right path for her. And the more Noah talks about money and success, the clearer Leyla sees and suddenly knows what she wants. Svenja tells Bella that she will move into the rose house and look after Till. But he is looking for his father again and is skipping school. When Svenja finds out, Till is honest with her and the two become closer. Valerie tells Ben about her suspicion that Tina wants him back.

videos.title: Episode 4080
videos.overview: Mo’s company from Florence checks in for a seminar at the «Drei Könige». Julius tries to handle the situation professionally. But then he and Mo get stuck in the elevator and Julius’ suppressed disappointment breaks out of him: Mo should disappear from his life forever. Svenja invites them to dinner at the Rosenhaus - but everyone except Simon cancels. The two spend an evening together. Elyas suspects that Simon has fallen in love with Svenja. Simon denies this, he just finds her interesting. Jorik and Amelie become more and more entangled in lies due to the election as Couple of the Year. They decide to tell Henni and Britta the truth and withdraw their candidacy. But they don’t manage it. Lilly is afraid that the person who caused the accident will get away with it. Britta tries to calm her down, but admits to Heiner that she has the same fear. He advises her not to brood over things, but to distract herself with work. Britta returns to the clinic and is greeted soberly by Noah.

videos.title: Episode 4081
videos.overview: Julius is uncomfortable with his emotional outburst in the elevator. And Mo has to accept that Julius no longer wants to have contact with him. Mo is all the more surprised when Julius takes over the supervision of his fragrance workshop in the hotel. Svenja feels that she cannot do justice to Bella, Till or her job in the hotel. She confides in Heiner that she feels overwhelmed in her role as a surrogate mother. Heiner then decides to move to Lüneburg to be with his daughter. Amelie is determined to win the Heath Couple of the Year competition. She wants to use the prize money to help Britta build the wheelchair skate park in memory of Hendrik. So she gains access to the competition tasks and urges Jorik on energetically. Britta believes she is on the trail of the driver who caused the accident when a suspicious patient disappears in the hospital. Noah warns not to suspect anyone too quickly and is right: the patient was involved in another accident.

videos.title: Episode 4082
videos.overview: The preparations for the selection of the heather couple become a challenge for Jorik and Amelie. First they are handcuffed to each other, then they have to recite their vows of love to Johanna. Amelie surprises them with an emotional speech. Svenja drives to Münster with Bella and Heiner takes care of Till in the meantime. Things are going rather poorly, because Heiner tries to lure Till away from the computer. But he won’t listen to him. Britta believes that she is coping better with her grief every day. Lilly has a different opinion of her mother. After a failed dare, she has to be treated in the emergency room and asks Noah not to tell Britta about it. She doesn’t want to burden her mother with it. Julius sets rules for Mo’s fragrance workshop: they meet on a purely professional level, private matters are ignored. Mo agrees, even if it is difficult for him.

videos.title: Episode 4083
videos.overview: Britta becomes suspicious when Noah refuses to say why the police are questioning him about the accident again. What is he hiding from her? She searches Noah’s room and finds photos of his car - which has since been sold.
