And everything fits: the color and model are identical to the car that was involved in the accident and the car has accident damage. Britta believes that Noah caused the accident and confronts him with the accusation. Mo is fascinated by the goat farm and wants to move his fragrance workshop there. When he and Julius take a tour of the site, a close moment develops between the two. Till flees from the argument with Heiner to the goat farm. There he realizes that Simon has his eye on Svenja. While Simon manages to arrange a date with Svenja, Till reconciles with Heiner and consoles Bella. She is upset because of a sensational newspaper article about the accident. On the evening of the Heidepaar competition, Amelie and Jorik see their chances of winning dwindle.

videos.title: Episode 4084
videos.overview: Noah can’t believe that Britta is accusing him of causing the accident. Britta is determined to convict Noah and in doing so she oversteps boundaries - she snoops into Noah’s past and calls his former colleagues. Noah then threatens to report her. Amelie and Jorik give it their all in the «Heidepaar» competition and, to their own surprise, win. In the euphoria of victory, they can’t help but sink into a kiss. Julius tries in vain to suppress his resurgent feelings for Mo. Mo feels the same way and so the two continue to be very distant. Only when Julius understands how hurtful his behavior towards Mo is does he take a step towards him. But when Mo starts to apologize, he is interrupted by an important phone call. Elyas and Bella take the dog Hermine to farmer Petersen’s farm and grow closer in the process. There could be a kiss between Svenja and Simon - if it weren’t for Svenja’s common sense.

videos.title: Episode 4085
videos.overview: Mo enthusiastically tells Julius about his Italian colleague Riccardo. When a misdirected text message goes to Julius instead of Riccardo, Julius becomes jealous and believes that something is going on between Mo and Riccardo. But when Mo makes it clear that he will never love anyone but Julius, Julius is speechless. After their victory as a «heathen couple», Jorik is perplexed to realize that he and Amelie must continue to pretend to be a couple - for advertising appearances and for Britta. Because Amelie cannot bring herself to tell her sister the truth. Jorik is all the more surprised when Amelie honestly suggests trying again as a couple. Heiner offers Britta to look for evidence of Noah’s innocence with her at the accident site. Britta does not know whether this is good for her. She is repeatedly overcome by her grief, which Heiner finds worrying. Elyas believes that the dog Hermione is being sought by her owner. In order not to worry Bella, he doesn’t tell her about it.

videos.title: Episode 4086
videos.overview: Amelie and Jorik try to rekindle their feelings, which is not so easy alongside the prestigious appointments as a «heathen couple». While Jorik continues to believe in a future together, Amelie has doubts. Svenja meets the attractive Arthur through a mishap. When they run into each other a second time, Svenja agrees to a bet: if they meet by chance for a third time, Svenja has to give Arthur her number. In the laundry, Arthur gets a tip from Elyas about where he can meet the beautiful stranger, apparently by chance. Svenja sees through the trickery and demands something in return. Britta is looking forward to Sam and Joe’s visit, but at the same time is afraid that a meeting so soon after Hendrik’s death could be too stressful. But it is good for everyone to be together again. Julius confesses to Valerie how difficult it is for him to withdraw from Mo. In the end, he cannot overcome his fear and jealously attacks Mo because of his colleague Riccardo.

videos.title: Episode 4087
videos.overview: Arthur tries in vain to persuade Svenja to go on a date. Only when he helps her out of a professional emergency and offers his services as a spice sommelier does Svenja give in. The flirtation becomes more intense and the two end up in Arthur’s bed. Julius confesses to Mo that he still has feelings for him, but can no longer trust him. He needs time with Mo to build up trust again. So Mo tries to persuade his employer to stay in Lüneburg longer. Jorik doesn’t want to accept that Amelie no longer wants to be with him. He would love to show Henni that he and Amelie are the perfect couple - even without the «heather couple» title. But Jorik also has to painfully accept that his feelings for Amelie are no longer enough for a relationship. Just when Britta thinks she has gotten over the worst of her grief, a delayed package from Hendrik arrives. The grief and pain catch up with her again. When Britta can’t stand it anymore, she tries to take refuge in work.

videos.title: Episode 4088
videos.overview: Britta clashes with Noah again in the hospital. She thinks he almost gave a patient the wrong medication. When Heiner finds out that Britta has given Noah time off, he suspects that Britta is not seeing things clearly because of her grief. Britta thinks Heiner is intrusive and tells him to move out of the Rose House immediately. Svenja is inspired after having sex with Arthur, but keeps it to herself. Arthur, meanwhile, is interested in the orphans left by the accident. He runs into Till at his school - without knowing who Till is. When Arthur asks him about the orphans, Till avoids the question. Valerie wants to have a mommy makeover after the birth. However, this is very expensive and her attempts to get money fail. Elyas plans to turn the laundry into a singles exchange. He wants to attract new customers with «Wash, wait and Date». Bella helps him with the transformation and Elyas falls more and more in love with Bella.

videos.title: Episode 4089
videos.overview: Valerie doesn’t want Julius to get involved with Mo again. She schemes to prevent the two from meeting and accuses Mo of having a relationship with his mentor. Mo can’t believe that Julius is falling for Valerie’s lie and wants to know from Julius who he believes more: him or Valerie? Svenja is shocked when she finds out that Till is being bullied at school. Till doesn’t think it’s that bad, after all he had help: Arthur. Bella is critical of this, what does the guy want from Till? Svenja, on the other hand, has no idea that she is having an affair with Till’s rescuer of all people. And Till is gaining more and more trust in Arthur. He admits to him that he and Bella are the children who lost their mother in the accident. Arthur realizes: he has found his children. Heiner realizes that he can’t patronize Britta like that. He apologizes to her and Britta agrees that Heiner can stay in the rose house. Jorik and Henni say goodbye to Amelie and Lüneburg with a heavy heart.

videos.title: Episode 4090
videos.overview: Bella becomes increasingly suspicious of why Till spends so much time with Arthur. She decides to disrupt a meeting between the two. But Svenja unknowingly gets there first. Arthur realises that Svenja, of all people, is his son’s godmother. Finally overwhelmed, Arthur wants to leave Lüneburg, but is confronted by Till, Bella and Svenja and confesses: He is Arthur Kaiser, Till and Bella’s father. Julius does not want to choose between his sister and Mo. He senses Valerie’s genuine despair over the unwanted pregnancy and knows that he has to be there for her now. Mo does not have to keep fighting for him - Julius’ trust in Mo is destroyed. They no longer have a chance. Ben is annoyed by Heiner’s tendency towards chaos. When Ben vents his anger to Valerie, he has no idea that Heiner is listening to everything. Amelie wants to help Britta out of her grief and convinces her to take a break with Inken and Nicos on Corfu. Britta agrees, but has one condition.

videos.title: Episode 4091
videos.overview: After Arthur comes out as Bella and Till’s father, Bella withdraws. Till, on the other hand, tries to talk to his father, who is also overwhelmed. Svenja immediately suppresses her feelings for Arthur. Not only out of contempt for his previous behavior, but also to protect Bella and Till. But Arthur has fallen in love with Svenja and wants to fight for her. Heiner is hurt because Ben thinks he is a powerless pensioner. Johanna tries in vain to reconcile the two quarrelers. And so one blames the other for repairing Johanna’s broken faucet. Elyas is looking for a new tenant for Simon’s old shared room. It’s a good thing that Svenja’s half-sister Toni wants to move to Lüneburg and is looking for a room. Noah isn’t happy. But maybe Noah finds Toni more likeable than he admits. When Mo no longer fights for Julius’s love, Julius tries not to lose contact with Mo and clings to the shared fragrance concept for the hotel.

videos.title: Episode 4092
videos.overview: Julius is torn between his feelings for Mo. Is he developing the fragrance concept just to be near Mo? When Mo presents his latest creation, Julius listens to his gut feeling and kisses Mo. Svenja turns Arthur down - he should rather take care of his children. Nevertheless, Arthur tries to persuade Svenja to meet up, also to explain himself. But Svenja doesn’t want to hear anything. Instead, she arranges to meet Simon. But then she has to take care of the distraught Till. Arthur realizes that he is no help to anyone and should leave Lüneburg. But Till needs him right now. The tussle between Ben and Heiner reaches a new high point when Johanna’s kitchen is flooded. The men decide to avoid each other - and involuntarily meet again. Toni and Noah’s mutual sympathy leads them straight to Noah’s bed. The next morning, both are relieved that they only kissed. But is there nothing more?

videos.title: Episode 4093
videos.overview: After their night together, Toni and Noah realise that they are colleagues. But the two take it easy. Until Toni hears that Noah is suspected of being the driver who fled the scene of the accident. Toni becomes skeptical and Noah behaves increasingly suspiciously. When Toni lays flowers for Jenny at the scene of the accident, she meets Noah - who is looking for something. Toni wants clarity and asks Noah directly: Is he the driver? Did he kill Jenny? Bella is suffering from the pressure of the exam and the family situation with Arthur. Her heart feels a little lighter when she and Elyas decide to adopt dog Hermine together. When Bella admits how important Elyas is to her, they kiss. The presentation of the Three Kings fragrance flops. Things are getting tight for Mo professionally. And privately, he also has to fear that he has gambled away the chance of a relationship with Julius. Till does everything he can to get to know his father Arthur better.

videos.title: Episode 4094
videos.overview: Svenja urges Julius to be professional when looking for the right hotel scent - she doesn’t want to leave the project to Mo alone, but puts it out to tender. Mo is stunned and, in his disappointment, accuses Julius of wanting to destroy his career. Julius is offended. Noah is hurt that Toni suspects him of being the driver of the accident and leaves her without an answer. Together with Heiner, Toni searches the scene of the accident for evidence and they find it. Heiner is now clear that Noah is guilty and he hands the evidence over to the police. Toni, on the other hand, still has doubts. But when the «Heideecho» publicly pillories Noah, Noah wants to flee the city. When Arthur accidentally interrupts Svenja’s date with Simon, she makes a clear statement to him: Arthur should stay out of her life beyond looking after Till and Bella. Bella and Elyas finally confess their feelings for each other after their failed kiss.

videos.title: Episode 4095
videos.overview: Till skips school because he is being bullied again. Arthur solves the problem pragmatically and gives Till’s classmates money. Svenja thinks that’s impossible - as always, Arthur can only solve the problems with money. Till, on the other hand, is delighted. He realizes that his father has supported the family financially before. But when Arthur confesses to Till that he only wanted to buy himself out of his responsibility, he is bitterly disappointed in his father. Toni tells Noah how she herself was wrongly suspected of a crime in the past and is thus able to prevent him from fleeing. He is grateful for Toni’s support. But when the public prosecutor actually charges him with hit-and-run resulting in death, Noah doesn’t know what to do. Ben and Heiner become fiercely competitive for the title of best neighbor in the house. It is only through the intervention of Johanna and Lilly that the two squabblers realize that they actually like each other.

videos.title: Episode 4096
videos.overview: Toni is determined to tell Noah that she and Heiner handed Noah’s charging case from the scene of the accident over to the police. But before she can do that, the police are at the door to continue taking evidence against Noah. Toni is there for him. Noah is grateful until he finds out by chance that Toni and Heiner made him the main suspect in the first place. Arthur wants to explain to Till and Bella why he bought himself out of his responsibility as a father back then. But they don’t want to listen to him because the hurt is too deep. Arthur doesn’t believe that his relationship with his children can still be saved and decides to go to New York for work. But Svenja makes it clear to him that he doesn’t have to come back if he doesn’t fight for his children now. Will Arthur stay? Angelo Formani assures Mo that the company will continue to support Mo and his talent. Inspired by the feeling of success, Mo also demands that Julius decide what will happen next between them both.

videos.title: Episode 4097
videos.overview: Shock for Julius and Valerie: Noah examines Julius’ blood at the blood donation drive and finds a discrepancy. According to the blood group determination, Julius and Valerie cannot possibly be siblings. Arthur has an idea how Till can assert himself among his classmates. He should challenge them to a gaming duel. Heiner passes the suggestion on to Till and indeed: Till wins and gains respect. When he learns that the duel was Arthur’s idea, Till is not happy. Toni regrets that she reported Noah to the police because she has long believed him to be innocent. She tries to make amends by protecting Noah from a patient. But Noah doesn’t want any help from Toni. A misunderstanding arises between Bella and Elyas: Bella’s good high school grades make Elyas ashamed of his unfinished studies and avoids her. That’s why Bella thinks that Elyas might not be interested in her after all.

videos.title: Episode 4098
videos.overview: Till and Arthur slowly grow closer. In an emotional conversation, Arthur talks about the death of his father and that his fear of commitment is the result of the early loss. Svenja overhears and is about to fall in love with Arthur. Valerie and Julius do not understand why they have different blood types. While Valerie does not want to pursue the question any further, Julius invites her mother Gisela to get to the bottom of the mystery. Hermine escapes Bella from Bio Mertens. Elyas and Heiner help to search for the dog. Bella - who should actually be studying - searches all night. It is not until the next morning that Hermine turns up: she was locked in the food truck. Bella can finally concentrate on her final exam. Julius suggests that Mo should drop out of the hotel fragrance competition. He is a jury member and fears that he will not be able to represent the hotel’s interests objectively.

videos.title: Episode 4099
videos.overview: Gisela can only laugh at Valerie and Julius’ assumption that they might not be siblings. She is also not prepared to contact the twins’ father, but she can only be persuaded to have her blood group determined: she has group zero. For Valerie and Julius there is only one explanation for Valerie’s different blood group: Hans is not their father. Did Gisela cheat? Toni learns that a wildlife camera in farmer Knut’s forest recorded the accident. She is able to convince Noah to look for the camera with her. But they find nothing and Noah takes out his frustration on Toni. Svenja tries to control her feelings for Arthur. Meanwhile, Arthur and Till spend father-son quality time together. When Arthur wants to cook for the whole family, Svenja is overwhelmed: How should she deal with Arthur’s proximity? Mo wins the fragrance content and is commissioned to equip Gunter’s hotels with his fragrance concept. He immediately tries to talk to Julius. But he blocks him.

videos.title: Episode 4100
videos.overview: Gisela is hurt when Julius and Valerie suspect that she had cheated on them, and is even able to refute the suspicion with an old paternity test. The siblings apologize to their mother and Julius asks their father for proof of his blood type. But the result is not as expected. Gisela can only find one explanation: Valerie was switched at birth. Arthur and Svenja get closer through Svenja’s favorite music. But when Arthur wants to give her a mixtape, the closeness becomes too much for Svenja. She rejects him and tells him clearly that she doesn’t want any gifts or any flirting attempts from him. Bella wants to look for a job before she starts her studies and Elyas offers her to work in the laundry - so that she can spend as much time with her as possible. Mrs. Krause is not at all enthusiastic about this... Toni demands an apology from Noah for his unacceptable behavior. It takes a while for Noah to realize what he has in Toni, and he finally apologizes to her.

videos.title: Episode 4101
videos.overview: Mo has received a job offer from Paris, but doesn’t find the opportunity to tell Julius. It’s only when the two meet at the lake and Mo narrowly saves Julius from drowning that old feelings surface - Julius and Mo end up in bed. Mo finally tells them about his offer, but makes it clear: he’ll give up Paris if Julius comes back to him. Elyas organizes his date night in the laundry to acquire customers. But he has forgotten a large order. Bella helps him and the event can go ahead as planned. Everything goes well until Elyas notices that the money has disappeared from the till. The suspicion that she might have been switched as a baby in the hospital takes the rug out from under Valerie’s feet. When Noah also confirms that babies were indeed switched from time to time in the past, Valerie’s suspicion becomes more and more likely. Britta, Carla and Amelie receive a male visitor from Heiner on their girls’ night out. He wants to repair Carla’s faucet.

videos.title: Episode 4102
videos.overview: Julius gives way to Mos question about a future together. His fear of loss and distrust are just too big. Only a dream makes Julius clear: he doesn’t want to lose Mo. Julius confesses Mo his love - he wants to be with him, no matter where. Valerie is still faced with the question of whether she was swapped as a baby. Gisela is trying to support her pregnant daughter. She even suggests moving to Lneburg. Valerie is torn back and forth and wants a DNA test: she wants to know whether Gisela is her mother at all. Elyas reacts when Bella explains that he had taken the money to secure it from possible theft. He apologizes to Bella with a guilty conscience and brings her to an idea of how she can get Till - who seems to be more and more under the influence of Arthur -: she has to become a gamer. Britta believes that he has observed a flirt between Carla and Heiner. Isn’t something wrong with the relationship between Carla and Michael?

videos.title: Episode 4103
videos.overview: While Julius and Mo plan their future, Valerie feels left behind by Julius. The question of whether she was switched as a baby still bothers her. Gisela is shocked when Heiner tells her about a one-night stand they had after a carnival party. She can’t remember it for the life of her. She was always faithful to her ex-husband Hans. The result of the genetic test literally knocks Gisela over: she is Valerie’s mother, but Hans is not the father. At Bella’s shared apartment gaming party, there is a scandal: Till thinks Noah is the person who caused the accident and is responsible for his mother’s death and attacks him. But things get even worse for Noah: his car - the only proof of his innocence - has been scrapped. Arthur labels Amelie as a hobby artist. Until it becomes clear that Amelie is the daughter of the famous painter Jakob Fährmann. As an apology, Arthur invites her to eat burgers. Amelie accepts - but sets one condition.

videos.title: Episode 4104
videos.overview: After the fight between Noah and Till at the shared flat party, Toni convinces an angry Noah to talk to Till. At first it seems as if Noah’s words are getting through to Till. But chat buddy Marcel continues to incite Till against Noah. When Till is sitting behind the wheel of Arthur’s car in preparation for a driving lesson and Noah crosses the street, Till steps on the accelerator. Gisela realizes: Heiner is Valerie’s father. But since the two don’t particularly like each other, Gisela only tells her daughter that she has a different father than Julius - but she doesn’t say who. Valerie is shocked. Mo and Julius are toying with the idea of moving to Paris. But what do they do with Valerie? Mo decides to turn down Paris and work for Formani in Lneburg in the future. Julius is happy. Carla has a cooking block and refuses to develop new burgers for the food truck - much to Amelie’s annoyance. But Arthur unintentionally reawakens Carla’s passion for cooking.

videos.title: Episode 4105
videos.overview: Arthur prevents Till from running over Noah at the last second and is slightly injured in the process. Arthur claims to Svenja that he was driving, which Till later refutes by telling him about the driving lessons. Svenja is not happy. Arthur, on the other hand, reveals to Svenja that the accident was the first time he felt what it was like to take responsibility for his son. Carla has developed new sauces for the food truck and invites Heiner to the farm as a taster. The two immediately start a wine tasting and Carla unsuspectingly eats Heiner’s hash biscuits. The next morning, Carla does not remember how the evening ended. Only that Heiner spent the night with her. Then Michael unexpectedly appears at the door... Shocked, Noah assumes that Till wanted to run him over with his car. But Arthur says the car was malfunctioning and takes sole responsibility for the accident. Valerie does not let up and wants to know from her mother who her father is. Gisela flees.

videos.title: Episode 4106
videos.overview: Noah decides to forget about the accident with Till - it really does seem to have been an accident. But Noah continues to feel threatened by Till. In the hospital, he suddenly thinks he sees Till in front of him. Confused, he lets Toni distract him until Till appears to him again. Elyas has neither luck in love nor luck in business: he doesn’t know where he stands with Bella, and the first night of partying in the laundry is a disaster. While Bella tries to cheer Elyas up with a little flirtation, Elyas honestly admits to her that he has fallen in love with her. Arthur has developed real fatherly feelings and wants to be there for his children in the future. He spontaneously decides to get an apartment in Lüneburg and sensitively persuades Svenja that they should look after Till together. Carla has a blackout - she can’t explain to Michael why Heiner spent the night at her half-naked. She tries to play it down, but has to admit that she flirted with Heiner.

videos.title: Episode 4107
videos.overview: Noah tries to downplay his hallucinations about Till. But Britta notices that Noah is not feeling well and lets him go. But when Till approaches him again at a chance meeting, he feels increasingly threatened. Shortly afterwards, Till is unexpectedly arrested by the police. He is charged with attempted grievous bodily harm. After Elyas’ declaration of love, he and Bella end up in love in the shared flat. Until Elyas wants to end the evening with her in his room. That goes too fast for Bella and she says goodbye abruptly. Has Elyas lost his luck? Valerie demands that Julius help her unconditionally in the search for her father. Valerie’s brazen behavior is almost unbearable for Mo and he asks Julius to make his priorities clear to her. With a heavy heart, Julius tells his sister to stop disturbing his life. After Michael humorously realizes that Carla had nothing to do with Heiner, he lovingly supports her in her concern for the food truck.

videos.title: Episode 4108
videos.overview: Svenja accompanies Till to the police station. Meanwhile, Toni finds out that Noah has reported Till. Till does well during questioning and Arthur organizes a lawyer. Svenja is grateful that she can rely on Arthur and is hopeful that everything will be fine. But then the youth welfare office suddenly appears at the door. Gunter has invited David to Lüneburg: He wants to move his life to Costa Rica for good and give the estate to David. At first David refuses, but Gunter does not give up. Carla and Michael compete against Mo and Julius in the «heather couple» competition. Carla thinks it’s fun, but Michael has more in mind. Valerie punishes Julius by withdrawing her love and asks Simon to accompany her to an ultrasound scan. She is worried because she can’t feel her baby moving and wants to have it checked out. While Simon strokes her belly, the child moves. For the first time, Simon has the feeling that he could become a father after all.

videos.title: Episode 4109
videos.overview: The fronts are hardened between Valerie and Julius. Mo tries to mediate and Valerie takes a step towards her brother. The ice seems to have been broken until Julius puts his foot in his mouth again. Valerie feels rejected by him again and demands a temporary sibling break. Gunter is happy: David wants to take over the estate and turn it into a restaurant. Franziska, however, is less enthusiastic about the plans. Svenja, Arthur, Bella and Till fear that Svenja could lose custody after Noah files a complaint against Till. Arthur asks his lawyer for support and at the same time tries to convince Noah to withdraw the complaint. Without success. Bella is impressed by how her father is putting in the effort. Noah is troubled by his visions of Till. Nevertheless, he acts carefree and refuses psychological help. However, when he attacks a young person because he mistakenly thinks he is Till, Noah realizes that he cannot go on like this.

videos.title: Episode 4110
videos.overview: Till’s appointment for the psychological assessment goes surprisingly well. The whole family is gathered in the allotment garden when the positive call from the lawyer comes: Svenja will retain custody of Till. All tension falls away from Svenja and she kisses Arthur. Carla is disappointed to discover that Michael only traveled to Germany to promote the western village. Not because of her. Valerie is shocked when Julius keeps her contact break. Simon looks after Valerie and is able to distract her successfully. The two have a relaxed moment and suddenly Valerie confesses to the surprised Simon that he could well be the father of her baby… David does not want to take over the estate without Franzi’s consent and tells his father no. Gunter is deeply disappointed in David. Amelie rediscovers her love of art and wants to benefit from Arthur’s contacts in the art scene. She invites him in a good mood to accompany her to an exhibition opening. But is she really only interested in the art?

videos.title: Episode 4111
videos.overview: Bella meets Victoria on the estate, who is selling Gunter’s property as a real estate agent. After some initial difficulties, the two discover more and more things in common. Shortly afterwards, it becomes clear what the reason for this could be: Victoria is Arthur’s mother and therefore Bella’s grandmother. Simon is frustrated: Valerie simply won’t give him an answer as to whether he is the father of her child. Only when Valerie’s fear of giving birth increases does she show up at Simon’s again. However, only to ask him for money for a Caesarean section. After Svenja abruptly breaks off the kiss with Arthur, Arthur struggles with whether he should continue to fight for Svenja. The memories of Jenny prevent Svenja from pursuing her feelings. Arthur realizes that Svenja needs time. Michael is just able to convince Carla not to give up on her participation in the «Heidepaar» competition.

videos.title: Episode 4112
videos.overview: Carla tries to find out why she is no longer happy with Michael. Is it because she never really found a home in Texas? Michael also realizes how serious the situation is. After they have to admit defeat to Mo and Julius in the final of the «Heidepaar» competition, Michael takes the opportunity and gets down on his knees in front of Carla. Victoria has to come to terms with the fact that Arthur has kept her grandchildren Bella and Till a secret from her for years. She immediately has a connection with Bella, but the first meeting between Victoria and Till does not go well. Arthur then clearly tells his mother to leave his family alone. Bella has a learning block while preparing for the veterinary medicine test. But a short walk with Elyas and Hermine works wonders - suddenly she can recall her knowledge again. Neither Julius nor Simon are on good terms with Valerie. She realizes that she should take a step towards both of them, but to no avail - both men remain cool.

videos.title: Episode 4113
Episode 4114
videos.overview: Noah is relieved: the charge of negligent homicide against him is dropped. Till is beside himself. He continues to search for evidence against Noah and finds the wildlife camera. But the recording is sobering and Till is frustrated to realize that Noah cannot have been the driver who caused the accident. Arthur warns Bella and Svenja about his mother - Victoria is dangerous, she never acts selflessly. But it is only when Victoria tries to get information about Gunter through Svenja that Svenja feels manipulated and has to agree with Arthur. Gunter wants to sell his property and has hired Victoria as a real estate agent. But the two don’t really get along. But when Victoria finds out from Amelie what makes Gunter tick, she approaches him. Julius and Valerie have reconciled and Julius insists on financing Valerie’s Caesarean section. Mo fears that Julius is letting his sister take over too much again. Until he realizes how lonely Valerie is.

videos.title: Episode 4115
videos.overview: Mo and Julius surprise Valerie with a baby shower. When Simon turns up and approaches her in a conciliatory manner, Valerie becomes thoughtful. With Franzi’s encouragement, she decides to finally be honest with Simon about his paternity. But on the way to him, Valerie collapses. Noah is extremely upset after another encounter with Till. Toni is able to calm him down and tell him the liberating news that Till himself has found the proof of Noah’s innocence. All tension falls away from Noah. Nevertheless, he does not want to withdraw his complaint against Till - Toni is stunned. Till is thrown off course by the realization that he may never find the real culprit. Svenja and Arthur want to be there for him together more than ever. Franzi finds out that her sister Mia is pregnant - which spurs her to immediately put her own family plans with David into action. But the two cannot find peace and quiet for each other.

videos.title: Episode 4116
videos.overview: Simon and Julius take the collapsed Valerie to the hospital. Fortunately, the all-clear is given straight away: mother and child have survived the circulatory collapse unscathed. Valerie is only bothered by the severe heartburn - Britta gives her some medication for this. But she is distracted by her grief over Hendrik and makes a serious mistake. Valerie decides to finally tell Simon that he is the father - but again she doesn’t get around to it. The contractions start and the amniotic sac breaks. Valerie panics. Victoria offers Bella a summer job at her company EmKa. Despite Arthur’s warning, Bella accepts the offer. When Victoria admits to Arthur what plans she has for Bella, Arthur tells his mother: she should stay away from his children. Noah reacts violently when he discovers cannabis plants in the shared apartment. Toni wants to teach him a lesson and lets him believe that they are her plants.

videos.title: Episode 4117
videos.overview: Simon is nervously told that Valerie is in labor much too early. Will he miss the birth of his child? But everything goes well. Simon immediately looks for possible similarities in the newborn, but finds none. But then Valerie, half asleep, surprisingly reveals: Simon is the father. Bella gets a strange feeling when Svenja is a little too excited about spending an evening with Arthur. Bella also has the feeling that Toni and Svenja are keeping secrets from her. Upset, she asks Svenja if there is something going on between her and Arthur. Gunter and Victoria find a good level with each other. Victoria wonders why he is trying so hard for her. Could there be more to it than just business interests? Elyas does everything he can to make the atmosphere in the shared flat more relaxed. Are Noah and Toni moving with him?

videos.title: Episode 4118
videos.overview: Victoria tries to drive a wedge between Arthur and his children. To get Till on her side, she gives him an expensive laptop. But Arthur asks Till not to let himself be bought and to return the device. But Victoria also uses this situation to her advantage and tells Till about a delicate passage in her will, which makes Arthur look very bad. Svenja confesses to Bella about her one-night stand with Arthur. Bella feels betrayed and keeps her distance. Svenja’s renewed attempt to talk things out also goes wrong: Bella accuses her of only wanting to take Jenny’s place. The new father Simon wonders what role he should play in the little girl’s life. He doesn’t want to impose himself... But then Valerie asks him to help find a name and Simon is overjoyed and hopeful. Valerie’s joy is limited when Gisela unexpectedly appears in the doorway to greet her granddaughter. She reproaches Gisela and finally wants to know who her father is.

videos.title: Episode 4119
videos.overview: Gunter wonders: Why is Victoria so interested in the Flickenschild family history? When she then summons Gunter to her suite, he is afraid of the next flirting offensive. But Victoria has no intention of seducing Gunter. She has found out that she and Gunter are related. Noah and Toni’s argument about the cannabis plants escalates at Elyas’ party in the laundromat. But when Noah later apologizes to Toni in the shared apartment, his anger erupts and the two end up in bed. Victoria’s intrigue is successful: Till and Bella believe that Arthur is only using his contact with them to get his mother’s money. When even Svenja begins to have doubts, Arthur is deeply disappointed. Valerie is suffering from the fact that she cannot breastfeed. She is also annoyed by her mother, who continues to hide her father’s name from her. Thanks to Simon, Gisela and Valerie become closer again - and together the three find a name for the child: Olivia.

videos.title: Episode 4120
videos.overview: Sam needs a video of Hendrik for a school project. Now Britta is overwhelmed by her grief. But when she watches a video of Hendrik, she is also overcome with gratitude - for the time she spent with Hendrik. But then she suddenly realizes that she gave Valerie the wrong medication, which caused the premature birth. Gunter is stunned: Victoria is supposed to be Emilia Flickenschild’s daughter? But according to the family chronicle, she died in 1943. He thinks Victoria is a liar and cuts off his business relationship with her. But Victoria swears that she will prove her mother’s Flickenschild origins. Svenja and Arthur are unable to reconcile due to misunderstandings. Both agree that everything between them was a mistake. Disappointed, Arthur travels to Berlin and leaves it open whether he will return. Toni and Noah have sex for the first time and enjoy it. But Noah is overwhelmed by Toni’s spontaneity. He needs clear rules.

videos.title: Episode 4121
videos.overview: Gisela tries to support Valerie as best she can in her new role as a mother. The secret that Heiner is Valerie’s father weighs heavily on her. When Heiner reveals how much he wants to be a grandfather, Gisela’s guilty conscience grows. Should she tell him the truth? Britta doesn’t know how to deal with the realization that she is responsible for Valerie’s premature birth. She decides on a compromise: She takes time off work but keeps quiet about her mistake. Only when Valerie believes she is responsible for the premature birth can Britta no longer remain silent. Victoria makes it clear to Gunter: She will investigate the injustice that the Flickenschilds have done to her mother and provides the overwhelmed Gunter with direct proof - a photo showing her mother Emilia with Gunter’s father and the Flickenschild family. Svenja is disappointed and hurt that Arthur has fled to Berlin. Toni worries about her sister and consults the stars for her.

videos.title: Episode 4122
videos.overview: Victoria is convinced that Emilia Flickenschild, who was declared dead, is her mother. Gunter gives Victoria a box in which his grandmother kept memories to investigate. To Victoria’s disappointment, there is no evidence inside. Until a second bottom opens up. Valerie threatens Britta with legal action and hopes for compensation. However, there is little chance of success - she and the baby are fine. When Simon explains this to her, Valerie relents. Britta is relieved and looking forward to her time off. But Noah doesn’t want to let Britta go; he needs her in the hospital. Gisela receives news that her apartment in Frankfurt is being evicted. Because she doesn’t want to burden her children with her financial problems, she travels to Frankfurt without notice. Valerie and Julius are irritated. Arthur returns from Berlin disillusioned. His gallery isn’t doing well, and he’s not making any progress in his personal life either.

videos.title: Episode 4123
videos.overview: Arthur and Amelie get along brilliantly. Amelie is also impressed by Arthur’s cooking skills and promptly hires him as a temporary chef at «Carla’s.» When he runs into Amelie in the staff room afterward, the two can no longer contain their passion... Victoria has confirmation: her mother, Emilia, was a patchwork chef. Gunter also shows insight and wants to correct the family chronicle. Victoria is happy and immediately agrees when Gunter asks her to take over the sale of the estate. Bella is also overjoyed: she has been accepted to study veterinary medicine. Victoria is less enthusiastic, as she sees Bella’s future in the EmKa (EmK). So Victoria doesn’t hesitate for long and talks Bella out of her dream of owning her own veterinary practice. Noah is in a crisis: He can’t find a diagnosis for Mrs. Krause’s symptoms, and Britta advises him to show more team spirit. Noah feels insulted and gradually realizes that he can’t solve all his problems alone.

videos.title: Episode 4124
videos.overview: Victoria wants Bella in the company and puts pressure on her granddaughter. Svenja confronts Victoria when Bella expresses doubts about her studies. But Victoria makes it seem as if Svenja doesn’t recognize Bella’s potential. When Arthur hears about this, he urges Svenja to influence Bella. While Bella is no longer sure what she wants, Victoria seizes the opportunity and makes her an offer: a year as a trainee at the EmKa - after which she can choose between the company or her studies. Will Bella accept? Toni is annoyed because Noah is celebrating Ms. Krause’s diagnosis, even though she was also involved in it. She’s not the only one who feels this way: Noah’s behavior is also causing controversy among his colleagues. But when Toni sees how Noah is suffering from the situation in the hospital, she feels sorry for him. Heiner wears noise-cancelling headphones during Britta’s cello practice. Is he trying to provoke her? Britta is unsettled. A joint mushroom picking trip lifts the mood.

videos.title: Episode 4125
videos.overview: Britta and Heiner bond in a humorous way. They laugh together when Heiner spontaneously fills in for Corinna at the grocery store. Britta regains a sense of ease and manages to play a proper piece on the cello for the first time. When Heiner sees her doing this, he has a magical moment. Victoria skillfully manages to win Bella over. Their shared concern for Bella certainly brings Svenja and Arthur closer together. But this only makes Bella feel more strongly that Arthur is turning Svenja against Victoria. Toni pours her heart out to Mo about Noah. Mo mediates between the two. Noah overcomes his fear, apologizes to Toni, and speaks openly about his past. Gisela returns from Frankfurt after being evicted from her apartment and wants to move in with Valerie. Ostensibly to help her daughter with the baby. The real reason, however, is that she no longer has a place to live. Will Valerie agree to this?

videos.title: Episode 4126
videos.overview: Arthur and Svenja are worried that Noah’s trial is frightening Till. Arthur tries to talk to Till, but is distracted by Amelie and a potential buyer for his gallery. Till has the impression that Arthur is only interested in his work. But the opposite is true. How can Arthur prove this to his son? Gisela has moved in with Valerie and is helping her care for Olivia. Nevertheless, Valerie feels confined and longs for peace and quiet. Simon offers to take care of Olivia while Valerie spends the afternoon at the spa. Everyone is happy until Simon finds Olivia’s birth certificate. Heiner has fallen in love with Britta. So he ignores his knee problems and goes hiking with Britta. He overdoes it, and Britta finds him in severe pain the next day. Embarrassed, Heiner has to admit that he has overdone it. While working with Victoria, Bella realizes that her grandmother doesn’t tolerate backtalk.

videos.title: Episode 4127
videos.overview: While the estate’s sale is being prepared, Bella explains the estate’s history and significance to Victoria. Victoria realizes that the property must stay in the family. She decides to buy the property herself and move in. Gunter likes the idea, and Victoria ushers in a new era at Flickenschild Estate. Heiner tries to relieve his knee pain with cannabis. Britta, curious, is tempted to smoke a joint with Heiner. They almost get caught when Ben and Lilly return from vacation, and Lilly is surprised by Britta’s strangely foolish behavior. Arthur invites Till to come to Berlin with him, but by the time Till can get over his fear, Arthur is already on his way. Then his chat buddy Marcel threatens him, and he feels lonelier than ever. Simon tries to convince Valerie to be listed as the father on Olivia’s birth certificate. And Valerie suddenly becomes unusually insightful.

videos.title: Episode 4128
videos.overview: Victoria wants to continue a family tradition with Bella for her 18th birthday: Shortly after midnight, the eldest daughter will be presented with a medallion. But Bella already has plans - she’s celebrating her birthday with Elyas. Victoria tries to prevent that. Svenja and Arthur are worried that Victoria’s planned birthday ceremony will put too much pressure on Bella. They’re also planning something for Bella themselves. But Bella doesn’t want to see Arthur on her birthday. While Valerie and Simon fill out the application for paternity acknowledgment, it becomes clear how much Simon will be able to influence Olivia’s life, and thus Valerie’s life, in the future. Valerie hesitates to submit the application. When Gisela finds out, Valerie implores her mother to keep the secret. Ben learns by chance that Franka has been in Japan for weeks - without having told him. It becomes painfully clear to both of them that a long-distance relationship doesn’t work. Franka and Ben break up.

videos.title: Episode 4129
videos.overview: Gisela is offended because her daughters are keeping so many secrets from her. When Heiner makes it clear to her that she’s also been hiding a lot, Gisela feels pressure because her biggest secret concerns Heiner himself. After an argument with Heiner, she’s touched by how hard he cares about her and breaks her silence under the weight of his lies. Gisela blurts out the truth: Valerie is Heiner’s daughter. Through Valerie and Olivia, Julius realizes how much he wants a child. Mo reacts very understandingly. But Mo also has a heartfelt wish: He wants to return to Florence. Does this fit together? Svenja and Arthur grow closer through caring for Bella and Till. Inevitably, feelings arise, something Svenja initially doesn’t want to admit. Victoria gives Elyas a job at the laundry to keep him away from Bella’s birthday party. But Elyas doesn’t give up so easily and wants to impress Victoria.

videos.title: Episode 4130
videos.overview: Heiner is shocked: He’s Valerie’s father. Gisela begs him not to tell Valerie. But Heiner behaves so strangely towards Valerie that she asks him what’s going on. Will Heiner be honest? Victoria is planning to have the pond on the estate filled in. Gunter is horrified - the bench by the pond was Dörte’s favorite spot. Victoria doesn’t care. Only when Gunter threatens to back out of the sale does Victoria relent. Although Till confesses his guilt in court, Noah continues to feel uneasy. Only when Till apologizes to Noah can Noah find peace. Svenja and Arthur fear that Till will not be able to avoid a prison sentence. Arthur organizes a place for Till on Anette’s Second Chance boat. Everyone is relieved - and Till wants to start work immediately. Mo really wants to go to a company event in Florence, but is hesitant because of Julius. Julius would love to go, but he has to work. So Svenja takes over the hotel for the time being and Mo and Julius leave.

videos.title: Episode 4131
videos.overview: Gisela meets Victoria at the lake: All her belongings have been stolen, and she’s standing helplessly on the shore. Gisela helps her, and Victoria invites her to dinner as a thank you. Only then does Gisela realize that Victoria is a very wealthy woman. The two get along brilliantly. When Gisela tells her about her debts, Victoria promptly offers to pay off her new friend’s debts. Gisela is perplexed. Arthur single-handedly buys a large quantity of fish for «Carlas.» When the fish arrives, the head chef’s enthusiasm is limited, and a conflict ensues. Amelie, who continues to flirt with Arthur, takes his side. Only Svenja, as the hotel manager, has no choice but to tell Arthur off. Toni and Noah clash over the topic of astrology. Noah believes in conventional medicine and not in alternative methods. Until Britta makes him think... Simon is angry: Valerie posts photos of Olivia online without first discussing it with him - as the father.

videos.title: Episode 4132
videos.overview: After Svenja’s reprimand, Arthur doesn’t show up for work the next day. Svenja is disappointed by his irresponsibility. Arthur just wants to get rid of all the fish and sells it at the town festival. Svenja is impressed by his creativity, and the two drift into a flirtation that, contrary to Svenja’s intentions, ends in a kiss. Gisela’s honor is insulted when Victoria condescendingly offers to pay off her debts. Victoria wants to apologize, but immediately puts her foot in it. Gisela is furious and insults Victoria with rich-woman clichés. An argument ensues, and the new friendship seems to be over. Heiner tries to get closer to Britta over a romantic movie night. But to his disappointment, Britta simply falls asleep. On Toni’s advice, Heiner makes another attempt to win Britta’s heart: this time with an action film. Will it be to Britta’s taste?

videos.title: Episode 4133
videos.overview: After her kiss with Arthur, Svenja feels guilty: The father of her godchildren and she are a couple? Nevertheless, when Arthur invites her to a picnic, Svenja agrees. But shortly before, Arthur also realizes the consequences of a relationship with Svenja. He backs out and doesn’t come to the picnic. Svenja is deeply disappointed. Victoria offers Bella the chance to move to the estate with her. At the same time, she tries to bribe Elyas to take care of Hermine alone so that Bella has enough time for her trainee program. When Bella and Elyas discover Victoria’s attempts at manipulation, Bella makes a clever announcement to Victoria. Britta discovers her love of fishing on a fishing trip with Lilly and Heiner. Heiner’s heart races, and he enthusiastically suggests that Britta hike the Way of St. James together. However, this is completely overwhelming. Amelie has forgotten to plan the town festival. But Gunter has an idea: dance classes with René Siegel. Amelie is not very enthusiastic.

videos.title: Episode 4134
videos.overview: Gisela is coming under increasing pressure: Not only Simon, but also Valerie learns that Gisela has moved to Lüneburg. Valerie doesn’t like it at all. Gisela tearfully confesses to her daughter: Her apartment has been evicted. René radiates his good mood in Lüneburg. Only Ben is annoyed. He had to take the dance teacher in and now has to constantly listen to his flowery ravings about his true love. Until René, in a quiet moment, admits that, despite his good mood, he has serious self-doubt. Svenja is sad and disappointed by Arthur’s withdrawal. But she tries to cover up her pain with reason. Arthur asks her to remain friends, and Svenja finally agrees - for the sake of the children. In a dance with René, she can give free rein to her feelings. For Elyas, the argument between Toni and Noah becomes unbearable. Every attempt to reconcile the two fails. Until Noah finally takes a step towards Toni.

videos.title: Episode 4135
videos.overview: Amelie and Svenja work together respectfully at the hotel. Meanwhile, Amelie and Arthur grow closer. Arthur feels a conflict of conscience. He wants to be honest and tells Svenja about himself and Amelie. Svenja is deeply disappointed. René doubts he can remain a traveling dance teacher permanently. When Ben offers to take over the nursery, René has a vision: He wants to turn it into a dance school. What does Gunter think? Valerie is completely overwhelmed: Her mother is broke and homeless. She quickly shirks responsibility for Gisela. But Heiner is able to make it clear to Valerie that Gisela needs her family’s support now. Valerie talks to Gisela and is relieved to learn that her mother has a new job - as a housekeeper for Victoria. Noah surprises Toni with his dancing skills and his sensitive nature. But the romance doesn’t last long, and Noah gives Toni the cold shoulder again. But she doesn’t let that go.

videos.title: Episode 4136
videos.overview: Amelie learns about Svenja’s past with Arthur and is concerned that their good working relationship at the hotel is in jeopardy. Although Svenja assures her otherwise, Amelie senses that Svenja is tormented by Arthur more than she lets on. So she decides to end the affair. Valerie unexpectedly takes over Franka’s apartment. But how is she supposed to pay the rent without a steady income? Gisela intervenes without being asked - but successfully. She finds Valerie a job with Victoria, who urgently needs someone to oversee the renovation of the property for her. Ben and Gunter want to prevent René from turning the nursery into a dance school. As the new tenant, he has every right to use the building for his own purposes. Ben can’t talk René out of his plans, but Gunter has one last saving thought. Heiner realizes how deep his feelings for Britta already are, and he wants to keep his distance. But when Britta invites him to a concert, he abandons his good intentions and, in love, accepts.

videos.title: Episode 4137
videos.overview: Bella and Elyas give Hermione a new rubber toy for passing her dog training test. Unfortunately, it ends up in the laundry dryer and causes a small fire. Luckily, they have liability insurance. But then Bella realizes: The letter to the insurance company wasn’t stamped. Elyas is in serious financial trouble. Amelie remains determined to put her affair with Arthur on hold. Nevertheless, she secretly regrets it. Svenja suspects this and urges Amelie not to be too considerate and to indulge in the affair with Arthur. Amelie is perplexed by Svenja’s selflessness. Valerie is immediately put to the test in her new job. She makes herself unpopular with the tradesmen and fears failure. But then she unexpectedly earns respect. Heiner and Britta try hash cookies together. Intoxicated, Heiner’s feelings overcome him and he confesses his love to Britta. Once sobered up, he realizes what he said. Does Britta still remember?

videos.title: Episode 4138
videos.overview: Noah realizes how good Toni is for him, and he cooks for her. But the surprise backfires: Toni invites René to the shared apartment. Noah is annoyed - he didn’t want a date for three. After René leaves, a romantic mood develops. The head chef at «Carla’s» is absent, and Arthur is in charge of the kitchen. Things are going great, and Arthur is in his element. He’s so impressed that he asks Svenja to give him the head chef position. But Svenja refuses - she doesn’t trust him for the job. Elyas is at his wits’ end - he needs a new dryer, which he can’t afford. Bella blames herself for the dryer fire and asks Victoria to help Elyas out of his financial predicament. Elyas accepts Victoria’s money with a bad feeling. Through his contacts in the «Gentlemen’s Club,» Gunter helps Victoria obtain a permit to avoid historic preservation during the renovation of the property. Victoria is impressed and wants to join the old white men’s club. Can Gunter help her?

videos.title: Episode 4139
videos.overview: When Valerie clashes with Victoria, Gisela tries to mediate and asks Victoria for understanding. Gisela confides in her about Valerie’s knack for rich, older men. Victoria doesn’t hesitate to humiliate Valerie with this in their next argument. Valerie is shocked and draws her conclusions. Arthur experiences a completely new, relaxed side of Amelie with Henriette. He encourages her to explore this beyond Henriette’s visits. Amelie realizes that her ambition has stifled her lightheartedness and decides to reclaim her old attitude to life. René wants to hold a dance class at the Rosenhaus. This is too much for Ben - he kicks René out. But with a few remaining tickets for the sold-out concert of Lilly’s favorite band, René is able to reclaim his place at the Bergers’. Ben just can’t get rid of René. Noah has fallen in love with Toni, but doesn’t want to admit it. Emotions overwhelm him, he panics and flees.

videos.title: Episode 4140
videos.overview: Elyas takes Victoria’s money but wants to sign a contract as security for the repayment. Bella thinks this is excessive, because he can trust Victoria. But then she is forced to abandon her positive opinion of Victoria when she mercilessly fires an employee. Gisela takes care of Olivia while Valerie organizes the renovation of the estate. But when Gisela gives her granddaughter a pacifier without asking, a fight breaks out between mother and daughter. Gisela, disappointed, packs her bags. Heiner, in love, offers to accompany Britta on a hike. Svenja cancels at short notice but shows up anyway, leaving Heiner feeling like a third wheel. Amelie lobbys Svenja to get Arthur a trial head chef. The «Heideecho» (Heide Echo) makes a scandalous story out of it. But Arthur knows how to help himself: He invites everyone to a test meal. Amelie isn’t thrilled with Arthur’s solo venture. Only when the venture is a complete success does she celebrate with Arthur.

videos.title: Episode 4141
videos.overview: Noah returns from Berlin in a good mood. But when it comes to sex with Toni, he can’t perform as usual. What’s going on? Is Elyas right and Noah still has feelings for Toni? Noah doesn’t want to hear about it and throws himself into his scientific work. When he presents the results to Britta, she amusedly points out that he mentioned Toni in it. Were his suppressed feelings playing a trick on him? Ben wonders if Tina wants to return to Lüneburg permanently? But before he can find out, René stirs up trouble in the attic again - Tina insists that he live with them and not alone in the nursery. Ben doesn’t like this at all. Lara believes she has found Valerie’s biological father in an old friend of Gisela’s. She resolutely searches for evidence. After an argument, Bella and Elyas realize that a harmonious relationship requires a lot of openness and understanding. In love, the two promise each other to try.

videos.title: Episode 4142
videos.overview: Ben and Tina want to prevent René from turning the nursery into a dance school. With a ruse, they manage to dissuade René from his business idea. Gunter is relieved that the nursery is being preserved. Ben and Tina celebrate themselves as a dream team. Until the divorce papers arrive. Noah is overwhelmed by his feelings for Toni. Before a date with Toni, he backs out at the last minute and asks Simon to go forest bathing for him. But then he gets jealous. Lara tries to find out whether Juan is really Valerie’s father with a secret DNA test. To get Juan’s hair undisturbed, she triggers a fire alarm in the hotel - and succeeds. Simon is less than enthusiastic about the stunt. Heiner’s climate activist gene awakens when Britta advocates for sustainable fruit shopping. He persuades Britta to take part in a protest in front of BioMertens. The two chain themselves to a shopping cart until Amelie makes it clear to them that they have gone astray.

videos.title: Episode 4143
videos.overview: Victoria doesn’t recognize Bella’s commitment to the company, which offends her. When Victoria then gets the feeling that Elyas might lure Bella away from her, she offers him a lot of money if he leaves Bella and Lüneburg forever. Britta has an erotic dream about Heiner and herself. Completely taken aback, she blocks out any closeness to him and, overwhelmed, turns down his birthday invitation. Noah can’t bear the thought of Simon and Toni forest bathing together. So he decides to join them - in swim shorts and flip-flops. Toni and Simon can’t help but laugh at the misunderstanding, and Noah stands there embarrassed. Ben and Tina uneasily prepare the papers for their divorce. But when René suspects that the relationship only broke down because Tina went to Andalusia, Ben denies it. On the contrary: In retrospect, he’s proud of Tina’s own path. Tina is touched.

videos.title: Episode 4144
videos.overview: Lara is waiting for the results of the DNA test and wants to prevent Juan from leaving before Valerie returns. Gisela is irritated by Lara’s strong interest in Juan. Is their marriage not working out? When the test result comes back negative, Simon comforts Lara. The two become more than close. Elyas rejects Victoria’s attempt at bribery: He won’t part with Bella for any amount of money. But when Elyas is offered an attractive future prospect for which he needs money, he starts to think again. Arthur and Amelie’s reconciliation is exposed. While Svenja doesn’t let her hurt show, Victoria is taken with the connection. Finally, a woman to her heart’s content. The responsibility for the hotel is becoming too much for Gunter. He longs for a carefree life with Merle in Costa Rica. Then Victoria offers to buy his hotel. Britta wants to keep Heiner at a distance and tries to convince him to move into the garden shed. Svenja and Heiner are irritated.

videos.title: Episode 4145
videos.overview: When Elyas tells Bella about Victoria’s scheming offer, Bella questions their relationship. But Elyas fights for Bella’s love and sets a trap for Victoria so that Bella can see her grandmother’s true, evil face. Simon and Lara limit their flirtation to a kiss. Even though Simon could have imagined more, the two part as relaxed friends. Gisela and Valerie talk it out. Valerie seems to have made peace with never meeting her father. However, another secret causes problems: Simon wants to take parental leave. But Valerie never applied for his paternity at the authorities. Gunter can’t bring himself to sell the «Three Kings» to Victoria. But Victoria is certain: Eventually, she’ll have him ready, and then she can usher in the new Kaiser era with the estate and hotel. Julius is back from vacation and is irritated: Why is Svenja playing the drums in the hotel lobby? Svenja and Amelie are at a loss for an explanation.

videos.title: Episode 4146
videos.overview: Despite Victoria’s intrigue, Bella wants to continue working for the EmKa (EmKa) - but keep her distance from her grandmother. But Bella realizes: Victoria won’t change. So she decides to abandon her training and resigns. Simon waits impatiently for the paternity certificate. Gisela and Lara manage to stop him from asking the authorities. But finally, the lie is exposed, and Simon is shocked to discover that Valerie never sent the documents. Julius is against Svenja and Amelie’s planned Heide Rock Night. The two women continue with their plan anyway and label Julius a bore. When the concert seems to be a success, Julius becomes thoughtful: Is he really that boring? Britta keeps having erotic daydreams about Heiner, which she suppresses. Amelie advises her to remain friendly with Heiner. At the same time, Amelie takes care of Britta’s obvious needs: She has a sex toy sent to her.

videos.title: Episode 4147
videos.overview: Arthur persuades Amelie to show her paintings to a gallery friend. Unfortunately, the gallery owner doesn’t share Arthur’s positive opinion - Amelie’s world falls apart. Her self-doubts surface, and in her despair, Amelie destroys her art. Heiner is overjoyed: Britta has come for his birthday after all. And not only that, she has organized a surprise party for him with Svenja. Only the joint gift causes confusion... Although Simon is deeply hurt, Valerie persists: she doesn’t want to register him as the father. Lara persuades her to take a step towards Simon, but that’s not enough for Simon. Either he is officially Olivia’s father, or he doesn’t exist in her life at all. Bella gets her resignation from Victoria and turns away from her grandmother, both professionally and personally. Victoria is stunned that Bella rebels against her and rejects her successor. While Victoria finds comfort in Gisela, Elyas is at Bella’s side.

videos.title: Episode 4148
videos.overview: Valerie is under pressure: She can’t find a plumber for the estate renovation, and time is running out. Heiner steps in and is touched when Valerie warmly thanks him. Overwhelmed by his emotions, Heiner blurts out: He’s her father. Tina and Ben drive to Wendland with Louis. Astrid plans to sell the farm, and Tina wants to pick up her personal belongings. Childhood memories flood back to Tina, and she realizes she feels much more at home in Germany than in Andalusia. Tina spontaneously decides to stay in Lüneburg. Amelie is frustrated; she never wants to paint again and wants to concentrate solely on her career at the hotel. When Victoria praises Amelie for her job at the hotel, her self-confidence returns. However, she wants to keep her affair with Arthur a secret. But suddenly Victoria is standing in front of them - has she noticed the closeness between the two? Britta feels exposed: Amelie has told the entire birthday party about her erotic dreams.

videos.title: Episode 4149
videos.overview: Ben supports Tina in her decision to stay in Lüneburg - they’re still a good team. Or even more than that? As Tina and Ben are stressed out trying to get to the «Heide-Rock-Nacht» on time, tensions flare between the two. Victoria can’t accept that Bella doesn’t want anything to do with her anymore. Gisela advises her to apologize to Bella. But Victoria can’t overcome her fear and offers Bella a stay in New York instead. Can Bella resist? Valerie can’t believe it - Heiner is her father. She accuses Gisela of lying to her for so long. Svenja and Toni are also taken aback by the news of having a «new» sister. Svenja and Julius argue incessantly during the preparations for the «Heide-Rock-Nacht.» Only to realize at the end that the concert is a success and they make a good team.

videos.title: Episode 4150
videos.overview: Amelie and Arthur want to keep their affair to themselves until Victoria catches them in the act. Although both insist that their liaison is nothing serious, Victoria hatches a plan. She makes Amelie an offer: If she marries Arthur, she’ll give them the hotel as a gift. Noah finally wants to confess his feelings to Toni. The timing is bad, though - Toni is on the phone and isn’t really listening to Noah. Meanwhile, she learns on the phone that Noah always has to work night shifts with him, and she’s angry. Bella rejects Victoria’s offer - an internship in New York. However, she becomes unsure when Victoria sincerely apologizes to her and Elyas for her intrigue. Svenja is able to encourage Bella to accept Victoria’s apology and not ruin her future. So Bella takes a step closer to Victoria and travels to New York. Feelings are developing between Tina and Ben again. Will they still go ahead with the planned divorce?

videos.title: Episode 4151
videos.overview: Valerie is in a bind: She needs a babysitter for Olivia. But Simon refuses to step in without acknowledging paternity, and Valerie doesn’t want to accept help from Heiner. Julius tries to smooth things over, but Valerie manages to anger both men again. Noah fears losing Toni. Elyas persuades him to write a love letter, giving him his old letters as a template. Meanwhile, Toni is chatting with a mysterious admirer. When Elyas overhears a quote from the chat, he realizes with shock: The stranger is Noah-and he’s using Elyas’s words. Arthur and Svenja plan a welcome dinner for Till. For his sake, Arthur also invites Victoria. But when he learns that she has offered Amelie the job of hotel manager if she marries her son, he summarily throws her out. Angrily, he tells her to stay out of his life. Tina wants to buy her sister’s Wendland farm. But without a regular income, she lacks creditworthiness.

videos.title: Episode 4152
videos.overview: Britta is bitten by a snake while hiking with Heiner. Although the bite is harmless, Heiner becomes overly concerned for her. Britta increasingly feels his affection and asks him directly if he’s in love with her. Amelie initially assures Arthur that she’s not interested in Victoria’s offer to give them the hotel. But when Amelie clashes with Julius again in the hotel and he threatens her with a warning, Victoria’s offer becomes increasingly attractive. After an argument with Julius, Valerie realizes in a conversation with Victoria how important family is. Valerie then apologizes to both Simon and Heiner. Eventually, she is able to reconcile with Julius - he keeps his promise and takes care of Olivia. Noah is so distraught that he offers Elyas money to be allowed to quote from Toni’s love letters in a chat. The quotes are well received, and Toni asks the stranger for a meeting. Will Noah reveal his identity?

videos.title: Episode 4153
videos.overview: Greta is finding it increasingly difficult to make a decision about her pregnancy. Yvonne isn’t letting her get close either, so she picks up the phone and calls Miro. When he suddenly appears in front of Greta, she stumbles. Erik photographs the dossier with dollar signs in his eyes, because the material has the potential to reverse the entire «Fürstenhof» sale. He slyly presents the pictures to the Saalfelds and Schwarzbachs and makes a demand: originals in exchange for «Fürstenhof» shares. The date for the referendum is set, and Henry tries to convince Maxi and Larissa to run a fair election campaign. Maxi and Lale release a video showing a landscape painted on cardboard that is being ruined by a large factory. They comment on everything with pithy remarks, which Henry secretly finds amusing, but Larissa finds rather unfair. Katja is taken by surprise by Markus’s early return, and the question of whether she should tell him about her affair leaves her despairing.

videos.title: Episode 4154
videos.overview: Britta believes she can’t reciprocate Heiner’s feelings. Or secretly, does she? When she injures herself in a bicycle accident, Heiner lovingly cares for her injured foot. Britta can no longer suppress her burgeoning emotions and kisses him. Valerie sees her opportunity: Victoria gives her primary responsibility for renovating the estate. But the growing stress overwhelms Valerie, especially when Olivia starts coughing. Eventually, Valerie has to cancel an important meeting with Victoria. Will she be jeopardizing her career opportunities? But at that moment, Valerie doesn’t care about them, because Olivia is having difficulty breathing. While Svenja and Mika work together to support Till, an unexpected closeness develops between them. Has Svenja fallen in love with Mika? It’s just a shame that he’ll have to return to Hamburg soon. With Lilly’s support, Tina is finding more and more people interested in her ceramics classes.

videos.title: Episode 4155
videos.overview: Tina is overcome by intense daydreams of happy times with Ben. So much so that she desperately confesses to Simon: She no longer knows how she feels about Ben, but one thing is certain - she doesn’t want a divorce. Meanwhile, Svenja spontaneously offers Mika a seat on her sofa that evening. But why did he disappear again the next morning? Fortunately, the misunderstanding is quickly cleared up, and the two enjoy a carefree afternoon. Svenja is certain: she wants to see Mika again. Heiner is on cloud nine after the night with Britta, but for her, it was just a one-time adventure. Without any great emotion, she wants to leave it at that and is relieved that Heiner apparently sees it the same way. Valerie is touched by how lovingly Julius supports her with Olivia. Julius’s old desire to have children is reawakened. But amidst all the uncertainty, Mo has some good news - he doesn’t have to return to Florence.

videos.title: Episode 4156
videos.overview: The fight between Julius and Simon over Olivia escalates. Valerie, on the other hand, enjoys having the two babysitters work for her. When Simon plans to take Olivia with him for a short trip to London, the situation escalates. Julius demands that Simon stay away from Olivia. Tina increasingly realizes that she doesn’t actually want to divorce Ben. She hopes Ben feels the same way, but doesn’t dare to confront him about it. When Tina thinks she can finally talk openly with him, she learns that he wants to celebrate their divorce with a big party. Victoria wants to pick up some personal belongings from Hamburg and forces Gisela to go with her. On the way back, the car breaks down and they have to walk back to Lüneburg. This leads to a small reconciliation. Svenja tries to distract herself from Mika with work when her old punk band, Girlfront, contacts her. The drummer is out. Can Svenja step in?

videos.title: Episode 4157
videos.overview: Noah and Toni help Elyas prepare for his first singles party at the laundry. The workload is a welcome opportunity for Elyas to distract himself from his frustration with Bella. Toni is also disappointed because there’s been no communication between her and her chat partner, DCooley. Encouraged by Elyas, Noah takes the plunge and confesses his love to Toni. Tina faces her divorce hearing with mixed feelings. When it comes to selling the attic apartment, she and Ben argue because Tina can’t find a suitable buyer. Britta comes to the rescue. She has received a large sum from Hendrik’s life insurance and offers to take over Tina’s share. Simon and Julius remain irreconcilable until Simon offers a surprised Julius to be Olivia’s godfather. Harmony is restored, and the two promise to work together in the future. Svenja is delighted when Mika unexpectedly returns to Lüneburg.

videos.title: Episode 4158
videos.overview: Toni initially can’t take Noah’s declaration of love seriously. However, she gradually realizes, with shock, that Noah has not only fallen in love with her, but has also been chatting with her as DCooley the whole time. Tina and Ben are divorced and are celebrating the end of their marriage at their divorce party. Their good mood leads to a flirtation between them - until Tina jealously sees a message from another woman, bikergirl82, on Ben’s phone. Svenja and Mika make no secret of their mutual attraction. The flirtation quickly turns into a romantic affair, and Svenja ends up in bed with Mika. Heiner and Gisela are overwhelmed when Hannes unexpectedly shows up at the arbor. On top of that, Heiner also has to confess that he gave Hannes’s beloved suitcase to Paragraph Schulze. Hannes is deeply hurt. But with Simon’s help, they are able to recapture the suitcase and Hannes is overjoyed because it contains a memento of his great love.

videos.title: Episode 4159
videos.overview: After the divorce, Tina remains unsure whether this was the right move. In addition to the message from bikergirl82, Tina also finds a key with a heart pendant at Ben’s house. This proves to her that Ben isn’t being honest with her, and she confronts him angrily. Svenja is very much in love with Mika and relieved by how easily Till reacts to Mika’s presence. Svenja completely forgot to request leave from the hotel for her short tour. Will Julius agree to Amelie being her vacation replacement? Victoria renews her tempting offer to Amelie of giving her the hotel. For this, however, Amelie would have to marry Arthur. Arthur is strictly against it. He wants to distance himself from his mother. But the tempting idea doesn’t leave Amelie alone. At the end of his time at the Lauben, Hannes has one last battle with Paragraph Schulze. And he persuades Heiner and Britta to take over his Lauben together.

videos.title: Episode 4160
videos.overview: Britta and Heiner are looking forward to spending time together in the summerhouse. And Hannes triumphs over Schulze, who is a bit of a snob, before saying goodbye to his friends in Lüneburg and heading off to LA. Julius reluctantly agrees to have Amelie cover for Svenja at the hotel during her concert tour. At the same time, Victoria doesn’t let up: She repeats her offer to Amelie and teases her about Arthur’s frivolity, which triggers a minor jealousy attack in Amelie. But the misunderstanding is cleared up, and Amelie realizes: She wants Arthur without compromise. Tina feels like sinking into the ground: She has accused Ben of having an affair with 82-year-old Ingrid. Ben is puzzled by Tina’s jealousy: Where does it come from? Svenja wistfully bids Mika and Till farewell to their concert tour. Before they leave, however, she asks Toni to take care of Till in her absence.

videos.title: Episode 4161
videos.overview: Bella is back from New York, and Elyas senses that she’s changed. Bella is brimming with new ideas that only Victoria seems to understand. Victoria seizes the opportunity and makes her granddaughter a tempting offer: Bella could begin her studies and return to the EmKa at the same time. Amelie takes over as Svenja’s replacement at the hotel and is immediately put in her place by Julius with a trick - and it works. Annoyed, she remembers Victoria’s advice on how to get rid of Julius: by marrying Arthur. On the farm in Wendland, Tina dreams of a hidden treasure. Ben offers his support, but Tina wants to keep her distance. But when he gives her a crucial clue, the argument is forgotten, and the treasure hunt begins. For Valerie, her world is falling apart: She made a mistake during the estate renovation, making a timely handover impossible. Heiner could be her salvation - if it weren’t for the argument between them.

videos.title: Episode 4162
videos.overview: Amelie and Arthur are caught kissing in the hotel by Julius. He threatens to expel them if they break the rules again. Annoyed, Amelie considers quitting. But when she realizes how attached Arthur is to their collaboration, she takes Victoria’s suggestion to marry Arthur and makes a surprise proposal. Valerie doesn’t want to expose herself in front of Victoria and overcomes the fear and asks Heiner for help with the estate renovation. When Heiner gets injured, Valerie pulls the ripcord: his health comes first. But in Victoria’s eyes, Valerie has failed. Bella is taken with Victoria’s offer to work at the EmKA while studying. Elyas and Arthur are horrified that she’s seriously considering it. But Bella firmly believes she can hold her own with Victoria and accepts the challenge despite all the warnings. Tina is disappointed: her mother’s treasure is just a porcelain figurine. Or maybe there’s more to it?

videos.title: Episode 4163
videos.overview: Valerie defends herself against Victoria’s accusations, while Noah is mocked by Heiner for his heartbreak. Frustrated, the two run into each other and get into a heated argument. After the argument, they both feel relieved, and when they meet again later, they can’t resist their mutual attraction. Till receives a sexy photo of Marcel, and Toni suggests to him that Marcel might want more than just friendship. Uncertain, Till considers canceling the planned visit. But Marcel has no romantic interest. Till breathes a sigh of relief and deepens his friendship with Marcel. Then Bella receives shocking news: The police are calling off the search for the driver who caused the accident. Arthur rejects Amelie’s proposal. He doesn’t want to be manipulated by his mother and confronts Victoria. Ben is confused: Is something going on between Tina and Simon? When he asks Simon about it, Tina wonders why Ben is suddenly jealous.

videos.title: Episode 4164
videos.overview: Elyas and Bella are stuck. Every conversation about Bella’s future ends in an argument. Despite Elyas’s efforts to save the relationship, everything feels like goodbye. But then Bella surprises him with an unexpected declaration of love and asks him to support her in her decisions. Till can’t accept that the police have called off the search for Jenny’s driver. Arthur and Heiner want to help him find a way out of his grief. Arthur suggests organizing a ceremony in Jenny’s memory. But Till balks - he’s not ready to let go of his mother yet. Valerie is under pressure after her night with Noah: Gisela harshly criticizes her for staying out all night. Overwhelmed by Olivia’s restlessness, Valerie finds comfort in Noah, who suggests they spend another night together. While Julius is busy at the hotel and has little time for Mo, Mo uses his free time to make plans for his professional future.

videos.title: Episode 4165
videos.overview: Amelie is irritated by Arthur’s desire to keep a clear separation between family and affair, but agrees to it for his sake. When she meets Till by chance and persuades him to attend the ceremony for Jenny, Arthur doesn’t take kindly to this - Amelie should stay away from his family. He accuses her unfairly. Amelie won’t stand for it. Gisela and Valerie argue constantly, and Gisela is afraid of losing her daughter. She gets tips from a mother-daughter guide, but they only make things worse. Gisela is depressed - until Heiner enchants her with a dance. Mo is working on a concept for his own business. When he presents his ideas to Julius, he is reserved.
