Mo is irritated - does Julius not believe in him? Britta embarks on the Camino de Santiago to cope with her grief. But everything goes wrong, and she abandons the tour with a heavy heart. Back home, she is surprised to discover that the purpose of her pilgrimage has nevertheless been fulfilled.

videos.title: Episode 4166
videos.overview: Although Valerie receives praise from Victoria for her design ideas on the estate, she still hasn’t received a permanent job offer. Mo encourages her to take the step into self-employment. Julius considers it far too risky. When Valerie accuses him of being stuffy, Julius loses his temper. Arthur tries to win Amelie back, but she gives him the cold shoulder. Even when he needs her help with Till again, she remains adamant. Arthur realizes he has to commit to his relationship and is surprised: Bella and Till are on Amelie’s side. Meanwhile, Victoria is planning the inauguration of the new estate. Gisela can’t do anything right, and when she orders extra spicy food in a stressed-out mood, Arthur has to support the desperate Gisela against his mother.

videos.title: Episode 4167
videos.overview: When Valerie receives a high praise from Victoria at the manor house reception, Gisela is overjoyed. Heiner suggests celebrating this success with the family. The mood is exuberant. And suddenly, while dancing with Heiner, Gisela is overcome by her feelings and kisses him. After their passionate night, Tina and Ben are certain: It was just a slip-up. They are divorced, and that’s a good thing. But when Tina is able to move to her farm in Wendland earlier than expected, Ben realizes that he still loves her. Julius fears that both Valerie and Mo might fail in their plan to become self-employed. Mo, however, is undaunted, and Julius decides to pursue a long-held dream: He wants to adopt a child. While Mo and Julius pursue their dreams, they ask each other in love: Isn’t their life already perfect? Arthur enjoys his casual affair with Amelie, but Victoria is pushing for a quick wedding. However, Arthur remains calm.

videos.title: Episode 4168
videos.overview: Victoria gives Arthur her grandmother’s valuable engagement ring so that he can finally propose to Amelie. But neither Arthur nor Amelie are considering marriage, as they both enjoy the non-committal nature of their affair. When Arthur loses the ring, a frantic search begins until Amelie finds it. Overwhelmed by the situation, Arthur spontaneously proposes. Noah gets into trouble when he questions his chief physician’s treatment methods. The criticism has consequences: Noah is removed from the surgical schedule. This means he will not be able to complete his residency as planned. The kiss between Gisela and Heiner is dismissed by both as a harmless whim. But while Gisela’s hopes are beginning to grow, Heiner’s feelings are with Britta. Ben struggles with his reawakened feelings for Tina. Overwhelmed but determined, he doesn’t want to let her move to Wendland and dares a brave, unconventional gesture.

videos.title: Episode 4169
videos.overview: Gisela’s hope grows that Heiner feels more for her than he lets on. When he plans a romantic boat trip, she dreams of sailing across the lake with him. But then she realizes, to her dismay, that Heiner organized the trip for Britta. Bella is supposed to find an apartment at the Salzmarkt, but a mistake in the exposé gets her into trouble. Valerie points this out to Victoria, but instead of helping Bella, Victoria lets her down so she can learn from her mistakes. Amelie accepts Arthur’s marriage proposal, but the two agree to a non-committal relationship-without any deep feelings. Amelie wants to get rid of Julius as quickly as possible and lets Victoria know that she’s fulfilled her part of the bargain and now wants the hotel. Noah suspects that his chief physician is trying to cover up a misdiagnosis. He secretly gains access to the patient’s file but finds no clues. When he tries to report the case, Britta turns against him. She believes Noah is acting out of personal revenge.

videos.title: Episode 4170
videos.overview: Valerie is at her wit’s end. Olivia’s constant crying is wearing on her nerves, and she longs for a life without a child. In her desperation, she confides in Amelie, who advises her to seek help. Valerie knows who to turn to: She asks Julius for a chat and asks if Olivia wouldn’t be better off with him and Mo. Bella wants to make amends for her mistake in preparing the exposé and sees her chance when Victoria is looking for a house in the Salzmarkt. Bella is tempted to offer Victoria the house where Elyas’s laundry is located. And which Bella knows Elyas wants to buy himself. Will she betray Elyas? Gisela is drowning in heartbreak after her disappointment with Heiner, who is also hurt by being rejected by Britta. Noah is shocked when he discovers that Till has posted a video protesting his chief physician online. Although Noah takes it offline, the consequence follows: Noah is suspended - his job is at stake.

videos.title: Episode 4171
videos.overview: Svenja is worried that Bella has finally dropped out of veterinary medicine school. Even though Bella convincingly tells her that she’s not concerned about Victoria, but only about her own interests, Svenja is worried. Arthur is also worried and doesn’t get around to telling Svenja about his engagement to Amelie. Noah fears being fired - even an apology to his boss, Dr. Steeger, doesn’t help. But Britta successfully advocates for Noah with the hospital board and is able to prevent him from leaving the clinic. Noah can hardly believe his luck. Valerie is completely overwhelmed as a mother and, in her despair, feels like she’s not being taken seriously - neither by Julius nor by Gisela. But then Julius is able to reassure her: Olivia is good for Valerie. So Valerie decides to give herself another chance as a mother. Bella doesn’t tell Victoria, but at the same time she’s afraid that Elyas is overextending himself by buying the laundry.

videos.title: Episode 4172
videos.overview: Britta is offered the opportunity to return to the hospital. Is she ready for it? When she saves a passerby’s life with Toni’s help, she realizes her calling: she wants to return to work as a senior physician. Ben wants to create a list of things he hates about Tina to distance himself emotionally from her. When Tina reads the list and all her disliked traits, she asks Ben, agitated, if their entire marriage was a single mistake for him. Then Ben makes a confession: despite all her flaws, he still loves her like the first day. Tina gives in to her feelings and kisses Ben passionately. Svenja is perplexed to learn of Amelie and Arthur’s engagement. Although she thinks she’s over Arthur, the news hurts her. When Britta suggests that it won’t be a love match for Amelie and Arthur, Svenja’s uncertainty grows. But then Mika arrives unexpectedly and manages to distract her... Valerie is once again at her lowest point in her role as a mother and is supported by Noah.

videos.title: Episode 4173
videos.overview: When Svenja and Mika get stuck in the elevator, Svenja realizes that Mika can’t easily attract attention. Svenja increasingly discovers the world of the deaf. After a passionate night, Svenja declares her love to Mika, which Mika reciprocates. Valerie comes to the emergency room with the sick Olivia. When the pediatrician doesn’t test Olivia for the RSV, Britta strongly advises Valerie to do so. But Valerie is overwhelmed and calls Britta an incompetent doctor. Britta, worried, wants to check on Olivia the next day. However, Julius is alone with Olivia and doesn’t want to have the baby treated against the mother’s wishes. Victoria puts pressure on Arthur to finally tell Bella and Till about the wedding plans. Till is happy, while Bella reacts cautiously. When Svenja expresses criticism of the engagement, Victoria pricks up her ears. Ben and Tina confess their love and feel like lovestruck teenagers. But then the familiar patterns creep in.

videos.title: Episode 4174
videos.overview: Arthur is stung when he sees how happy Svenja is with Mika. When an argument breaks out between Victoria and Mika, Arthur even takes his mother’s side. Amelie doesn’t miss Arthur’s behavior and confronts him with her suspicion: Arthur is jealous of Mika. Bella has the chance to land her dream project at EmKa - provided she secures a property for the company on the Salzmarkt. The building with Elyas’ laundry would be perfect. So Bella convinces herself that she can save Elyas from making a mistake if she and Victoria snatch the house away from him. Julius and Gisela convince Valerie to have Olivia examined at the hospital. Valerie recognizes the seriousness of the situation but doesn’t want Britta to get close to Olivia. Only when Olivia’s condition rapidly deteriorates does Valerie relent. Ben and Tina want to symbolically shed the baggage of their relationship over the past few years. But this backfires, and a heated argument ensues.

videos.title: Episode 4175
videos.overview: Simon is back from Rostock. When he hears how ill Olivia has been during his absence, he accuses Valerie of not informing him. While Valerie seriously considers giving Olivia to Julius for adoption, Simon realizes that he finally wants to be officially registered as Olivia’s father. He makes a clear statement to Valerie: He will fight for his rights - in court if necessary. Amelie is increasingly annoyed by Arthur’s attention to Svenja. Arthur is able to temporarily appease her, but ultimately Amelie questions the wedding. Bella is tormented by her guilty conscience toward Elyas - she snatched his house on the Salzmarkt away from him. She wants to talk to Elyas, but he has already heard of a competitor outbidding him. He is devastated, and Bella can’t bring herself to tell Elyas the truth. Gisela can hardly believe her luck: she has won a cruise in a competition. Excitedly, she sets off on an adventure.

videos.title: Episode 4176
videos.overview: Valerie wants to go through with the adoption without Simon’s consent. To do so, she needs Julius’s consent so she can hire a lawyer for the adoption. But Mo is unwilling to agree under these conditions. Will Julius sign without speaking to Mo first? Upon his return, Heiner is surprised to find Britta working at the hospital again. He’s afraid she won’t have time for him anymore. But Britta wants to continue their time off together in the allotment garden. However, a lot of trouble awaits Heiner at the gardening association. Arthur can’t believe that Amelie is questioning the wedding. She won’t be easily reconciled. But then Amelie realizes that the lightheartedness is the strength of their relationship, and she reconciles with Arthur. Elyas is disappointed to realize that he has no chance against the other bidder for the house on the Salzmarkt and gives up. Bella tries to console him by suggesting that he find another location for the laundry.

videos.title: Episode 4177
videos.overview: Valerie convinces Julius to submit the adoption application without Simon and Mo’s knowledge. When Mo finds out, he reproaches Julius and insists on informing Simon immediately. But before Julius can, Simon suddenly appears at the door. Ben and Tina don’t know how to break out of their old relationship patterns. Tina suggests a date where they pretend they’re just getting to know each other. The plan works: Tina discovers a previously unsuspected romantic side in Ben, which she likes. Victoria and Amelie’s ideas for the engagement party differ greatly. While Victoria wants a befitting celebration that represents the Kaiser family, Amelie wants to celebrate with her closest family. Arthur is willing to make a partial compromise. But that’s not enough for Victoria. Heiner runs for election to the allotment board. With a passionate election speech, Heiner impresses not only the allotment gardeners, but also Britta.

videos.title: Episode 4178
videos.overview: Britta is thrilled by Heiner’s dedication to the allotment garden and his caring for the sick Toni. During a spontaneous dinner with Heiner, Britta enjoys his closeness. She finds it increasingly difficult to escape her feelings for him and decides to kiss him. But Heiner resists. Simon can’t believe that Valerie gave custody of Olivia to Julius without speaking to him first. Upset, he asks Mo to spend time with Olivia - and Mo agrees. Then comes the shock: Has Simon taken off to Rostock with Olivia? Svenja watches, irritated, as Till and Jolina kiss in public. When Till doesn’t tell her about the kiss, she asks Arthur to talk to Till. But this backfires - Till doesn’t feel like discussing romantic matters with them. Svenja realizes she has to give Till his space. After a long back and forth, Tina and Ben happily admit that they don’t want to be without each other anymore.

videos.title: Episode 4179
videos.overview: Bella’s successful purchase of the laundry building for Emka is overshadowed by her guilty conscience toward Elyas. She wants to tell him the truth, but things get worse: she has to hand him the notice of termination of the lease. Elyas is shocked - has Bella known about Victoria’s plans all along? Valerie does everything she can to keep Simon away from Olivia. She stokes Julius’s fear that Simon, now that he’s established paternity, might sue for sole custody of Olivia. Britta wants to try it with Heiner - he can hardly believe his luck. However, Britta wants to keep her love a secret for now. Not so easy with a nosy Johanna in the hallway. And when they try to escape to the hotel, Svenja catches on to them. Amelie is still reeling from her departure from Henni, and then Victoria is constantly interfering in the planning of her engagement party. At least she overcomes her block on screen and is happy when Arthur agrees to the celebration at the estate.

videos.title: Episode 4180
videos.overview: Instead of telling Elyas the truth, Bella continues to entangle herself in lies. She makes Elyas believe that Victoria alone is to blame for his loss of his laundry business. While Bella is looking for new premises for Elyas, Victoria exposes Bella’s betrayal to him. Victoria has achieved her goal - Elyas is breaking up with Bella. Simon pressures Julius to sign the consent form for the paternity test. When Simon finally gets the signature, he realizes that there is still a long way to go before possible custody. But Simon’s patience is running out. Then David’s offer to move to the countryside with him and Franzi comes at just the right time. Britta wants to make her relationship with Heiner official at the household’s spontaneous dinner. She only wants to tell Joe and Sam alone and carefully. But Joe shows up unexpectedly and thwarts Britta’s plan. Arthur is enlisted by Victoria to help her reconcile with his siblings.

videos.title: Episode 4181
videos.overview: Amelie throws herself enthusiastically into planning an art exhibition at the «Drei Könige» (Three Kings), but doesn’t want to reveal how much art still means to her. But the hype surrounding the artist makes her wonder: Has she given up on her dream of working as an artist too soon? While Elyas seeks comfort from his father after his separation from Bella, Bella desperately tries to explain herself to him. But Elyas is stonewalling - a reconciliation seems out of the question. Meanwhile, Simon plans to move to Rostock with his daughter Olivia as soon as he is officially recognized as the father. Julius fears losing Olivia to Simon in a potential custody battle and makes far-reaching concessions for the time being. Britta is happy that Joe accepts her happiness with Heiner, but Lilly takes a dim view and provocatively asks her mother what she wants with someone like Heiner. Britta is deeply hurt. Can the conflicts be resolved, or will tensions escalate?

videos.title: Episode 4182
videos.overview: The DNA test confirms Simon’s paternity, but the argument over Olivia escalates. Julius is horrified to learn of Simon’s plan to move to Rostock with Olivia. In his anger, he confesses to Mo that he is deliberately delaying the custody proceedings in order to become indispensable in Olivia’s life. Mo is shocked and confronts both men about their true intentions. Amelie struggles with her future at the hotel. Svenja and Arthur advise her to follow her inner voice. When Victoria presents her with the preliminary contract for the transfer of the hotel, Amelie doesn’t sign. Instead, she writes her resignation. Nevertheless, she and Arthur want to get married. While Bella seeks comfort from Svenja and Arthur, Arthur rediscovers his feelings for Svenja despite Amelie. But Svenja only has eyes for Mika. Meanwhile, Britta and Lilly reconcile: After a clarifying conversation, Britta realizes the reason for Lilly’s rejection of Heiner, and Lilly takes the first step toward him.

videos.title: Episode 4183
videos.overview: Amelie and Arthur celebrate their engagement, but Arthur can’t deny his feelings for Svenja - and Amelie doesn’t miss it either. The two honestly admit to each other that there’s no future for them together and part as friends. Ben realizes he can’t move to Wendland immediately - his workshop has to stay in Lüneburg, otherwise he won’t have regular customers. But he wants to earn extra money with his blog and make videos in sign language with Mika’s help. His editor rejects the suggestion. But Ben doesn’t give up and is rewarded in the end... The argument between Julius and Simon escalates to the point where Julius forbids Simon from seeing Olivia. But Mo intervenes and makes it clear that they must finally come to an agreement. Otherwise, he’ll involve the youth welfare office. Meanwhile, Svenja and Mika are on cloud nine. When Mika has to go to Munich on a sudden, Svenja makes a decision: She’ll accompany him on his trip.

videos.title: Episode 4184
videos.overview: Bella tries to make amends for her mistake with Elyas - she offers him a suitable property for the laundry. But Victoria sabotages the house purchase and challenges Elyas: He should stay away from Bella. Undeterred, Elyas organizes a residents’ protest against the EmKa (EmKa). Bella is horrified. Till notices Victoria’s tense mood and tries to cheer her up. But she blocks him, whereupon Till predicts that she will end up lonely and alone in her bitterness. Arthur is horrified: After the engagement is broken, Victoria breaks off contact with him and also causes a derogatory article in the «Heideecho» that exposes him and Amelie. At the same time, he has to suppress his feelings for Svenja. Ben and Tina are optimistic about the future: They want to open a biker café in Wendland. Together, they say goodbye to Lüneburg and begin a new chapter full of hope.

videos.title: Episode 4185
videos.overview: Victoria is haunted by Till’s dark prophecy when she has to face the Salt Market protest against the EmKa. She isolates herself; even Arthur can’t get close to her. Only when he protects her from angry demonstrators does she, touched, admit to feelings for Arthur. Elyas is disappointed in Bella and wants to forbid her from having contact with Hermione. But when Hermione suddenly disappears during a protest, the search for her brings the two together again. But Elyas demands that Bella turn away from Victoria and the EmKa in order to have a future with him. Svenja, confronted with Arthur’s confession that he still loves her, is plagued by doubts about who her heart truly belongs to. But she decides to go on vacation with Mika to gain clarity. Mo feels neglected by Julius. Everything revolves around Olivia and the adoption. Julius wants to show Mo how important he is to him and takes time off to support Mo at the Salt Market protests. Mo is touched.

videos.title: Episode 4186
videos.overview: Gunter immediately feels at home during his brief visit to the hotel, but Victoria’s tarnished reputation in Lüneburg irritates him. Doubting whether she’s suitable as a hotel owner, he lets her persuade him with a touching - albeit fictitious - story about her mother and finally agrees to sell the hotel to her. Toni and Noah are back in Lüneburg. Noah would prefer to avoid Toni, but Toni asks him to help her clean up the shared apartment. But when Toni skips the cleaning, it sets off a chain reaction that ends with Toni in the hospital... Bella is faced with a difficult decision: Elyas demands that she choose between him and the EmKa. Torn apart, thanks to Till’s support, she realizes that she can’t allow herself to be blackmailed. Bella makes it clear to Elyas that their relationship has no future as long as he continues to put her under so much pressure. As Britta immerses herself in her work again, Heiner encourages her to be spontaneous sometimes.

videos.title: Episode 4187
videos.overview: Gunter is alarmed when Elyas tells him about Victoria’s unfair business practices. When he realizes that she was trying to manipulate him with her sentimental family history, he withdraws his agreement to sell the hotel. Stunned, Victoria runs into the protests at the Salt Market and collapses, shaking. Amelie launches her career as an artist with a wooden sculpture - but Britta doesn’t recognize art in it. Discouraged, Amelie wants to give up everything. Toni, frustrated, realizes that she’s helpless with two broken arms. But Noah is there to take care of her. But when Toni learns that Noah deliberately placed the cleaning bucket in front of her room, her emotion at Noah’s helpfulness turns to anger. When Olivia shows an abnormality during her U4 check-up, Julius and Simon panic - is Olivia developmentally delayed because she doesn’t smile? Mo tries unsuccessfully to calm them both down. Only Olivia can calm everyone’s tempers with a contented chuckle.

videos.title: Episode 4188
videos.overview: Ben and Tina are planning a farewell barbecue at the allotment garden, but everyone seems unavailable. Disappointed, they want to spend their last evening in Lüneburg alone until Lilly surprises them with a lovingly prepared party. Olivia’s incessant crying is driving Simon to his limits. Desperately, he calls Julius and Mo for help. Together, they try every trick in the book to get Olivia to sleep. When she finally falls asleep, Simon has an unexpected idea: Why don’t the three men just move in together? After Victoria’s collapse at the salt market, Bella decides to move in with her on the estate to be there for her. But when Bella asks Elyas to end his protest, the situation escalates, and Bella and Elyas get into a heated argument. Meanwhile, Noah is roped in by Toni, who blames him for everything because of her broken arms. Reluctantly, he steps in for her, and the two become closer than they ever expected.

videos.title: Episode 4189
videos.overview: Bella convinces Victoria to give in to the demands of the Salzmarkt tenants. Surprisingly, Victoria withdraws the notices of termination and keeps the rents stable. But Bella’s hopes are dashed when she learns at the rally that the offer doesn’t apply to Elyas’ laundry. Amelie creates a new wooden sculpture, which Till, with Amelie’s consent, places on an art auction platform - on the condition that the name Fährmann is not mentioned. But Till doesn’t comply. When Amelie finds out about this and demands that the listing be deleted, the bid has already reached 5,000 euros. Ben, Tina, and Louis are moving to Wendland for good. Britta misses the lively activity at the Rose House. Heiner lovingly welcomes her and, to cheer her up, suggests an end-of-season party in the allotment garden. Julius, Mo, and Simon are exhausted by Olivia’s trouble falling asleep. Julius believes that the temporary three-person shared apartment on the estate could provide some relief for everyone.

videos.title: Episode 4190
videos.overview: Britta feels lonely after Amelie’s departure and seeks closeness with Heiner. But when she wakes up the next morning next to him in the marital bed she had shared with Hendrik, she regrets her decision. Due to a misunderstanding with Simon, Julius and Mo leave Olivia alone on the estate. When the three men realize their faux pas, they panic. But Heiner has taken care of the little girl and hands her over safely to the relieved men. Bella’s fighting spirit is awakened. She refuses to be intimidated by the protests against the EmKa. During Victoria’s business trip to Copenhagen, she decides to bravely stand up for the EmKa. Amelie is moved to tears that Gunter has bought her sculpture to exhibit. Inspired by her initial success, she decides to leave Lüneburg and attend a master class in wood carving in Italy. Toni and Noah enjoy a close friendship until Noah suddenly receives a message from Valerie that could change everything.

videos.title: Episode 4191
videos.overview: Simon, Julius, and Mo take care of Olivia harmoniously - until Valerie returns and sharply attacks Julius: Why doesn’t he keep Simon away from Olivia as agreed? Simon will take Olivia away from him. Julius initially defends himself against Valerie’s insinuations, but distrust is sown. Britta still can’t stand Heiner in her former marital bed. Although he shows understanding, her rejection hurts him. A clarifying conversation brings the two closer together again - at least for the moment. Toni finds everyday life difficult with her broken arm. When Noah downplays her injuries, she feigns pain and lets him work for her with relish. Bella tries to win Gunter over at chess and convince him to sell the hotel. But Gunter sees through her scheme and turns away from her, disappointed. Arthur returns from Estonia - reformed and determined to take responsibility for his life. But Svenja doesn’t buy his new attitude.

videos.title: Episode 4192
videos.overview: Arthur has big plans for Carla’s, but Svenja doubts his perseverance. To convince her otherwise, he bets on his success - will she go along with it and believe him that he’s changed? Julius lets Simon down in front of the youth welfare office employee. Their friendship is over. Julius’s fear of losing Olivia grows immeasurably, and not even Mo can calm him down. And Simon wants to fight for custody and bravely gives Valerie an ultimatum: Either she gives in or they’ll face court. Outraged, Britta believes Lilly and Joe secretly tried the homemade apple cider. And Heiner is to blame. Toni is curious about Noah’s mysterious girlfriend, who spent the first night in the shared apartment. To hide her growing jealousy, she openly approaches the new girl. But she surprisingly turns out to be Valerie. Toni is shocked.

videos.title: Episode 4193
videos.overview: Valerie continues to encourage Julius to be tough on Simon so as not to lose custody of Olivia. Simon then realizes that Valerie is fighting unfairly and that Julius is on her side. Angrily, he accuses Julius of becoming Valerie’s plaything. Svenja proposes an unusual challenge to Arthur: If he creates perfect buns, she will support his concept for Gunter’s «Carlas.» Arthur masters the task with flying colors and impresses Svenja. Has he really changed? Britta is planning Lilly’s birthday party at Ben and Tina’s farm in Wendland. But a sudden emergency call to the hospital forces her to hand over responsibility to Heiner, who is happy to step in for her. Britta is grateful and also a little happy to have a brief break from Heiner’s affections. Toni clashes with Valerie and demands that Noah stop bringing Valerie into the shared apartment. Noah doesn’t even think about responding to Toni’s announcement, but then gives in with a compromise proposal.

videos.title: Episode 4194
videos.overview: Britta feels constrained by Heiner’s love. While she questions the relationship, Heiner confesses his love to her and is already planning a vacation together. Britta, with a heavy heart, realizes that she doesn’t reciprocate Heiner’s feelings. She breaks up with him. Heiner is shocked. Julius realizes that Valerie is manipulating him. When he suspiciously checks Valerie’s browser history, he believes she’s trying to harm Simon with a fake email. Julius warns Simon and allies himself with him. Together, they give Valerie an ultimatum: Either she signs Simon’s paternity statement or she’ll be reported. Elyas, Toni, and Noah get stuck in the elevator. The unplanned time off forces them to finally talk about their conflicts. Svenja and Arthur are worried about Bella. During a game of chess with Svenja, Bella confesses that she’s suffering from the breakup with Elyas.

videos.title: Episode 4195
videos.overview: Arthur and Svenja plan to bring Bella and Elyas back together. They arrange a meeting at «Carla’s» so the two can talk things out. But shortly before, Bella receives an order from Victoria to view an important apartment. Under pressure to avoid jeopardizing her career, Bella cancels the meeting with Elyas. And Victoria openly threatens Svenja to stop interfering in Bella’s life. An exasperated Valerie signs the paternity acknowledgment. But it has nothing to do with a fake email to Simon. Embarrassed, Simon and Julius discover that they wrongly suspected Valerie. Heiner misunderstands Britta’s dismissive behavior and believes she just needs time to commit to the relationship. Britta feels compelled to finally speak up, which completely throws Heiner off track. Toni comforts her father and vehemently reproaches Britta. At the same time, Toni becomes increasingly skeptical: Why is Valerie suddenly so nice to her?

videos.title: Episode 4196
videos.overview: Simon is faced with a mystery: How did the oil get into the goat farm’s pond? Together with Till, he searches for answers using an underwater drone - and discovers a sunken car at the bottom. Is that the missing car from the accident? Gunter is worried about David, who is suddenly missing and has even sold his café in Rostock. When Gunter tries to sort things out himself, Carla is forced to reveal the surprise: David has long since left for Lüneburg. Franzi is pregnant, and Gunter is going to be a grandfather. Svenja suggests to Arthur that they take advantage of Gunter’s absence to offer an exclusive menu at «Carla’s.» But when Gunter suddenly appears at Carla’s with David, Svenja wants to call off the plan. Arthur, on the other hand, is determined to go through with it. Does Svenja trust him? Toni realizes that Valerie is exploiting her and wants to teach her a lesson. She presents her with a crazy astrological interior design concept for a client.

videos.title: Episode 4197
videos.overview: Arthur and Svenja make a good team with Till and at «Carla’s.» Even though Gunter isn’t buying into Arthur’s menu concept, Arthur can no longer contain his feelings for Svenja and confesses his love to her. After the discovery of the wrecked car, Till hopes that the driver will finally be found and brought to justice. He writes to his chat buddy Marcel about the discovery. And suddenly, a stranger appears at the door: Marcel. Victoria hatches a devious plan to pressure Gunter into selling the hotel. She arranges for the residents of the Salzmarkt to be asked to pay for the upcoming road construction. This would force Gunter to cover a large portion of the costs. When he expresses concern about this, David questions why Gunter is still attached to «Three Kings.» David offers Simon the opportunity to move in with him and Franzi on the Darß. But Simon, with a heavy heart, declines. After everything he’s experienced with Julius and Olivia, he doesn’t want to separate them.

videos.title: Episode 4198
videos.overview: Elyas is determined to ruin Victoria’s reputation with Corinna’s help. But when Corinna plants an incendiary device in front of the grocery store and calls the police as agreed, Elyas realizes that Bella’s - and not Victoria’s - fingerprints are on the bottle. He aborts the operation and wants to dispose of the bottle - but then the police arrest him. Arthur’s declaration of love deeply touches Svenja. Even though Arthur accepts her relationship with Mika, Svenja can no longer be carefree with Mika. When Mika confronts her openly about it, Svenja confesses Arthur’s declaration of love to him. Gunter is convinced that he is indispensable at his hotels. Only when David points out to him that he should better plan his time with his grandson on the Darß does Gunter reassess his priorities. He wants to sell the hotels to Victoria - but only 80 percent of the time. Till becomes suspicious: Why does Marcel want to stay with him? When he finds Marcel’s ID card, it has a different name on it.

videos.title: Episode 4199
videos.overview: Svenja tries to convince Mika and herself that Arthur’s declaration of love means nothing to her. But she realizes she’s lying to herself, and she breaks up with Mika. Now Victoria fears that Svenja might challenge her control over Arthur and the grandchildren. Therefore, Victoria’s first official act as hotel manager is to fire Svenja. Bella hopes that Elyas will finally clear out the laundry after the confrontation with the police. Elyas briefly considers giving up, but then, in a rage, barricades himself in the laundry. Britta is worried about Heiner. When she hears that he’s traveling to visit friends, she thinks Heiner is over the breakup. But Toni makes it clear to her: Heiner is only traveling to suppress his heartbreak. Gunter is persuaded by David’s words, hands over the hotels to Victoria, and gets rid of his stored furniture. When David sees how attached Gunter is to the pieces, he secretly buys them back at auction to make his father happy.

videos.title: Episode 4200
videos.overview: The car from the pond turns out to be the one that caused Jenny’s death. Marcel abruptly wants to leave Lüneburg and asks Till to move with him to Spain, to one of Victoria’s vacation homes. But Till refuses and is shocked to learn that the car belongs to Marcel. Simon makes a difficult decision: He wants to move in with Olivia to David and Franzi. How will Julius react? Svenja suspects that Victoria fired her to destroy the closeness between her and Arthur. Arthur demands that his mother reverse the decision. Otherwise, he will quit. Elyas continues to occupy the laundry, and Victoria urges Bella to file an eviction notice. Bella struggles with this harsh step, but in light of Elyas’s stubbornness, she finally agrees. Britta has to go on a professional training course and leaves Heiner a letter explaining her feelings to him. Before leaving, she asks Toni to give the letter to Heiner as soon as he returns to Lüneburg.

videos.title: Episode 4201
videos.overview: Marcel is holding Till captive at an unknown location. He manages to calm Svenja down with a lie. But when Marcel’s escape fails, Till suggests to him that he should demand a ransom from Victoria. This is how the family finally learns that Till has been kidnapped. Simon can’t bring himself to tell Julius that he wants to move to Rostock with Olivia. When he finally comes clean, Julius is shocked. Elyas is worried that Victoria will clear out the occupied laundry. Together with Toni and Noah, he comes up with the idea of publicizing the occupation via social media. This works so well that Elyas gets a lot of new business. And Bella realizes: EmKa is facing a PR problem. Svenja senses that Arthur has changed-for the better. She feels a lightness with him that she hasn’t felt in a long time. She realizes that she is finally free to live out her love with Arthur. But before Svenja can declare her love to him, Victoria brings the bad news - Till has been kidnapped.

videos.title: Episode 4202
videos.overview: Victoria, Arthur, and Svenja are horrified - Till has been kidnapped. While Arthur and Svenja want to call the police, Victoria wants to avoid unnecessary fuss and pay the ransom. When it becomes clear that Marcel is the kidnapper, Svenja and Arthur go to the police. Meanwhile, Victoria plans to hand over the ransom to the kidnapper. She deposits the money in a package at the Salt Market. Elyas is watching her. He suspects an operation against the local residents and has Corinna remove the package. When Arthur finds out, he rushes to the Salt Market to prevent things from getting worse. But it’s too late - the money is gone. Julius feels betrayed by Mo, who tries to convince him that Olivia would be better off with Simon. Mo simply doesn’t want to commit to being Olivia’s full-time dad while Julius is busy managing both hotels. Valerie and Toni read Britta’s letter. The question then arises: Should Heiner read it too?

videos.title: Episode 4203
videos.overview: Julius is completely devastated - his little family is in danger of falling apart if Simon moves away with Olivia. Simon and Mo know how difficult it is for Julius and try to find a solution. But Julius blocks everything. Only Heiner can get through to him. After Elyas learns from Bella that Till has been kidnapped and that the ransom is in Victoria’s package, he is plagued by feelings of guilt - has he put Till in danger? Arthur and Svenja get the crucial clue from Johanna about where Marcel might be hiding. Meanwhile, Till just wants to go home, but Marcel is becoming increasingly desperate and planning his escape. But just then, Svenja and Arthur are combing the grounds where he and Till are hiding. And in the darkness of night, Marcel mistakes them for police officers. Toni wants to create interior design concepts for Valerie based on horoscopes, but tax law thwarts her plans. It’s a good thing Valerie has a saving grace. Will it work for both of them?

videos.title: Episode 4204
videos.overview: Till tries to build an emotional bond with Marcel despite his imprisonment. This ultimately leads to Marcel releasing Till. At the same time, Svenja and Arthur search for Till at the freight depot and actually find him. When Marcel hears the approaching police, he believes Till has betrayed him. A scuffle ensues, during which Marcel pushes Svenja to the ground. She hits her head awkwardly and remains unconscious... Julius forces himself to let Olivia go. Simon is touched and surprised. He grants Julius’s wish to leave as soon as possible. Valerie finally gives her okay, too. And so Simon and Olivia leave Lüneburg for the Baltic Sea. Toni feels exploited by Valerie and decides to say «no» more often, which is extremely difficult for her. That’s why she can’t deny Valerie the opportunity to borrow her new dress. Saying no isn’t that easy.

videos.title: Episode 4205
videos.overview: The MRI gives the all-clear: Svenja has escaped with a laceration and a concussion. The family is relieved. Only Bella shows solidarity with Victoria and refuses to reconcile with Svenja. Svenja remains calm and wants to talk to Bella as soon as she is released from the hospital. But then Svenja’s condition suddenly worsens, and Britta fights for Svenja’s life, while Svenja wakes up in an in-between world and suddenly finds herself face to face with Jenny. The occupation of the laundry drives Elyas to the brink of exhaustion. Mo can’t get through to him: giving up is not an option for Elyas. Concerned, Mo asks Bella to mediate between Elyas and Victoria. Bella reluctantly agrees and seeks a conversation with Elyas. Before leaving, Gunter appeals to Victoria to rethink her management style at the hotel. When Valerie jokes about Toni’s savior complex, Toni has had enough. She terminates their collaboration with Valerie. Valerie doesn’t take her seriously. Will Toni remain consistent?

videos.title: Episode 4206
videos.overview: Svenja remains in a coma. In an in-between world, she encounters her deceased friend Jenny. Svenja confesses to her that she has doubts about her role as a surrogate mother, but Jenny is able to reassure her. Only when Arthur appears in the in-between world does the mood change. Jenny wants to know what’s going on between Svenja and Arthur. Meanwhile, Britta is fighting for Svenja’s life in the real world. Heiner, Till, Arthur, and Bella come together and try to support each other. Only Toni is missing... Bella tries to mediate between Victoria and Arthur, but a comment from Victoria opens Bella’s eyes: Victoria is completely indifferent to Svenja’s fate. Julius, unaware of the whole dramatic situation, tries to reach Arthur and Svenja in a state of stress. When Gisela returns fresh from her trip, she immediately has a solution to Julius’s chef problem. But will Julius go along with it?

videos.title: Episode 4207
videos.overview: Valerie meets a regular EmKa client privately for her astrology concept and is caught by Victoria. To keep her extra income secret, Valerie quickly invents an affair. But Victoria has a completely different suspicion. Toni finds it difficult to cope with the fact that her otherwise strong sister is in mortal danger and can’t bring herself to visit Svenja. When she learns that Heiner is being comforted by Britta, her anger boils over. She demands that Britta finally leave Heiner alone. After Bella sees through Victoria’s foul play, she moves back to the Rose House to wait with Arthur and Till for Svenja to wake up after the surgery. In the in-between world, Svenja confesses to Jenny that she’s fallen in love with Arthur and hopes for her support. But Jenny warns her friend against getting involved with Arthur. Gisela realizes that the family needs encouragement during this difficult time and organizes a cozy evening. But it goes completely wrong.

videos.title: Episode 4208
videos.overview: Arthur sits by Svenja’s bedside day and night, simultaneously trying to encourage Bella and Till. Fear is almost tearing him apart, because no one knows if Svenja will ever wake up again. In the in-between world, Svenja struggles with her feelings. Should she return to life? Britta withdraws, hurt after Toni’s outburst. Toni realizes that her anger stems only from concern for Svenja and regrets her harsh words. Tensions also arise between Gisela and Valerie: Valerie feels misunderstood by Victoria and accuses Gisela of not supporting her. Gisela tries to resolve the conflict with an expensive gift, but Valerie prefers genuine sympathy. Elyas is facing the loss of his laundry business due to Victoria’s eviction notice. Shortly before giving up, Bella secretly switches sides and fights with all her might to save his business.

videos.title: Episode 4209
videos.overview: Arthur is overjoyed that Svenja has woken up from her coma. But when she asks for Jenny and asks Arthur to leave, he is irritated. When Svenja tells her about her encounter with Jenny and her guilty conscience, Britta is able to reassure her: Svenja wasn’t struggling with Jenny, but with her own feelings of guilt. Bella tries to convince Victoria to redevelop a site near the harbor instead of the salt market. Victoria is willing to agree, but only on one condition: Bella must move back in with her. Bella agrees if Victoria gives Elyas a new lease. Will Victoria agree? Britta explains to Toni why she broke up with Heiner, and the two reconcile. Only Heiner remains reserved towards Britta. Valerie is touched when Gisela assures her that she will support her more in the future. Nevertheless, she is annoyed that she no longer has any additional income. When she hears about Noah’s stock portfolio, she has an idea.

videos.title: Episode 4210
videos.overview: Bella’s plan seems to be working when Victoria presents Elyas with a new lease. But her joy is short-lived - the lease terms are far too high. Elyas is furious but refuses to give up. And things get worse: At the contract signing, Victoria shows up wearing a neck brace and claims Elyas attacked her. Bella is unsettled - did Elyas really hit her? Meanwhile, Toni tries to open Noah’s eyes and cancels Valerie’s shopping day. Valerie is disappointed and annoyed. And then she learns that Noah and Toni had an affair. Arthur and Svenja swear that nothing and no one can separate them. But when Victoria expresses her disapproval of the relationship, Arthur takes the consequences and finally breaks off with his mother. Victoria tries to talk her way out of it - too late. Julius is under enormous professional and personal pressure. Will Mo succeed in changing his mind?

videos.title: Episode 4211
videos.overview: Bella is torn: Did Elyas really hurt Viktoria? She would like to believe him, but a lingering doubt remains. Elyas painfully realizes that he has lost not only the laundry, but also Bella. Thanks to Toni, Noah gets the chance to participate in a scientific study. As he hugs Toni euphorically, filled with gratitude, she wonders if Noah is still in love with her. Noah denies it, but Valerie, who witnessed the scene, sees things quite differently. Julius notices that Mo is struggling with his unemployment and offers him the opportunity to work at the hotel. But Mo suggests a creative alternative - a Perfume Day with a workshop. Will Julius accept? Svenja is released from the hospital early. But for her and Arthur, a big question remains: Should they stay in Lüneburg or dare to make a fresh start?

videos.title: Episode 4212
videos.overview: Arthur wants to use Perfume Day to showcase his skills as a fine dining chef to the world. However, during a test cooking session, an extra-hot chili pepper spoils the taste. Is his dream of becoming a celebrity chef shattered? Gisela is expecting a visitor: her holiday fling - ship’s cook Jörg - is coming to Lüneburg. Gisela is initially thrilled and enjoys the charming attention. But then Jörg increasingly gets on her nerves. After the misunderstanding with Toni, Noah wants to appease Valerie with a wellness weekend. However, the new study he’s working on demands his full attention. Noah has to choose between his job and his affair. Mo is so distracted by worrying about Elyas that he can barely concentrate on his presentation. Thanks to some encouraging tips from Britta, Mo’s passion for perfume returns. Elyas is bravely handling the closure of the laundry, but the pain of breaking up with Bella runs deep.

videos.title: Episode 4213
videos.overview: Elyas and Bella are both suffering from their breakup. They make one last attempt and meet for a chat at «Carla’s.» Is there still a chance for their love? Jörg, on the other hand, is on cloud nine, while Gisela wants to get rid of him sooner rather than later. Desperate, she turns to Heiner. How can she gently but firmly make Jörg understand that she has no feelings for him? Shortly before Perfume Day, the dinner at «Carla’s» is barely booked. But Svenja and Arthur seize the initiative and spontaneously offer a blind tasting in front of the hotel. At the same time, Mo is giving his lecture and workshop, with surprising success. Valerie doesn’t believe that Noah ended their affair due to lack of time. Curious, she digs deeper and learns by chance that Noah used to be in love with Toni. She reacts jealously and looks for a way to keep an eye on Toni and Noah.

videos.title: Episode 4214
videos.overview: Till pretends to be processing the kidnapping well with the help of therapy sessions. In reality, however, he no longer attends the sessions and simply tries to suppress the traumatic memories. With dire consequences... Gisela finally wants to end her affair with Jörg, but he ignores all the clues. Together with Heiner, she hatches a plan to hit Jörg at his most vulnerable point. Will this get rid of him for good? Victoria advises Bella to distract herself with work rather than drown in heartbreak. Bella then decides to move back to the estate. Svenja is disappointed that Bella is choosing Emka over her family and is distancing herself from her. Valerie is determined to spend more time at the shared apartment to observe Noah and Toni. But her attempts to break them up are in vain. And finally, Toni sees through her motives.

videos.title: Episode 4215
videos.overview: When Mo and Julius are interviewed as the current Heath couple, Mo realizes how different their dreams for the future are. He tries to find the right moment to talk to Julius about it. But Julius has long had other ideas: He proposes to Mo in public. How will Mo react? Valerie is determined to prove that Noah and Toni are having an affair. To do this, she secretly installs a surveillance camera in the shared apartment. It doesn’t stay undetected for long, however. Despite his panic attack, Till refuses to resume his aborted psychotherapy. Only Arthur is able to persuade him to seek professional help. Meanwhile, Svenja and Arthur are worried about Bella. It seems as if they have lost her to Victoria for good - will Bella find her place in the family again? Gisela and Heiner can’t bring themselves to continue their act in front of Jörg. They decide to tell him the truth.

videos.title: Episode 4216
videos.overview: Bella feels misunderstood by everyone-except Victoria. When Svenja and Arthur find out that Elyas didn’t attack Victoria, she has to admit her plot to Bella. But Bella reacts completely differently than expected. Mo, taken aback, evades Julius’s marriage proposal. He loves Julius, but wants to find out for himself where his career path will lead him first. But when Mo receives a contract for his new company and Julius is overjoyed for him, Mo makes a decision: He counter-proposes to Julius. Will this step really change everything? Toni blackmails Valerie by threatening to expose Noah’s actions on the surveillance camera. Valerie has no choice, so she relents. However, the video footage holds some unexpected surprises that suddenly bring the two sisters closer together.

videos.title: Episode 4217
videos.overview: When Britta meets Matteo, a successful baking influencer, in the grocery store, sparks fly between them immediately. While Matteo uses his charm to entice Britta to reveal the recipe for his legendary cheesecake, she can hardly resist his charisma. Will this unexpected encounter lead to something more? Carla is overjoyed when Michael arrives in Lüneburg earlier than expected. But her joy quickly fades when she realizes she applied for her green card too late. Just as she’s about to confess this to Michael, the two receive bad news from the USA. Svenja finds it difficult to accept that Bella prefers Victoria’s proximity. However, she doesn’t give up and hopes that Arthur’s 40th birthday will provide an opportunity to reconnect. Mo receives a job offer from Parma but wants to discuss it with Julius. However, Julius is constantly being taken up with his family, which makes Mo increasingly insecure.

videos.title: Episode 4218
videos.overview: When Heiner rediscovers an old cassette with Svenja’s first self-written song, Arthur immediately gets a cassette recorder. But before the two can listen to the song, the cassette accidentally falls into a pond. Arthur doesn’t hesitate for a second and immediately jumps in after it. Touched by this heroic act, Svenja makes a spontaneous decision. Britta comes across interesting information about Matteo on the internet: He has five children from four women. Britta takes it easy; she just wants to have fun with Matteo. After Michael and Carla learn about the destruction of their western village by a tropical storm, Carla has to confess her green card misery to Michael. A heated argument ensues. Can the two reconcile? Mo receives the tempting offer to rent space in the perfume factory in Parma. Julius is ready to leave Lüneburg and his family behind. Together they plan their move into a new future. But suddenly Julius becomes thoughtful.

videos.title: Episode 4219
videos.overview: Julius faces a difficult decision: He realizes he’s too attached to his family to move permanently to Parma. While Julius plans to commute between Parma and Lüneburg, Mo realizes that their life dreams are too different. Svenja is overjoyed when Arthur accepts her marriage proposal. To maintain family peace, she invites Victoria to Arthur’s birthday party - but she coldly rejects her. Arthur asks Heiner for his daughter’s hand in marriage, but he refuses. Arthur does everything he can to change his mind. Lilly is worried about her dog Betty, who misses Ben and Tina. Matteo reacts empathetically and promptly films a baking video for dog biscuits with Lilly. Britta is thrilled by the idea - and by Matteo. Noah witnesses Toni sleepwalking. While he’s amused, Toni worries about the causes of her somnambulism. Noah offers her the opportunity to participate in his study. Toni agrees and has to prepare for 24 hours of wakefulness with Noah.

videos.title: Episode 4220
videos.overview: Arthur gives Victoria a choice: Either she treats Svenja with respect, or he will turn away from her. Bella also urges Victoria to come to Arthur’s party, and Victoria actually makes up her mind. But when Arthur and Svenja announce their engagement, the mood changes. Noah is furious when he discovers that Valerie hid a camera in the shared apartment. His mood doesn’t improve when it becomes clear that Toni also knew about the camera. But the two are able to reconcile, and together they stay up all night for Noah’s sleepwalking study. When Noah shows his soft side, Toni suddenly sees him with different eyes. Julius and Mo are deeply hurt by their separation-even though they both know there is no other way. At Arthur’s birthday brunch, they meet one last time and say goodbye. Lilly finds it very difficult to let her dog move to Wendland. But she knows that Betty will finally be well again there.

videos.title: Episode 4221
videos.overview: Arthur’s sister Lou unexpectedly arrives in Lüneburg with her family for his birthday. And Lou and her husband Daniel want to stay longer. Daniel’s architectural firm has been awarded the contract to build the new tech campus. To do this, Lou wants to finally reconcile with her mother Victoria. Eight weeks later, Lou moves to the estate with Daniel and their two sons. But during a dinner, the situation escalates: Victoria can’t contain her old wounds and flees. Gisela, Franka, and Valerie move into the Rose House to make room for Lou. While Franka and Gisela are excited about their new apartment, Valerie is being bitchy. She’s secretly heartbroken for Noah, who’s enjoying his new love with Toni. And then Valerie is caught up in the past: Simon shows up at the door with Olivia and wants to move into the Rose House too. That’s going to cause trouble.

videos.title: Episode 4222
videos.overview: Lou wants a fresh start with Victoria and wants to talk things out with her. But Victoria remains stubborn. Mother and daughter argue again. Richard, who is visiting his sister Lou, thinks reconciliation will be difficult. Will he succeed in convincing his mother to take a step toward Lou? Britta is overwhelmed: Matteo shows up unannounced at her door and wants to spend the night with her. For her, the affair was a one-time affair without any feelings, but now the baking influencer is sparking renewed passion in her. While Valerie vehemently opposes Simon moving into the Rose House with Olivia, Gisela and Franka are thrilled. Simon demands a decision. And finally, Olivia softens Valerie’s heart: Simon can stay. There’s an immediate spark between Richard and Franka. After an initial flirtation, the two don’t waste any time and end up in bed. Both know they won’t see each other again after that. But then, unexpectedly, the two meet again.

videos.title: Episode 4223
videos.overview: Daniel wants to hire Franka as a landscape architect. But Richard, Daniel’s business partner, can’t reach an agreement with Franka. Daniel insists on Franka and puts everything on the line: If he wins at poker, Richard will have to make Franka a new offer. Richard loses, and Franka demands a high price. On a horseback ride, Carla ends up at an abandoned horse farm that has been up for sale for years. Gunter knows why: Dornenhof is haunted. An old woman promptly appears to Carla in a dream, demanding to know what Carla is doing there. Valerie is still unhappily in love with Noah and is shying away from Toni. But Toni wants a better relationship with her half-sister. Noah tries to mediate and invites Valerie to dinner at the shared apartment. But Toni, of all people, is waiting for him there, dressed in a sexy outfit. After Britta learns that Matteo is hiding from the police at her place, she throws him out. But Gisela offers her kitchen as a safe haven.

videos.title: Episode 4224
videos.overview: When Richard hears that Victoria is grooming her granddaughter Bella to be her successor at the EmKA, he doesn’t like it at all. Lou accuses him of still being interested in the EmKa himself. And suddenly, Richard decides not to fly back to the USA, but to stay in Lüneburg instead. Does he want to prevent Bella from getting the EmKA? Toni and Noah are happily planning their trip to the North Cape until Toni learns that her vacation won’t be approved due to staff shortages. Toni doesn’t want to back down again, and when Britta doesn’t accommodate her either, Toni spontaneously quits her job at the hospital. Matteo and Heiner are both heartbroken. They encourage each other and want to fight for their love, but they don’t realize they’re in love with the same woman: Britta. Carla has fallen in love with the old Dornenhof and is determined to take it over. Neither Britta nor Gunter understand Carla. She doesn’t care. But Michael is also against her plan.

videos.title: Episode 4225
videos.overview: Lou and Daniel long for nothing more than a third child. Because Lou is still not pregnant, Daniel gets a check-up with a urologist. The results, however, are a shock for Daniel. Richard is determined to prevent Victoria from naming Bella her successor. But that’s harder than he thought. Britta still finds Dornenhof spooky and tries to talk Carla out of buying it. Therefore, Britta keeps quiet about the fact that she knows the owner of the farm. When Carla finds out, an argument erupts between the friends, and Carla feels even more motivated to buy the farm. Until she encounters a ghost there. Noah reacts with incomprehension to Toni’s spontaneous resignation from the hospital-just to go on vacation with him. Only after Valerie unwittingly points out that Toni’s resignation is proof of her love for him does Noah apologize to Toni, full of affection.

videos.title: Episode 4226
videos.overview: Heiner, in love, takes a step closer to Britta until he realizes that Britta’s good mood is connected to Matteo’s return and that Matteo is his rival. Heiner doesn’t give up and challenges Matteo for his date with Britta. But when Britta finds out, Heiner is bitterly disappointed. Valerie refuses to babysit Olivia, even though Simon is in dire straits. This is met with incomprehension by Simon and Gisela. Gisela wants to take Olivia, but is roped in by Victoria. When Olivia ends up with Valerie after all, it’s Noah who realizes how much being close to her daughter is straining Valerie. Finally, Noah kindly agrees to babysit Olivia. Valerie finally feels understood and falls even more in love with Noah. Daniel and Lou have to deal with Daniel’s possible tumor diagnosis. But they stick together, and Lou accompanies Daniel to the biopsy. Richard is also deeply affected and confronts his primal fears.

videos.title: Episode 4227
videos.overview: Britta can’t get Heiner’s declaration of love out of her head. Would a relationship with Heiner be an option after all? But she finds a lightness with Matteo that she lacks with Heiner. Britta has no choice but to admit to herself and Heiner: She’s fallen in love with Matteo. Daniel and Lou deal with the wait for the biopsy results differently. While Lou faces her feelings, Daniel distracts himself with work. But Lou suspects that something is brewing beneath Daniel’s cool facade. Toni persuades Noah to do some outdoor training for their trip to the North Cape. Noah seizes the opportunity and plans a romantic camping trip to the Dornenhof. But the romance never materializes - Valerie sabotages their time together, and Toni gets hurt. Carla is frustrated that Britta and Gunter advise her against buying the Dornenhof - she expects more support from her friends. When Gunter realizes this, he agrees to question the farm’s seller.

videos.title: Episode 4228
videos.overview: Britta has fallen in love with Matteo. But unfortunately, the feeling isn’t mutual. Matteo just wants to spend some carefree time with Britta-without any commitment. When he hears from Gunter that Britta has feelings for him, Matteo is shocked. Toni and Noah move their tentative camping trip to Toni’s room and take Valerie with them-to be there for her. Toni doesn’t realize how much Valerie has a crush on Noah. Daniel and Lou continue to be there for each other while they wait for Daniel’s diagnosis. Meanwhile, Lou saves the panicked Franka from a horse. The two women become friends. Richard continues his plot against Victoria and achieves his first small successes. He wins Bella’s trust, and to some extent even Victoria’s-both are completely unsuspecting. Gisela feels guilty because Johanna has moved into the hotel. Is it too noisy for her in the Rose House? Meanwhile, Johanna feels very comfortable in the hotel and doesn’t want to leave.

videos.title: Episode 4229
videos.overview: Daniel’s worst fears come true: Britta confirms the diagnosis of testicular cancer. She recommends surgery for Daniel. During the conversation, he panics and flees. In nature, Daniel finds himself again. He wants to go through with the surgery and - if possible - have a third child. Britta also encourages Lou not to give up on her desire to have children and to have Daniel’s sperm frozen. Valerie interprets Noah’s sensitive behavior toward her as a sign of love. Toni is angry with Noah; Valerie will never let go of him this way. Only when Noah sets clear boundaries for Valerie does Valerie withdraw. Toni reconciles with Noah, and they both declare the shared apartment a Valerie-free zone. Will that work? When Richard hears that Bella wants to stay in Lüneburg instead of moving to Berlin with her family, he tries to convince Bella to leave Lüneburg and the EmKa. Because Bella is in his way. Can Britta, despite her feelings, embark on a casual affair with Matteo? Matteo is skeptical.

videos.title: Episode 4230
videos.overview: Lou bravely stands by Daniel after his cancer diagnosis. Only Victoria manages to get her to let her guard down. In her mother’s arms, Lou tearfully confesses how great her fear of losing Daniel truly is. Simon is looking for a new apartment, but Elyas convinces him that he shouldn’t let Valerie drive him out. So he decides to stay in the attic with Olivia-much to Valerie’s annoyance. Arthur is looking forward to moving to Berlin with Svenja, but he’s worried about Bella, whom he doesn’t want to completely leave under Victoria’s control. Lou and Richard persuade Victoria to finally accept Svenja, whereupon she makes a generous offer. Carla wants to make a fresh start quickly and move to the horse farm. Britta thinks this is too hasty, but wants to support her friend against her better judgment. However, the first night at the horse farm turns out to be very uncomfortable for the two friends.

videos.title: Episode 4231
videos.overview: Toni and Noah are looking forward to their cycling holiday together, but then Noah receives a job offer from Berlin and spontaneously accepts without telling Toni. Victoria makes Svenja and Arthur the surprising suggestion of holding their wedding at the estate. The two hesitate, especially Svenja, who remains skeptical at first. Only when Victoria demonstrates in an unconventional way how serious she is about the offer is Svenja persuaded. Britta takes over the planning of the bachelorette party but quickly reaches her creative limits. Only Gisela’s direct suggestion gives her an idea - a stripper is needed, and Elyas is to take care of it. However, the evening doesn’t go as planned. Meanwhile, Carla feels criticized from all sides - whether by Gunter, Britta, or Heiner. Her impulsive reaction makes her wonder: Could there be some truth to the accusations after all?

videos.title: Episode 4232
videos.overview: Toni is deeply disappointed: Noah has decided to take the job in Berlin without consulting her-and then he even cancels their planned vacation together. For Toni, this is the turning point. She painfully realizes that Noah’s career will always take precedence. Does their relationship still have a chance? Meanwhile, Svenja’s bachelorette party gets off to a slow start; even Elyas’s performance as a stripper barely gets the party going. Only Julius’s unexpected arrival turns the evening into a roaring success. Only Svenja and Arthur stay away from the revelry and enjoy their time together-unaware that Till has drunkenly lost their wedding rings. Heiner is also struggling with mixed feelings: His daughter’s wedding is approaching, and her departure for Berlin weighs heavily on him. When Gunter finally appoints him master of ceremonies, Heiner is honored-and even more nervous, with unforeseen consequences.

videos.title: Episode 4233
videos.overview: Svenja and Arthur begin their wedding day relaxed and unaware that Till is frantically searching for their lost wedding rings. During his frantic search, he runs into Jess, who is immediately captivated by this romantic mission. When she later stumbles upon the rings, she knows one thing for sure: she has to save the wedding. Together with Jonas, she sets out to find the bride and groom. Meanwhile, Till confesses the loss to Arthur - a confession that particularly hurts Svenja, for whom Jenny’s rings are of great importance. But this isn’t the only mishap that occurs that day. Will Svenja and Arthur’s big day turn into a disaster? Noah refuses to accept his breakup with Toni and struggles with the idea of crashing the wedding with a confrontation. Simon initially manages to dissuade him. But then he receives an unexpected offer from Valerie that he can’t refuse.

videos.title: Episode 4234
videos.overview: Jess tries unsuccessfully to reach Patrick and decides to go to the old laundry where he plans to open his insurance office. There, she finds only a note with a shocking message. Meanwhile, Richard is weaving his intrigues: He wants to drive a wedge between Victoria and Bella - and succeeds. When Bella is preparing important documents for the Lower Saxony grant at the estate, Richard distracts her with Hermine’s help and steals the key papers. Unbeknownst to her, Bella submits an incomplete application. Noah can’t accept Toni’s breakup. After a heated argument in their shared apartment, the two end up in bed - but for Toni, nothing changes. She refuses to put herself last any longer. Noah then announces that he’s turning down the job offer in Berlin. Is he serious? The situation is also coming to a head for Lou and Daniel: While Lou’s IVF treatment is imminent, Daniel’s surgery is scheduled. There’s no time left for just the two of them.

videos.title: Episode 4235
videos.overview: Svenja and Arthur find it hard to leave Bella in Lüneburg. Bella, too, wistfully realizes how much she will miss everyone. But she is certain she has a safe and secure home with Victoria. Little does Bella know that Richard’s evil plan is succeeding.On the day of his surgery, Daniel is accompanied to the hospital by Richard, while Lou receives emotional support from Victoria. At the doctor’s office, Lou unexpectedly runs into Jess-an encounter with unforeseen consequences. Jess’s life is in ruins: Patrick has ended their relationship and left her packed suitcases on her doorstep. Gisela takes her in, and Valerie also offers her comfort. Toni and Noah realize that their love has no future and break up for good. While Carla is excited about her new kitchen, Britta is sad about moving out. But a misunderstanding leads to an argument between the two friends. Will they find their way back to each other?

videos.title: Episode 4236
videos.overview: Richard continues to spin his web of intrigue: He cleverly makes it look as if Bella deliberately misplaced an important document for the grant application. Victoria is already suspicious, and when Richard ensures that Victoria finds the missing document among Bella’s papers, Bella is backed into a corner. Jess is at her wit’s end-not only is she heartbroken, but she’s also having trouble with her boss. Furious, she writes a resignation email, but doesn’t send it. Or so she thinks. Till and Bella are planning a bucket day with Arthur and Svenja. They want to tackle a list of things they had planned to do in Lüneburg. But it doesn’t work out: Svenja has to go to Berlin at short notice for an apartment viewing. Daniel shows Lou how grateful he is for her support with a romantic gesture. But when Britta gives him hormone replacement medication, he feels emasculated. Overwhelmed, he takes his frustration out on Lou.

videos.title: Episode 4237
videos.overview: Britta is looking forward to her next first night at Dornenhof. Carla, on the other hand, now believes the farm is actually haunted. Heiner’s lost hammer, Johanna’s story about the witch burning... Britta manages to calm her friend down until Carla is awakened in the middle of the night by an eerie crying... Richard’s scheme has succeeded: Victoria is so disappointed by Bella’s alleged lie that she fires her. Shocked and heartbroken, Bella moves out of the manor. Richard skillfully comforts his mother, only to overhear Victoria offering Lou Bella’s position at the EmKa. Elyas can no longer bear the tension between Toni and Noah and flees the shared apartment. He then runs into Bella. She is devastated by her dismissal and clashes with Elyas. On his last evening at «Carlas,» Arthur is surprised by a farewell committee and is deeply touched. However, when he hears that Victoria has kicked Bella out, he and Till search the city for her.

videos.title: Episode 4238
videos.overview: Lou firmly rejects Victoria’s request to return to EmKa. An argument ensues, and Victoria announces she’s selling EmKa to someone outside the family. When Richard hears this, he cuts ties with EmKa and Lüneburg. He wants to travel the world with Daniel again. Daniel refuses-he needs to process the loss of his masculinity. Then they learn that the tech campus investor is bankrupt. What will happen to their assignment now? After a disastrous farewell party and a misunderstanding, Toni and Noah say a heartfelt goodbye before Noah boards the train to Berlin. The trouble at Dornenhof continues. Carla is also suffering from insomnia and hot flashes. Britta realizes what’s really wrong with Carla: she’s entering menopause. When Julius then asks Carla to fill in for the head chef at «Carlas,» it all becomes too much for her... Bella and Elyas manage to take a step toward each other again, and Bella decides to stay in Lüneburg for the time being. And to confront Victoria.

videos.title: Episode 4239
videos.overview: Franka and Carla’s stories make Jess realize how boring her life with Patrick was. While dutifully waiting for the repairmen outside Patrick’s office, she observes the activity, and new stories begin to form in her mind. Finally, Jonas convinces Jess: until she finds a new job, she’ll use the time to write. But then Jess receives a payment demand from EmKa, and the carefree feeling vanishes. Richard doesn’t understand why Daniel doesn’t want to accompany him to Asia and breaks up with him. Arthur manages to reason with his brother, and Richard decides to be there for his best friend. But his anger toward Victoria continues to simmer. Victoria offers Valerie a job in Munich. Simon persuades Valerie to spend her last day with Olivia and him. He makes it clear to her: she’s allowed to have maternal feelings even without custody. Valerie is touched, and saying goodbye is harder than she expected. Till’s plan to reconcile Bella and Elyas backfires.

videos.title: Episode 4240
videos.overview: After the tech campus project is scrapped, Victoria offers financial assistance, but Richard and Daniel refuse. They want to remain independent. Daniel, in particular, is struggling: the hormone therapy is taking its toll and undermining his self-esteem as a man. When he hears that the campus is to be auctioned off, he wants to bid himself to save the project. But will Richard join him? Meanwhile, Jess is in serious trouble: Patrick has run off to Mallorca, leaving her with the lease for the office at Salzmarkt. Victoria is unyielding, and even Gisela can’t help her niece. When Elyas tells Jess about his experiences with EmKa, the full extent of the situation becomes clear to Jess-and she suffers a panic attack. Michael suddenly appears at Dornenhof-with ambitious plans: he wants to transform the property into a Western village. But Carla is strictly against it. Will she prevail? And Gisela? She’s determined to finally find her sport-and she’s giving it her all.

videos.title: Episode 4241
videos.overview: Jess is desperately searching for a job to pay the rent, but quickly realizes that finding something suitable isn’t so easy. When she runs into Britta, who thanks her for a book recommendation, Jess suddenly has a brilliant idea. Meanwhile, Michael is enthusiastically planning to transform the Dornenhof farm into a Western town. Carla, however, remains skeptical-and finally confesses to him that she loves the farm just the way it is. Will the two of them find a solution together? Richard and Daniel are determined to buy the tech campus at auction. Lou, on the other hand, remains reserved-she believes Daniel primarily wants to prove something to himself. On top of that, there are family worries: their son Pelle is being bullied by a boy on the football team. When the coach quits, Lou takes it upon herself to coach him. Eliyas thinks Bella has already left for Berlin, but is surprised to discover that she’s still in Lüneburg and intends to stay.

videos.title: Episode 4242
videos.overview: Daniel and Richard are determined to win the auction for the tech campus. But an unexpected competitor drives the price up. Richard takes a big risk and ends up bidding significantly more than the original financing loan. A dangerous game... Jess is unstoppable in her planning for her bookstore. With the support of friends and family, her dream is taking shape. As a highlight, Johanna agrees to a reading and book signing at the opening. But then a fateful misunderstanding occurs: In the «Heideecho» newspaper, the opening isn’t announced in three months as planned, but for the very next day. Will the store be ready in time? While Bella is suffering from Victoria’s rejection, she finds comfort in Lou. Lou realizes that Victoria is also struggling with the situation and tries to mediate. Carla is excited to finally meet Michael’s daughter, Ellie. Michael is more reserved-and with good reason. Because Ellie soon causes quite a stir.

videos.title: Episode 4243
videos.overview: Lou hosts a poker night to distract Richard and Daniel from their defeat at the tech campus auction. Franka is also there-and spontaneously brings Julius along. While Richard tries to get through the evening discreetly with two of his affairs, a surprising revelation causes a stir: It’s not some unknown investor who bought the tech campus, but Victoria. Meanwhile, Jess faces a huge challenge: Her bookstore has to open overnight. While she’s in Hamburg getting new books, Gisela quickly gathers the entire Böttcher clan. But will there be enough time to get everything ready for the opening? Carla wants to focus on the horse boarding business with Michael-but her passion for cooking won’t let her go. This gives her an idea... Ellie meets Toni and Elyas and immediately recognizes their heartbreak. When Bella joins them, an argument with Elyas escalates-but his words make Bella think.

videos.title: Episode 4244
videos.overview: Midway through her opening speech at the bookstore, Jess suddenly feels nauseous and vomits. Johanna smirks and speculates about a possible pregnancy. Jess finds this completely absurd-no sex, no pregnancy. But Gisela persuades her to take a test. Could it still be true? Meanwhile, Lou has to come to terms with a bitter truth: her desire for a child remains unfulfilled for now; she isn’t pregnant. Despite the disappointment, she finds strength in being there for Bella, who continues to suffer from Victoria’s rejection. When Bella remembers a magical moment with Elyas, she spontaneously seeks him out-and experiences a nasty surprise. After Victoria’s unexpected purchase of the tech campus, she offers Richard and Daniel positions at the EmKa. Daniel indignantly refuses, but Richard accepts. He secretly harbors his own plan: he wants to take over the EmKa completely.

videos.title: Episode 4245
videos.overview: Jess is stunned: She’s pregnant? She goes to her gynecologist and runs into Lou there - just like two weeks ago. When Nurse Ina calls Jess’s name as Mrs. Mahler, Jess becomes thoughtful. When Lou jokes that she and Jess weren’t mistaken for each other two weeks ago, something suddenly clicks for Jess. Bella wants to distract herself from her heartbreak and goes out to party with Toni. On the way back, Till calls her - yesterday was the anniversary of her mother’s death. How could Bella have forgotten? She seeks solace at the accident scene. There, a fateful newspaper ad blows into her hands. Lou wants to look to the future after the failed insemination. But for Daniel, his world collapses. Richard pursues his plan: He accepts Victoria’s offer and promises her that he will also persuade Daniel to return to the EMKa. But that proves more difficult than expected.

videos.title: Episode 4246
videos.overview: Lou has to tell Daniel that there’s no chance of another insemination. Selflessly, Lou is there for Daniel and asks him to reconsider the merger with EmKa. When Richard also makes an emotional plea to him, Daniel agrees for the sake of his family. Meanwhile, Jess has learned who she’s been mistaken for - Lou Mahler. Bella believes her deceased mother sent her a sign - to make a fresh start somewhere else in the world. But not alone. Bella realizes that Elyas still holds a place in her heart. Britta is grateful that Carla accompanies her to the accident site on the first anniversary of Hendrik’s death. The support of her family also shows Britta that she’s not alone. Ellie is fascinated by how openly Gisela speaks about intimate topics. She films Gisela and sends the video to her friends in Nashville. Given the many interested responses, Ellie asks Gisela to answer her friends’ questions. Gisela is flattered.

videos.title: Episode 4247
videos.overview: Jess tries to tell Lou and Daniel that their patient files were switched at the doctor’s office. As a result, Jess is pregnant with Daniel’s child. Daniel throws Jess out, but Lou tries to remember the day of the insemination. Like pieces of a puzzle, the clues begin to fall into place. Lou asks Jess to go with her to the doctor’s office and clear things up. Bella wants to win Elyas back and tries everything to get him to listen to her. But Elyas blocks all contact. Only Toni makes Elyas realize that he’s only making himself unhappy. Elyas allows himself to feel his emotions and reconciles with Bella. Victoria develops alarming symptoms and rushes to the hospital. Britta takes care of her and discovers that Victoria has been taking the wrong dosage of her supplements. Britta reassures her, which Victoria interprets as Britta being available to her for all her health needs in the future. Richard triumphs: His and Daniel’s architecture firm is merging with EmKa.

videos.title: Episode 4248
